title: Cognitive Sustainability and Employees' Wellbeing in a Digital Work Environment
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Cognitive Sustainability and Employees' Wellbeing in a Digital Work Environment

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper seeks to reflect on sustainable human development, pointing to new areas requiring attention and relevant practices to enhance employees' effectiveness and wellbeing. When managing the complexity of the workplace, characterized by an intensified digitalization, employees need to improve their awareness of factors hindering and supporting their cognitive abilities. On the one hand, they should protect themselves from the intense pace of work and from the continuous interruptions from multiple sources, and on the other hand, they should invest time in nurturing their thinking through exposure to diversity and sustainable habits. Studies show that undivided attention and positive levels of energy are crucial to the health of people working in organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文反思可持续人类发展，指出需要关注的新领域和相关实践，以提高员工效能和福祉。在数字化加剧的工作场所复杂性管理中，员工需要提高对阻碍和支持其认知能力因素的认识，既要保护自己免受高强度工作节奏和持续干扰，又要投资时间通过接触多样性和可持续习惯来培养思维。研究表明，专注的注意力和积极的能量水平对组织员工的健康至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何在数字化加剧的复杂工作环境中促进可持续人类发展，提高员工效能和福祉？
AI.motivation: 工作场所数字化程度加剧，员工面临高强度工作节奏和持续干扰，需要关注可持续人类发展，提高员工认知能力和健康水平。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续人类发展理论、认知能力理论、员工福祉理论
AI.method: 反思性分析和文献综述
AI.findings: 员工需要提高对阻碍和支持认知能力因素的认识，保护自己免受工作强度和干扰，同时投资时间培养思维，专注注意力和积极能量对员工健康至关重要。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了可持续人类发展理论在工作场所的应用，深化了对数字化环境下员工认知能力影响因素的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了提高员工效能和福祉的实践指导，包括保护员工免受干扰、培养思维习惯、维持专注注意力和积极能量等具体措施。

title: Examination of Major Factors Affecting Exchange Rate in Albania and its Influence on Inflation and Real Economy (Period 2004 -2014)
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Examination of Major Factors Affecting Exchange Rate in Albania and its Influence on Inflation and Real Economy (Period 2004 -2014)
detail.abstract: The aim of this research is to provide statistical evidence of major determinants of Euro/ Albanian Lek exchange rate levels and its consequences on inflation and real economy. The method used for this purposes is empirical research, Granger Causality Test has been applied in order to provide answers to the objectives of the research. Statistical examination provided major evidence of Granger Causality of inflation, foreign direct investments, industrial production, and foreign debt on Euro/ALL exchange rate levels. In addition the research provides statistical evidence that Euro/ALL exchange rate fluctuations in long run cause Savings in Domestic Currency and in short run Savings in Foreign Currency. Moreover, there is also found the existence of Granger Causality between export and interest rates with a minimum four months delay and Granger Causality of interest rates on inflation with two months delay. Whereas, based on examined variables there could not be found any significant finding of long run influence of Euro/ALL exchange rate levels on inflation and real economy.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过格兰杰因果检验发现，通货膨胀、外国直接投资、工业生产和外债是欧元/阿尔巴尼亚列克汇率水平的主要决定因素。汇率波动在长期影响本币储蓄，在短期影响外币储蓄。出口与利率之间存在4个月滞后的因果关系，利率对通货膨胀有2个月滞后的影响。但未发现汇率水平对通货膨胀和实体经济有长期显著影响。
AI.research_question: 欧元/阿尔巴尼亚列克汇率水平的主要决定因素是什么？汇率波动对通货膨胀和实体经济有何影响？
AI.motivation: 为欧元/阿尔巴尼亚列克汇率水平的主要决定因素及其对通货膨胀和实体经济的影响提供统计证据
AI.theoretical_framework: 汇率决定理论，格兰杰因果关系理论
AI.method: 实证研究，格兰杰因果检验
AI.findings: 通货膨胀、外国直接投资、工业生产和外债是汇率的主要决定因素；汇率波动在长期影响本币储蓄，在短期影响外币储蓄；出口与利率存在4个月滞后的因果关系；利率对通货膨胀有2个月滞后的影响；汇率水平对通货膨胀和实体经济无长期显著影响
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了欧元/阿尔巴尼亚列克汇率的具体决定因素和动态关系，丰富了汇率决定理论在转型经济体的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿尔巴尼亚货币政策制定者提供了汇率管理的实证依据，有助于更好地预测和控制汇率波动对经济的影响

title: The European Union's Countervailing Duties on Electric Vehicles from China: Disputes and Prospects
affiliations: Tianjin University - Ma Yinchu School of Economics

detail.title: The European Union's Countervailing Duties on Electric Vehicles from China: Disputes and Prospects

publicationDetails.journalName: United States Association for Energy Economics (USAEE) & International Association for Energy Economics (IAEE) Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The rapid increase of Chinese-made electric vehicles (EVs) raises a variety of concerns outside China, particularly in the European Union and the United States. This article analyses why the European Union began imposing high countervailing duties on Chinese-made EVs when they were not yet common on the streets of Europe, and the differences between and logic of the European Union and the United States. It also examines the level of countervailing duties that the European Union must impose on Chinese EVs to diminish their competitiveness in European markets, and the impact of additional countervailing duties on the European Union itself and Chinese EV exports to Europe. It looks at why the European Union decided to negotiate with China on a minimum price after imposing countervailing duties, but was particularly cautious about taking the lowest-price approach. It explores the significance and limitations of the China Chamber of Commerce for Import and Export of Machinery and Electronic Products" authorisation of representatives to negotiate on behalf of Chinese EV manufacturers, the possibility of implementing a hybrid scheme of countervailing duties and minimum prices, and the impact of the re-election of Donald Trump as President of the United States on the direction of the China-EU EV tariff dispute. The article also discusses overseas investment by Chinese EV companies, and ends with a discussion of the ways to move this dispute forward.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟对中国电动汽车征收高额反补贴税的原因、美欧政策差异、反补贴税水平对竞争力的影响、最低价格谈判的谨慎态度、商会代表谈判的意义、混合方案可能性、特朗普连任影响、中国EV企业海外投资，以及争端解决途径。

AI.method: 政策分析、比较研究、案例研究、逻辑推理分析。
AI.findings: 欧盟提前征税是预防性保护措施；美欧政策逻辑存在差异；反补贴税需达到特定水平才能削弱中国EV竞争力；最低价格谈判是妥协方案但需谨慎；商会代表谈判具有象征意义但存在局限性；混合方案可能更有效；特朗普连任将加剧贸易紧张。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴技术产业贸易保护主义的研究，拓展了反补贴税与最低价格混合机制的理论探讨，丰富了地缘政治因素对贸易政策影响的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中国电动汽车企业应对贸易壁垒提供策略建议，为政策制定者设计更有效的贸易争端解决方案提供参考，为企业海外投资决策提供指导。

title: Meritocracy and Its Discontents

detail.title: Meritocracy and Its Discontents

publicationDetails.detailsText: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series Paper No. 25-19
publicationDetails.journalName: The University of Chicago Stone Center Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this essay, I outline some ways to think about meritocracy. I interpret meritocracy as a constellation of claims about who deserves certain things, typically positions in schools, firms, and government organizations. My goal is to illustrate some of the challenges involved in evaluating meritocracy. I will explore how different concepts of merit can lead to different optimal policies. These optimal policies will, in turn, rely on features of education and labor market processes for which strong empirical evidence is lacking. Finally, I will explore equality/efficiency tradeoffs that emerge under meritocratic rules.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了精英主义的概念、评估挑战、不同精英定义对政策的影响，以及精英规则下的平等与效率权衡。

AI.motivation: 精英主义作为关于谁应获得特定职位的主张集合，其评估面临诸多挑战，需要系统分析。

affiliations: University of Auckland - Faculty of Law, University of Copenhagen - Copenhagen University, University of Copenhagen - Copenhagen University and University of Copenhagen - Copenhagen University

declarations.funderStatement: This study was supported by the Carlsberg Foundation, grant CF21-0317 (Semper Ardens: Accelerate). Project title: Purchase Power – Sustainable Public Procurement through Private Law Enforcement (PurpLE). Hosted by the Faculty of Law at the University of Copenhagen.

detail.abstract:
The realm of contemporary EU public procurement is expanding in complexity. This complexity arises not only from the incorporation of sustainability concerns and the procurement of diverse technological solutions but also from an increasing reliance on negotiated procedures. The growing interest in these methods within the EU highlights the need to explore their legal aspects in greater detail. As with other commercial transactions, issues can occasionally arise in public procurement. This raises a crucial question: What are the legal recourses if economic operators involved in the public procurement process are mistreated? Is it solely based on public procurement law, or can contract law doctrines, such as culpa in contrahendo, also be applied? 

To address this inquiry, the article is structured as follows: Section 1 outlines the interplay between public procurement and contract law. Section 2 explores potential avenues for compensation arising from breaches of public procurement rules under the Remedies Directive. Section 3 examines the concept of culpa in contrahendo under Danish law. Section 4 assesses the applicability and potential role of the culpa in contrahendo doctrine in Danish public procurement law, with particular attention to how it may be adapted in the context of public contracts. The final section summarises the key findings and draws conclusions based on the analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧盟公共采购中法律救济途径，特别是分析了在公共采购过程中经济经营者受到不当对待时，除了公共采购法之外，是否还能适用合同法中的缔约过失责任（culpa in contrahendo）原则。
AI.research_question: 在公共采购过程中，如果经济经营者受到不当对待，法律救济途径是什么？是否仅限于公共采购法，还是可以适用合同法中的缔约过失责任原则？
AI.motivation: 欧盟公共采购领域日益复杂化，涉及可持续性问题、技术解决方案采购以及谈判程序的增加，需要更深入地探讨这些程序的法律方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 公共采购法与合同法的交叉关系，特别是缔约过失责任（culpa in contrahendo）理论在丹麦法律体系中的应用。
AI.method: 文献分析和法律比较方法，通过分析欧盟公共采购法、丹麦合同法以及相关案例来探讨法律救济途径。
AI.findings: 缔约过失责任原则在丹麦公共采购法中具有适用性，可以为经济经营者提供额外的法律保护，特别是在公共合同谈判过程中。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了公共采购法律救济理论，建立了公共采购法与合同法之间的理论联系，丰富了缔约过失责任在公共领域应用的理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共采购实践提供了更全面的法律保护框架，帮助经济经营者了解在采购过程中受到不当对待时的法律救济选择，促进了公共采购的公平性和透明度。

title: Using Corporate Political Activity Resources to Advocate for LGBT Rights in Hostile Countries Where Multinational Corporations Operate
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Using Corporate Political Activity Resources to Advocate for LGBT Rights in Hostile Countries Where Multinational Corporations Operate

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Many countries where multinational corporations operate are hostile to LGBT people, including their own employees. While many multinational corporations have a strong record of LGBT inclusion practices in western countries, this paper discusses the role these businesses can play to advocate for the extension of protections to LGBT people in hostile countries. Data show a trend where multinational corporations invest significant resources in corporate political activity. This suggests that multinational corporations have the capacity to engage with local authorities on anti-LGBT laws should they choose to do so. Not acting to help protect LGBT people in hostile countries presents reputational risks to a multinational corporation's social responsibility commitment. LGBT advocacy organizations could question a business's motivation, i.e., is corporate support for LGBT communities in western countries because of a genuine commitment to social responsibility and inclusion values, or part of marketing efforts to target the "pink dollar". There is an opportunity for further research to explore the tension between the desire to comply with local laws and advocating for LGBT people in hostile countries, including a business's employees, suppliers and customers.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨跨国公司在敌视LGBT群体的国家中如何通过企业政治活动来倡导对LGBT人群的保护，分析了不采取行动可能带来的声誉风险，并指出需要进一步研究企业在遵守当地法律与倡导LGBT权益之间的张力。
AI.research_question: 跨国公司在敌视LGBT群体的国家中应如何发挥作用来倡导对LGBT人群的保护？
AI.motivation: 许多跨国公司在西方国家有良好的LGBT包容实践记录，但在敌视LGBT的国家中，这些企业面临着是否应该倡导LGBT权益的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、企业政治活动理论、声誉风险管理理论
AI.method: 文献综述和理论分析
AI.findings: 跨国公司有能力和资源通过企业政治活动与当地政府就反LGBT法律进行交涉；不采取行动保护LGBT人群会带来声誉风险；LGBT倡导组织可能质疑企业在西方国家支持LGBT社区的动机。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业社会责任理论在LGBT权益倡导方面的应用，提出了跨国公司在敌对国家中LGBT权益倡导的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为跨国公司提供了在敌视LGBT国家中平衡当地法律遵守与LGBT权益倡导的实践指导，帮助企业识别和管理相关声誉风险。

title: Sustainable Entrepreneurship in Tourism: Rescuing Authenticity
affiliations: Forward College and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Sustainable Entrepreneurship in Tourism: Rescuing Authenticity

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Authenticity is an integral motivator behind the success of many tourist destinations and experiences. This notion is often formulated as a contrast to other types of tourist experiences, such as mass tourism, which erodes authenticity and poses challenges for environmental sustainability. We argue that local entrepreneurship is uniquely positioned to provide positive and social environmental impacts, particularly when implemented in itinerary-based experiences. We identify the revitalization of past models-such as the Camino de Santiago-as a paradigmatic basis for a set of new, more distributive, and sustainable tourism strategies.

AI.tldr: 本文认为本地创业能够提供积极的社会环境影响，特别是在基于行程的旅游体验中，并以圣地亚哥朝圣之路的复兴为例，提出了更分布式和可持续的旅游策略。

title: Utilising Artificial Intelligence in Digital Marketing Strategy: Opportunities and Challenges for Marketers
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics, AAB College - Faculty of Economics and State University of Tetova

detail.title: Utilising Artificial Intelligence in Digital Marketing Strategy: Opportunities and Challenges for Marketers
detail.abstract: This study explores the integration of artificial intelligence (AI) in digital marketing, focusing on its impact on marketing practices and the evolving roles of marketers. The research aims to provide insights for professionals and academics by examining how AIdriven content marketing strategies affect consumer behavior, specifically purchase intentions. It hypothesizes that these strategies positively influence purchase intentions through brand awareness, customer retention, and engagement. Using qualitative analysis, case studies, and partial least square structural equation modeling (PLS-SEM), the study investigates the extent to which AI-driven marketing influences purchase intention. The results indicate that AI significantly transforms marketing operations, enhances consumer value, and drives the shift from traditional to digital marketing. PLS-SEM analysis shows that AI-driven content marketing substantially increases brand awareness, retention, and engagement, with its impact on purchase intentions being primarily indirect (Chintalapati & Pandey, 2022; Kumar et al., 2024). The study offers actionable recommendations for stakeholders to adapt to AI-driven marketing and emphasizes understanding indirect influences on purchase decisions.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨人工智能在数字营销中的应用，重点关注AI驱动的内容营销策略如何通过品牌认知、客户保留和参与度间接影响购买意愿，为从业者提供适应AI驱动营销的实用建议。

AI.motivation: 探索AI在数字营销中的整合及其对营销实践和营销人员角色演变的影响，为专业人士和学者提供见解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于AI驱动的营销策略通过品牌认知、客户保留和参与度影响购买意愿的理论框架。
AI.method: 采用定性分析、案例研究和偏最小二乘结构方程模型（PLS-SEM）进行实证研究。
AI.findings: AI显著改变营销运营，增强消费者价值，推动从传统营销向数字营销的转变；AI驱动的内容营销大幅提升品牌认知、保留和参与度，对购买意愿的影响主要是间接的。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对AI驱动营销策略通过中介变量间接影响消费者购买决策机制的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为利益相关者提供适应AI驱动营销的行动建议，强调理解购买决策中间接影响的重要性。

title: La société à mission, une entreprise au service d'un développement durable ? (The “Société à Mission”: A Company Serving Sustainable Development?)
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: La société à mission, une entreprise au service d'un développement durable ? (The “Société à Mission”: A Company Serving Sustainable Development?)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: Notre article se propose d'explorer le potentiel de diffusion de la nouvelle qualité de société à mission, introduite en France par la loi Pacte du 2019 et de sa possible contribution à un engagement RSE plus important des entreprises françaises. En se basant sur la littérature en économie, sciences de gestion et droit, ainsi que sur les premières données disponibles sur les sociétés à mission en France, l'article analyse les caractéristiques juridiques de ce label et ses avantages et désavantages potentiels pour les entreprises. A la lumière de cette analyse, le texte explore l'impact potentiel du label sur les consommateurs et celui des modifications de la gouvernance sur les capacités d'innovations sociétales et environnementales des entreprises ainsi que sur ses collaborateurs. Après avoir mis en évidence les limites de l'impact de la SM, les auteurs formulent des propositions d'amélioration de l'attractivité et de l'efficacité du label, tout en soulignant la nécessité de politiques publiques plus générales pour affronter les défis de la RSE, notamment le défi climatique.

English Abstract: This article aims to explore the potential diffusion of the new “société à mission” status, introduced in France by the 2019 Pacte law, and its possible contribution to stronger CSR (Corporate Social Responsibility) engagement among French companies. Drawing on literature from economics, management sciences, and law, as well as the first available data on sociétés à mission in France, the article analyzes the legal characteristics of this label and its potential advantages and disadvantages for companies. In light of this analysis, the text explores the potential impact of the label on consumers, as well as how changes in governance may affect companies’ societal and environmental innovation capabilities, along with impacts on employees. After highlighting the limits of the impact of the société à mission, the authors propose measures to improve the attractiveness and effectiveness of the label, while emphasizing the need for broader public policies to address CSR challenges, particularly the climate challenge.

title: Deeper than DeepSeek: China's Lesser Known AI Firms
affiliations: Harvard University - Harvard Law School

detail.title: Deeper than DeepSeek: China's Lesser Known AI Firms
detail.abstract:
Chinese AI startup DeepSeek has made the headlines once again in September 2025 after a peer-reviewed article in Nature magazine co-authored by DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng claimed that training costs for DeepSeek-R01 were a mere $294,000. This figure was not previously reported and is much lower than previous
estimates and reported training costs from U.S. AI companies, which suggests that DeepSeek’s impact on the AI industry may still be underestimated by foreign observers, pundits, and investors. Regardless of whether DeepSeek’s technology truly “cutting-edge” or whether it is simply a provider of a competent and cost-efficient
LLM, one aspect of DeepSeek that is most definitely revolutionary is the fact that it is a startup that has broken
through in a highly competitive domestic tech industry that has been largely known for its tech monopolies or duopolies. The timing of DeepSeek's breakthrough just a few years after the conclusion of China's regulatory crackdown on the tech sector is also significant, because tech giants bore the brunt of the regulatory penalties. Not only are these startups poised to play a larger role in China's economy moving forward, but they also present a new wrinkle to theoretical frameworks that have been used to analyze China's regulatory approach. Thus, while the majority of analyses from scholars like Angela Huyue Zhang has been focused on the tech giants, this article aims to assess China's startups and their relationships with Chinese regulators.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了中国AI初创公司DeepSeek在2025年9月《自然》杂志发表论文披露其模型训练成本仅为29.4万美元，远低于美国AI公司的成本，表明其行业影响力被低估。文章探讨了DeepSeek在中国科技监管整顿后突破垄断格局的意义，以及初创企业与监管机构的关系。
AI.research_question: 中国科技初创企业（特别是AI领域的DeepSeek）与监管机构的关系如何？这些初创企业在监管整顿后的垄断格局中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注科技巨头，而忽视了初创企业在监管环境变化中的角色。DeepSeek以极低的训练成本突破竞争格局，为中国科技行业分析提供了新视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 中国科技监管理论、垄断与竞争理论、初创企业成长理论
AI.method: 案例分析法，以DeepSeek为研究对象，结合监管政策变化和行业竞争格局分析
AI.findings: DeepSeek以29.4万美元的低成本训练模型，打破了国内科技行业的垄断格局；初创企业在监管整顿后获得发展机会，可能改变中国科技行业的竞争生态
AI.theory_contributions: 补充了中国科技监管理论，将研究焦点从科技巨头扩展到初创企业；提出了监管环境变化对初创企业发展的影响机制
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了新的分析视角；揭示了低成本AI技术可能带来的行业变革；为其他初创企业在监管环境中发展提供参考

title: A Broken Pipeline: From School to Nowhere, Rethinking Nigeria's Education-to-Employment Transition
affiliations: University of Abuja, FCT, Nigeria, University of Abuja, FCT, Nigeria, University of Abuja, FCT, Nigeria and Kogi State Polytechnic

detail.title: A Broken Pipeline: From School to Nowhere, Rethinking Nigeria's Education-to-Employment Transition
detail.abstract: Despite its demographic dividend, Nigeria's education system remains critically disconnected from labour market realities, undermining national productivity and youth development. This study employs a qualitative, interpretive approach to examine structural deficiencies in Nigeria's education-to-employment pipeline, drawing on document analysis from primary policy texts, international benchmarks, and labour market data. Key findings identify five systemic failures: an obsolete curriculum, inadequate teacher preparation, fragmented policy implementation, ineffective assessment frameworks, and limited school-to-industry collaboration. Drawing on empirical evidence and comparative insights from Finland, Rwanda, and Singapore, the study advocates a transition to a competency-based education model supported by robust accountability mechanisms and digital infrastructure. The proposed reforms aim to realign Nigeria's education system with contemporary economic demands and global employment trends.

title: Artificial Intelligence Applications and Economic Impacts in Sustainable Agriculture
affiliations: Rutgers Business School - Rutgers University

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence Applications and Economic Impacts in Sustainable Agriculture
detail.abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is transforming agriculture by enabling data-driven decision-making that enhances economic performance and environmental sustainability. Integration of AI with mechanization, digital agriculture, and sensor networks supports precise monitoring and optimization of resources such as water, nutrients, and energy, leading to improved yields and reduced input waste. Machine learning models facilitate accurate yield prediction, early disease detection, and targeted pest and weed management, while computer vision and IoT technologies enable continuous crop monitoring and adaptive interventions. AI-driven supply chain analytics improve market efficiency, price stability, and logistics, minimizing post-harvest losses and supporting food quality assurance. Climate-smart applications of AI contribute to carbon footprint reduction and resilience against environmental variability through predictive analytics and adaptive management strategies. Despite significant benefits, challenges remain in infrastructure gaps, data privacy, and equitable technology access, necessitating inclusive policy frameworks and capacity-building initiatives. Collaborative human-AI systems and fully autonomous farming platforms represent future directions, emphasizing synergy between computational intelligence and human expertise. Global cooperation in data sharing, research, and governance is essential to ensure broad, equitable adoption of AI technologies, advancing sustainable and productive agricultural systems worldwide.

detail.title: Aggregated Compensation Peer Group Disclosure and Managerial Labor Market Competition: A Network Analysis

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Accouting Research Forthcoming

detail.abstract: In this paper, we develop novel measures of managerial labor market classification and competition by constructing networks of compensation benchmarking peers disclosed in proxy statements. These networks represent firms’ relative positions within the managerial labor market. Our classifications strongly predict executive moves across firms, outperforming a comprehensive set of predictors in the literature. Subsequent tests further demonstrate the strength of our methodology in capturing the multidimensional and dynamic features of the managerial labor market. We also validate our competition measures by showing that they are associated with retention tools, such as higher equity pay and longer pay duration. Finally, we apply our measures to test two theoretical predictions. First, we find that labor market competition could explain controversial pay practices. Second, we demonstrate that the labor market provides managers with tournament incentives to deliver superior future performance.

detail.title: Global Economic Crisis and Its Reflection in Kosovo Financial System
detail.abstract: This paper intends to analyse the impact of global economic crisis on the economy of Kosovo with the focus on the impact of crisis on financial system of the country. For the purpose of analysing the global crisis impact on specific sectors of the economy of Kosovo, this paper begins by explain the roots of the global crisis, and the impact of the crisis in the region of Western Balkan by identifying and analysing fluctuations of major macroeconomic indicator of the economy, which is the GDP of Kosovo and Western Balkan countries for comparative analysis. In this regard the paper furthermore analyses the trends of macroeconomics indicators that reflect the development and macroeconomic balances of Kosovo economy in period of 2007-2012, such as GDP, Trade Balance, CPI, Unemployment Rates, Remittances, and FDI. Furthermore, specifically analysis the reflection of global crisis in financial system by analysing the main developments of banking sector and pensions fond as major pillars of financial system .Additionally this paper by considering reports, academic journals, and different studies in view of economic development of Kosovo during the global economic crisis, presents applied fiscal policies of government during that period and the respond of financial system itself toward crisis.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2007-2012年全球经济危机对科索沃经济的影响，特别关注金融系统，通过比较西巴尔干地区的宏观经济指标波动来评估危机影响。

AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观经济理论，包括GDP、贸易平衡、CPI、失业率、汇款和外国直接投资等指标的分析框架。
AI.method: 文献分析，包括报告、学术期刊和不同研究，分析2007-2012年期间科索沃主要宏观经济指标的趋势。

title: The War in Ukraine and its Impact on Global Inflationary Trends and Economic Stability

detail.title: The War in Ukraine and its Impact on Global Inflationary Trends and Economic Stability
detail.abstract:
Inflation is a critical factor in ensuring a country's sustainable economic growth. Generally, the economic aspect of sustainable development encompasses the overall health of an economy. Key macroeconomic indicators, such as unemployment and inflation rates, are crucial for assessing sustainable development.

The ongoing Russia-Ukraine conflict, which began in February 2022, has recently had profound and wide-reaching consequences on the global economy, particularly concerning inflation trends and economic stability. The aim of this paper is to analyze the complex relationship between the conflict and its economic repercussions, focusing on how the war has impacted inflationary pressures in various regions, with particular emphasis on the Western Balkans region. The analysis includes disruptions to global supply chains, volatility in energy and commodity markets, and shifts in international trade dynamics. Using econometric regression models, this study assesses the immediate and long-term impacts of the conflict on inflation rates and economic stability. The findings indicate that the war has exacerbated inflationary trends, with significant increases in the prices of energy, food raw materials, etc. Furthermore, the study highlights how these inflationary pressures have led to broader economic challenges, including reduced purchasing power and increased uncertainty in global markets.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了俄乌冲突对全球通胀的影响，特别关注西巴尔干地区，发现战争加剧了通胀趋势，导致能源和食品价格显著上涨，并引发购买力下降和全球市场不确定性等经济挑战。
AI.research_question: 俄乌冲突如何影响全球通胀趋势和经济稳定？
AI.motivation: 俄乌冲突自2022年2月开始，对全球经济产生了深远影响，特别是在通胀趋势和经济稳定方面。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续经济发展理论，宏观经济指标（失业率和通胀率）作为评估可持续发展的重要指标。
AI.method: 使用计量经济学回归模型分析冲突对通胀率和经济稳定的即时和长期影响。
AI.findings: 战争加剧了通胀趋势，能源和食品原材料等价格显著上涨，这些通胀压力导致了购买力下降和全球市场不确定性等更广泛的经济挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对地缘政治冲突与宏观经济稳定之间关系的理解，特别是在通胀传导机制方面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了关于如何应对地缘政治冲突引发的经济冲击的实证依据，特别是在管理通胀和维护经济稳定方面。

title: "No-Interest" Advertising in High-Interest Loan Markets
affiliations: University of Rochester - Simon Business School, University of Rochester - Simon Business School, University of Houston - C.T. Bauer College of Business and University of California, Berkeley - Haas School of Business

detail.title: "No-Interest" Advertising in High-Interest Loan Markets
detail.abstract: This paper studies how misleading advertising of borrowing cost influences consumer choices in the high-interest short-term loan market. We construct a unique and comprehensive dataset in the online cash advance app market that contains detailed advertising content, mobile app download and usage, apps' actual borrowing costs, and surveyed consumer beliefs. We first show that many high-cost apps increasingly advertise "no interest" over time, despite the misleading nature of such claims. We then demonstrate that "no interest" claims make advertising 9 times more effective in driving existing consumers' continued usage. Our survey results show that such claims lower consumers' perceived borrowing costs and mislead some into believing the cost is zero. We discuss policy implications of our results for financial advertising regulations and suggest that enforcing genuine and transparent advertising could save consumers tens of millions of dollars in financial charges.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，高息短期贷款市场中误导性的"无利息"广告会显著影响消费者选择，使广告效果提升9倍，误导消费者低估借款成本，导致消费者每年多支付数千万美元的财务费用。
AI.research_question: 误导性的借款成本广告如何影响消费者在高息短期贷款市场中的选择？
AI.motivation: 高成本贷款应用越来越多地使用"无利息"等误导性广告，但此类广告对消费者决策的影响尚未得到充分研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者行为理论和广告效果理论，研究误导性广告如何影响消费者的感知和决策。
AI.method: 构建包含广告内容、应用下载使用数据、实际借款成本和消费者调查信念的独特综合数据集，进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 1）许多高成本应用随时间推移越来越多地使用"无利息"广告；2）"无利息"声明使广告效果提升9倍；3）此类声明降低了消费者的感知借款成本，误导部分消费者认为成本为零。
AI.theory_contributions: 为误导性广告在金融产品市场中的影响提供了实证证据，深化了对消费者金融决策偏差的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为金融广告监管提供政策启示，建议强制实施真实透明的广告，可为消费者节省数千万美元的财务费用。

title: The Meta-RCT Approach to Measuring AI's Labor Market Impact
affiliations: University of California Berkeley, Haas School of Business

detail.title: The Meta-RCT Approach to Measuring AI's Labor Market Impact
detail.abstract: How exposed are different occupations to advances in artificial intelligence (AI)? Existing approaches typically infer exposure from patents, expert surveys, or static mappings between AI capabilities and tasks, but each has limitations. I introduce a complementary framework that aggregates evidence from randomized controlled trials (RCTs) in economics and the social sciences, which directly test the causal impact of AI tools on worker performance. Drawing on RCTs across domains such as writing, coding, forecasting, and management, I map their results to O*NET tasks and then aggregate to the occupational level. The outcome is the 'RCT Exposure Index', a novel, empirically grounded measure of AI exposure that captures heterogeneity across tasks and occupations. By anchoring exposure in experimental evidence rather than proxies, the RCT Exposure Index provides a real-time lens on how AI is reshaping the landscape of work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个基于随机对照试验(RCT)的AI暴露指数框架，通过汇总经济学和社会科学中直接测试AI工具对工人绩效因果影响的实验证据，来衡量不同职业对人工智能进展的暴露程度。
AI.research_question: 不同职业对人工智能进展的暴露程度如何？
AI.motivation: 现有的方法通常从专利、专家调查或AI能力与任务的静态映射推断暴露程度，但每种方法都有局限性。需要一种基于实验证据的补充框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于随机对照试验(RCT)的实证框架，将AI工具对工人绩效的因果影响直接映射到职业任务和职业层面。
AI.method: 汇总经济学和社会科学领域的随机对照试验结果，将其映射到O*NET任务，然后在职业层面进行聚合，构建RCT暴露指数。
AI.findings: 开发了RCT暴露指数，这是一个新颖的、基于实证的AI暴露衡量指标，能够捕捉任务和职业间的异质性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个基于实验证据而非代理指标的AI暴露衡量框架，为理解AI如何重塑工作格局提供了实时视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、企业和工人提供了更准确的AI暴露评估工具，有助于应对AI带来的工作变革。

title: The Dynamics of Insurance Sector Development and Economic Growth
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: The Dynamics of Insurance Sector Development and Economic Growth
detail.abstract: Through this paper, we were able to analyze the insurance system in Kosovo by looking at its structure, the degree of concentration of insurance companies in the insurance industry, and the types of products they offer. The analysis was based on statistical and qualitative data through the studies and analysis of insurance industry development in other countries. Furthermore, secondary data from the Central Bank of Kosovo, insurance companies, and the Insurance Association of Kosovo was used for the empirical analysis. Moreover, in order to obtain more data, one survey was conducted. The survey includes a more general audience, specifically employed people. The main research question of this study was whether insurance development has some effect on the financial markets in developing countries. The analysis conducted found that the insurance industry is important for the development of the financial markets in developing countries and also was mentation in research by Cristea, Marcu, and Cârstina (2014). Additionally, the analysis for the case of Kosovo shows that macroeconomic and financial sector-related factors are important drivers for the future development of the insurance industry in Kosovo. Therefore, macroeconomic, institutional, and regulatory environments are crucial for supporting the future growth of the insurance industry in Kosovo.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析科索沃保险系统的结构、保险公司集中度和产品类型，研究了保险发展对发展中国家金融市场的影响。研究发现保险业对发展中国家金融市场发展具有重要作用，科索沃案例表明宏观经济和金融部门因素是保险业未来发展的关键驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 保险发展是否对发展中国家的金融市场产生影响？
AI.motivation: 分析科索沃保险系统的结构、保险公司集中度和产品类型，研究保险业对金融市场发展的作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Cristea、Marcu和Cârstina（2014）的研究，探讨保险业与金融市场发展的理论关系。
AI.method: 使用统计和定性数据分析，包括科索沃中央银行、保险公司和保险协会的二手数据，以及针对就业人群的调查数据。
AI.findings: 保险业对发展中国家金融市场发展具有重要作用；科索沃案例显示宏观经济和金融部门因素是保险业未来发展的关键驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了保险业对发展中国家金融市场发展的理论重要性，支持了现有研究结论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃保险业发展提供政策建议，强调宏观经济、制度和监管环境对保险业增长的重要性。

title: Emergent Adulthood: Review of Literature
affiliations: University of Tasmania, University of Tasmania, , University of Tasmania - Tasmanian School of Business & Economics and University of Tasmania

detail.title: Emergent Adulthood: Review of Literature

declarations.funderStatement: This research was commissioned and supported by the Youth Network of Tasmania (YNOT).

publicationDetails.detailsText: Rudling, E., Shelley, B., Chuah S H., Hoffman n R. Lang, M ( E mergent Adulthood Review of Literature. Hobart: Tasmanian Behaviou ral Lab University of Tasmania

detail.abstract: This paper reviews multidisciplinary literature on emergent adulthood (18–25 years) to inform Tasmanian social policy. Emergent adulthood is marked by ongoing brain maturation, identity exploration, and gradual independence, yet also by vulnerability to precarious work, housing disadvantage, and mental health risks. We synthesise insights from behavioural science, law, economics, and sociology, examining legal, material, and economic markers alongside transition models in education, work, health, and housing. Findings highlight misalignment between structural markers and lived experience, underscoring the need for evidence-based, cross-sectoral policies that recognise emergent adulthood as a distinct life stage.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了关于新兴成年期（18-25岁）的多学科文献，为塔斯马尼亚社会政策提供参考。新兴成年期以持续的大脑发育、身份探索和逐步独立为特征，但也面临不稳定工作、住房劣势和心理健康风险的脆弱性。研究发现结构性标记与生活经验之间存在不匹配，强调需要基于证据的跨部门政策，将新兴成年期视为独特的人生阶段。
AI.research_question: 如何通过多学科视角理解新兴成年期（18-25岁）的特征和挑战，为塔斯马尼亚社会政策提供依据？
AI.motivation: 新兴成年期是一个独特的发展阶段，但现有社会政策往往未能充分认识其特殊性，导致结构性标记与年轻人的实际生活经验之间存在不匹配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新兴成年期理论、多学科整合框架（行为科学、法律、经济学、社会学）、过渡模型理论
AI.method: 多学科文献综述，整合行为科学、法律、经济学和社会学的研究成果
AI.findings: 新兴成年期具有持续大脑发育、身份探索和逐步独立的特征，但年轻人面临不稳定工作、住房劣势和心理健康风险的脆弱性；结构性标记与生活经验存在显著不匹配
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对新兴成年期作为独特人生阶段的理论理解，建立了多学科整合的分析框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为塔斯马尼亚制定基于证据的跨部门社会政策提供具体建议，强调政策需要更好地反映新兴成年期的实际特征和需求

title: Occupational Mediation of Intergenerational Income Mobility
affiliations: UNSW Business School, Reserve Bank of New Zealand, The University of Sydney - School of Economics and University of Queensland

detail.title: Occupational Mediation of Intergenerational Income Mobility
detail.abstract: Using novel administrative data from Australia, we examine the role of the parent's and child's occupational choices in shaping intergenerational income mobility. Applying a multilevel mediation analysis, we show that 38.2% of the intergenerational rank-rank slope is explained by a combination of the child's occupation, college education, and the parent's neighbourhood and occupational choices. Among these channels, both the parent's and the child's cognitive occupations play significant roles, each accounting for roughly one-quarter of the observed persistence. The contribution of the child's college education declines substantially once the parent's cognitive occupation is considered. The parent's cognitive occupation plays a more prominent role in locations with a significant presence of the knowledge economy.

AI.tldr: 使用澳大利亚行政数据，研究发现父母和子女的职业选择在代际收入流动性中起重要作用，其中认知职业是主要中介因素，各解释约四分之一的代际持续性。
AI.research_question: 父母和子女的职业选择在塑造代际收入流动性中扮演什么角色？
AI.motivation: 理解代际收入流动性的机制，特别是职业选择作为中介因素的重要性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代际收入流动性理论，职业选择作为社会流动的中介机制。
AI.method: 使用澳大利亚行政数据，应用多层次中介分析。
AI.findings: 38.2%的代际收入持续性由子女职业、大学教育、父母居住地和职业选择共同解释；父母和子女的认知职业各解释约25%的持续性；父母认知职业在知识经济发达地区作用更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 明确了认知职业在代际收入传递中的核心作用，揭示了职业选择作为重要中介机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育政策和职业发展政策提供依据，强调认知职业发展对促进社会流动的重要性。

title: VAITION: Energy Dualism of Digital Systems

detail.title: VAITION: Energy Dualism of Digital Systems
detail.abstract: This article presents the concept of VAITION (Verified Assessed Intention Time Intellectual Operation Network) as a solution to the fundamental problem of modern digital systems-the absence of energetic dependence on humans. It is shown that contemporary technologies functioning exclusively on electrical energy create a class of "zombie technologies"systems devoid of meaningful connection to human values and potentially uncontrollable. The concept of energy dualism is proposed, where digital systems require two types of energy: functional energy (electrical) for mechanical operation and existential energy (VAIT) for the right to function. VAIT is created exclusively through the transformation of meaningful human activity into digital form. The system solves the problem of lost human vital energy in result-oriented economies and creates architectural guarantees for controlling autonomous systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了VAITION概念，通过能量二元论解决现代数字系统缺乏人类能量依赖的问题，将人类有意义活动转化为数字能量(VAIT)，为自主系统控制提供架构保证。
AI.research_question: 如何解决现代数字系统缺乏人类能量依赖的问题？
AI.motivation: 当代技术仅依赖电能运行，产生了缺乏人类价值连接的"僵尸技术"，存在失控风险。
AI.theoretical_framework: 能量二元论：数字系统需要两种能量 - 功能性能量(电能)用于机械运行，存在性能量(VAIT)用于运行权利。
AI.method: 提出VAITION概念，将有意义的人类活动转化为数字形式的VAIT能量。
AI.findings: VAITION系统能够解决结果导向经济中人类生命能量流失的问题，并为控制自主系统提供架构保证。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了能量二元论和VAITION概念，为数字系统与人类价值的连接提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为控制自主系统提供了可行的架构方案，防止数字系统脱离人类控制。

title: The Impact of the Insurance Market on Economic Growth: Evidence from Developing Countries
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: The Impact of the Insurance Market on Economic Growth: Evidence from Developing Countries
detail.abstract: The purpose of this study is to understand the development and role of the insurance industry in the development of the economic and financial systems in developing countries with a special emphasis on Kosovo. It is the continuation of the preliminary works where for the empirical analysis, secondary data from the relevant institution and the survey were conducted. The survey was conducted with financial managers from all insurance companies in Kosovo. The analysis shows that the insurance industry has an important role in the development of financial markets and therefore has a positive impact on the development of countries. Also, the analysis of the case of the Balkan countries shows that the factors related to the macroeconomic and financial sectors are important drivers for the future development of the insurance industry. It is worth asking: What role does insurance play in economic development? Where, according to the studies by Arena (2008) and Haiss and Sümegi (2008), and also from this research there is ample evidence that insurance contributes significantly to economic development by improving the investment climate and promoting a range of activities. The analysis in Kosovo shows that the insurance market gross written premiums have a positive linkage with the GDP growth of Kosovo. Even though the impact is small, it can increase with the potential growth of the insurance sector in Kosovo.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了保险业在发展中国家经济和金融体系发展中的作用，特别关注科索沃案例。研究发现保险业对金融市场发展有重要贡献，并通过改善投资环境促进经济发展。科索沃的保险市场保费与GDP增长呈正相关。
AI.research_question: 保险业在经济发展中扮演什么角色？特别是在发展中国家如科索沃的经济和金融体系发展中
AI.motivation: 理解保险业在发展中国家经济和金融体系发展中的作用，特别关注科索沃案例，延续前期研究工作
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Arena (2008)和Haiss与Sümegi (2008)的研究，认为保险通过改善投资环境和促进经济活动对经济发展做出重要贡献
AI.method: 使用相关机构的二手数据进行实证分析，并对科索沃所有保险公司的财务经理进行问卷调查
AI.findings: 保险业在金融市场发展中发挥重要作用，对经济发展有积极影响；科索沃保险市场保费与GDP增长呈正相关，尽管影响较小但会随着保险业发展而增加
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了保险业对经济发展的促进作用，特别是在发展中国家背景下，丰富了保险与经济发展关系的理论认识
AI.practical_contributions: 为发展中国家特别是科索沃的保险业发展提供政策参考，强调了宏观经济和金融部门因素对保险业未来发展的重要性

title: Collective Benefits
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt and University of Tübingen - Faculty of Law

detail.title: Collective Benefits
detail.abstract: This article engages with the novel concept of "collective benefits" as introduced by the European Commission in its 2023 Horizontal Guidelines on Article 101 TFEU, where sustainability agreements are, for the first time, dealt with in a dedicated chapter. While the Commission frames the concept as a natural extension of the consumer welfare paradigm, our analysis demonstrates that it constitutes a substantive departure from established competition law. In contrast to the established distinction between use values and non-use values, both of which remain anchored in the consumer's individual willingness to pay, the collective benefits approach presupposes that consumers can express preferences not only with respect to their own consumption but also with respect to the consumption decisions of others, thereby substituting market choice with a form of social choice. We argue that such a substitution, even when couched in the language of willingness to pay, inevitably leads to a normative counterfactual that cannot be reconciled with the basic premises of antitrust analysis.

title: Fintech and Bank Debt in Innovative SMEs: Complementarities and Gender Gaps
affiliations: University of Bologna - School of Economics, Management, and Statistics, University of Florence and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Fintech and Bank Debt in Innovative SMEs: Complementarities and Gender Gaps
detail.abstract: Innovative small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) face persistent obstacles in securing external finance due to high uncertainty, structural opacity, and limited collateral. These frictions constrain bank lending, often curbing the growth of firms at the technological frontier. Financial technology (fintech) has been heralded as a transformative force capable of reducing information asymmetries by converting soft signals of creditworthiness into standardized data that banks can incorporate into lending decisions. Yet, it remains unclear whether fintech adoption systematically enhances bank debt capacity for innovative SMEs and whether it mitigates or amplifies existing gender disparities in credit allocation. This paper addresses these gaps by combining a panel dataset of 1,738 Italian innovative SMEs observed between 2015 and 2023 with a novel province-level index of fintech adoption. Our findings show that fintech diffusion fosters bank borrowing, with effects concentrated in long-term debt, thereby indicating complementarities between digital financial innovation and traditional banking intermediation. However, we also uncover a significant heterogeneity across gender lines: the positive impact of fintech adoption on bank debt is markedly weaker for women-led firms, especially for long-term financing. This evidence suggests that, while fintech enhances the ability of banks to supply patient capital to opaque firms, it may simultaneously reproduce structural biases in digitalized credit environments. Overall, this study advances understanding of how digital transformation reshapes credit allocation to innovative SMEs and underscores the importance of policy interventions aimed at ensuring inclusiveness in fintech-driven financial markets.

detail.abstract: This paper presents the first causal evidence on how banks adjust their voluntary capital buffers (the capital headroom above the required level) in response to changes in capital requirements. Using granular euro area data and exploiting the threshold-based assignment of Other Systemically Important Institution (O-SII) buffers within a regression discontinuity design, we study the liability side of banks’ balance sheets, complementing the asset-focused literature on lending and risk-taking. This allows us to assess whether capital regulation is effective in enhancing bank resilience, arguably its main objective. We find that banks offset about half of higher capital requirements by cutting their voluntary buffers rather than raising new equity. The offsetting effect is more pronounced among banks with weaker balance sheets, particularly those with higher levels of non-performing loans. These results indicate that regulation aimed at strengthening resilience may be only partially effective, as banks use existing voluntary buffers when subject to higher requirements.

detail.abstract: Traditional applied general-equilibrium (AGE) models have always faced trade-offs between analytical and computational tractability and counter-empirical restrictions. One is the assumption of homothetic preferences implying unitary income elasticities of demand, significantly inconsistent with data. Similarly, there is no “choke” income level, below which a certain good is not purchased and there is no choke price above which a good is not purchased, implying no changes in the extensive margin of trade. Here I exploit what I will label a StoneGeary Modified (SGM) formulation. This produces a model in which there are non-unitary income elasticities, choke income levels for some/all goods, and choke prices. The second approach modifies CRIE (constant relative income elasticity) preferences which are preferred for modeling income elasticities, but don’t by themselves permit choke income and prices. While other authors have explored these properties in alternative ways, both my approaches have considerable advantages for high-dimension simulation models in that they retain CES structures and functional forms so that they can slot right into existing modeling formats. They require only small modifications to off-the-shelf cost and expenditure functions, and therefore goods and factor demand functions via Shepard’s lemma. Unobserved parameters can be calibrated from observed data and econometric estimates.

title: Clean Hydrogen Pathways: Expert Projections from Australia and Implications for the World

detail.title: Clean Hydrogen Pathways: Expert Projections from Australia and Implications for the World

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Hydrogen produced from renewable energy sources or with carbon capture and storage is an important pillar for reducing global emissions. Using structured interviews, we collect and analyze expectations of 47 industry, science, and government experts on hydrogen pathways and policy needs in Australia. A detailed picture emerges of expectations for how hydrogen will be produced, traded, or used domestically, including projections of future production cost and quantities. Experts also shared views on key obstacles and factors that could support hydrogen deployment. While a large majority anticipates a transition to renewable hydrogen by 2050, there are some notable divergences in expectations, including among different stakeholder groups and levels of experience. For instance, carbon capture and storage pathways remain contested. While the experts were largely optimistic that technical and environmental barriers could be overcome, the main policy gaps identified relate to regulatory and market uncertainties.

title: The heat is on: Heat stress, productivity and adaptation among firms
affiliations: Independent, Centro Studi Confindustria, International Monetary Fund (IMF) - Research Department and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The heat is on: Heat stress, productivity and adaptation among firms
detail.abstract: This paper examines the impact of heat stress on firm-level labour productivity across 23 advanced economies from 2000 to 2021. Combining high-resolution weather data with balance sheet information, we find that both an increase in the number of high-temperature days and the occurrence of heatwaves lead to reduced labour productivity. This effect is substantial, more pronounced in smaller and less productive firms, and is exacerbated by longer heatwaves, high humidity, and low wind speeds. We find evidence of partial adaptation: firms in warmer climates and those with prior heatwave exposure suffer smaller losses from subsequent temperature extremes. However, the scope of current adaptation remains limited: higher temperatures relative to an already warm average result in more significant productivity losses, and there is no evidence of adaptation to severe extreme temperatures. These results underscore the relevance of both gradual and acute climate impacts for economic performance  and underscore the need for targeted adaptation policies to mitigate the long-term growth impacts of rising temperatures.

AI.tldr: 该研究分析了2000-2021年间23个发达经济体中热应激对企业层面劳动生产率的影响。研究发现高温天数和热浪都会显著降低劳动生产率，这种影响在小企业和低生产率企业中更为明显，且会因热浪持续时间长、高湿度和低风速而加剧。虽然存在部分适应现象，但当前适应能力有限，需要针对性适应政策。

title: Do Economic Principles Explain Orbital Use in Space?
affiliations: University of Colorado at Boulder and Middlebury College

detail.title: Do Economic Principles Explain Orbital Use in Space?
detail.abstract: While the global space economy continues to rapidly grow, and public policy challenges related to satellites and debris in orbit emerge, there is surprisingly little evidence connecting theoretical economic frameworks with observed orbital usage. Using a state-of-the-science integrated assessment model combining economic modeling with physical models of the space environment, we find the observed distribution of satellite orbits is well-explained by profit-maximizing satellite operator behavior.  Furthermore, we find strong evidence that collision risk plays a key deterrence role. Finally, the observed location of the largest satellite constellation, Starlink, is consistent with a sole owner over particularly economically desirable altitudes.

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of Richmond Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: How does the credible announcement of an unconventional monetary policy intervention affect bank lending standards during crises? We use a major central bank announcement, the "whatever it takes" speech of the European Central Bank President that boosted the capital of banks, as a natural experiment. We compare changes in lending standards of subsidiaries of euro area versus other banks in a third country, Mexico. The speech reversed a prior trend of euro area banks augmenting their risk-taking via loan growth, lending rates, and credit risk. Our findings show that policies that amount to capitalization can reduce risk-taking in times of stress, adding a new dimension to the bank capital channel.

title: Comparative Analysis of QE in the U.S. and Japan: Why Inflation Dynamics Differ

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of QE in the U.S. and Japan: Why Inflation Dynamics Differ
detail.abstract: Since 2008, both the United States and Japan have used quantitative easing (QE) as a central tool for monetary stimulus. Yet the outcomes have diverged: the U.S. experienced significant inflationary pressures in the 2020s, while Japan has largely avoided persistent inflation despite decades of QE. This paper examines the structural, institutional, and behavioral differences between the U.S. and Japanese financial systems that explain this divergence. Key factors include: • Differences in Treasury market structures and access for retail investors. • Investor behavior and financial culture in each country. • The role of banking systems, demographics, and savings preferences. • The interaction between QE and fiscal policy.

detail.abstract:
This paper, “Lowering Green Premiums to Zero: Climate Policy, Innovation, and Growth,” examines how governments can accelerate the transition to net-zero emissions while preserving economic growth and fairness. Building on Bill Gates’s framework from How to Avoid a Climate Disaster, the study focuses on reducing “Green Premiums”—the extra cost of clean technologies compared to fossil alternatives.

Using illustrative global data on emissions, temperature anomalies, and technology costs, the analysis shows that while carbon pricing is efficient in theory, it is insufficient in practice. Hard-to-abate sectors such as steel, cement, and aviation face high Green Premiums, requiring targeted innovation, industrial policy, and concessional finance.

The paper concludes that policy mixes combining carbon pricing, innovation support, and equity measures are the most credible pathway to net zero. For low- and middle-income countries, reducing capital costs and ensuring a just transition are essential for aligning climate ambition with economic development.

detail.abstract:
Despite the difficulties we faced, I am happy that the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo managed to achieve its goals this year as well, providing a stable financial system, which not only managed to withstand the unfavourable economic developments in the country, but also to be one of the main pillars of support to businesses and individuals, and thus to the country’s economy.

title: Debt as a Lifeline? Financial Debt and SME Growth During the COVID-19 Pandemic in Europe
affiliations: Università degli Studi della Calabria, University of Messina, University of Messina - Department of Economics and Montpellier Business School

detail.title: Debt as a Lifeline? Financial Debt and SME Growth During the COVID-19 Pandemic in Europe
detail.abstract: This study examines the role of debt financing in the growth of early-stage small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Europe between 2017 and 2024, with a focus on how this relationship evolves over a firm’s life cycle and changes in response to systemic shocks such as the COVID-19 pandemic. Using a large dataset of over 2.6 million firm–year observations, we identify a clear life-cycle pattern: debt supports growth in the initial years but its effectiveness weakens and eventually turns negative as firms mature. Importantly, we find that this relationship is not stable across crises. During COVID-19, the impact of debt on growth became statistically insignificant, likely due to large-scale policy interventions that shielded firms from financial distress. By contrast, during the Global Financial Crisis, debt remained a relevant but increasingly detrimental factor for growth. We also uncover significant cross-country heterogeneity, showing that institutional response capacity plays a moderating role. Stronger, timely government interventions preserved the productivity of debt, whereas weaker responses turned debt into a constraint. Our findings challenge the notion of a structurally fixed debt–growth relationship and demonstrate that the value of debt financing is context-dependent. These results offer insights for policymakers designing crisis response tools and for entrepreneurs evaluating debt as a growth instrument under uncertainty.

AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了债务-增长关系结构固定的观念，证明债务融资价值具有情境依赖性
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者设计危机应对工具和企业家在不确定性下评估债务作为增长工具提供见解

title: Fehmi Mehmeti: The Financial System Proved Capable of Withstanding the Crises Caused by the Pandemic and the War in Ukraine

detail.title: Fehmi Mehmeti: The Financial System Proved Capable of Withstanding the Crises Caused by the Pandemic and the War in Ukraine

keywords: Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (CBK)

detail.abstract:
Fehmi Mehmeti, Governor of the Central Bank of the Republic of Kosovo (CBK), delivered a year-end speech highlighting the resilience of Kosovo's financial system amidst global crises such as the COVID-19 pandemic and the war in Ukraine. ​ Despite challenges like inflation, changing monetary policies, and disrupted supply chains, Kosovo's economy showed slowed GDP growth of 3-4% in 2022, following a strong 10.75% growth in 2021. ​ Key economic indicators included increased remittances (€1 billion, up 5.5%), higher imports (€4.15 billion, up 24.6%), and exports (€688 million, up 27.1%). ​ Foreign direct investments rose to €567 million, driven by real estate investments. ​

The financial system demonstrated stability, with banking sector assets reaching €6.46 billion (up 12.4%) and deposits growing to €5.3 billion (up 14.2%). Nonperforming loans remained low at 2.0%, and the sector maintained high capital adequacy (15.8%) and liquidity levels. ​ Other sectors, including insurance, pensions, and microfinance, also showed growth. ​ Inflation averaged 11.5% in 2022, reflecting global price increases. ​

CBK emphasized consumer protection, financial education, and inter-institutional cooperation for developing new financial segments like the capital market. ​ It also celebrated winning an international arbitration case against Iute Credit and recognized young economists for their research on inflation's impact on trade. ​ Mehmeti concluded with optimism for 2023 and a commitment to economic stability and development.

AI.tldr: 科索沃央行行长年终演讲显示，尽管面临全球危机，科索沃金融系统保持韧性。2022年GDP增长放缓至3-4%，通胀率11.5%，但银行资产、存款、侨汇和外国直接投资均实现增长，不良贷款率维持在低位。
AI.research_question: 科索沃金融系统在全球危机背景下的表现和韧性如何？
AI.motivation: 评估科索沃经济在COVID-19大流行和乌克兰战争等全球危机冲击下的适应能力和稳定性
AI.theoretical_framework: 金融稳定性理论、宏观经济韧性理论
AI.method: 基于科索沃央行年度数据的描述性分析
AI.findings: 科索沃金融系统保持稳定：银行资产增长12.4%至64.6亿欧元，存款增长14.2%至53亿欧元，不良贷款率仅2.0%，资本充足率15.8%，侨汇增长5.5%至10亿欧元，外国直接投资达5.67亿欧元
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了小型开放经济体在全球危机中保持金融稳定的实证案例
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了危机时期维护金融稳定的实践参考，强调了消费者保护、金融教育和机构间合作的重要性

title: Addressing the Alignment Problem in Transportation Policy Making: An LLM Approach
affiliations: Northwestern University, Northwestern University and Northwestern University

detail.title: Addressing the Alignment Problem in Transportation Policy Making: An LLM Approach
detail.abstract: A key challenge in transportation planning is that the collective preferences of heterogeneous travelers often diverge from the policies produced by model-driven decision tools. This misalignment frequently results in implementation delays or failures. Here, we investigate whether large language models (LLMs)-noted for their capabilities in reasoning and simulating human decision-making-can help inform and address this alignment problem. We develop a multi-agent simulation in which LLMs, acting as agents representing residents from different communities in a city, participate in a referendum on a set of transit policy proposals. Using chain-of-thought reasoning, LLM agents provide Ranked-Choice or approval-based preferences, which are aggregated using instant-runoff voting (IRV) to model democratic consensus. We implement this simulation framework with both GPT-4o and Claude-3.5, and apply it for Chicago and Houston. Our findings suggest that LLM agents are capable of approximating plausible collective preferences and responding to local context, while also displaying model-specific behavioral biases and modest divergences from optimization-based benchmarks. These capabilities underscore both promise and limitations of LLMs as tools for solving the alignment problem in transportation decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨大型语言模型（LLMs）能否帮助解决交通规划中集体偏好与模型驱动决策工具之间的对齐问题。通过多智能体模拟，让LLMs代表不同社区居民参与交通政策公投，结果显示LLMs能够近似合理的集体偏好并响应本地情境，但也存在模型特定的行为偏差。
AI.research_question: 大型语言模型（LLMs）能否帮助解决交通规划中集体偏好与模型驱动决策工具之间的对齐问题？
AI.motivation: 交通规划中，异质旅行者的集体偏好往往与模型驱动决策工具产生的政策存在分歧，这经常导致实施延迟或失败。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于LLMs的推理和模拟人类决策能力，使用多智能体模拟框架，结合思维链推理和即时决选投票机制。
AI.method: 开发多智能体模拟，让LLMs（GPT-4o和Claude-3.5）作为代表不同社区居民的智能体，参与交通政策公投，使用排名选择或批准投票偏好，通过即时决选投票聚合民主共识。
AI.findings: LLM智能体能够近似合理的集体偏好并响应本地情境，但也显示出模型特定的行为偏差，与基于优化的基准存在适度差异。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了LLMs作为工具解决交通决策中对齐问题的潜力和局限性，为LLMs在集体决策模拟中的应用提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为交通规划者提供了一种新的方法来理解和预测集体偏好，有助于减少政策实施延迟和失败的风险。

title: Quasi-Correspondent Bank

detail.title: Quasi-Correspondent Bank
detail.abstract: A Quasi-Correspondent Bank is a financial institution that provides limited correspondent banking services within a geography (such as regional or domestic clearing of foreign currency payments), but itself relies on global correspondent banks (e.g., Citi, Bank of New York Mellon) for true access to international clearing and settlement. Unlike full correspondent banks that operate directly at the global clearing level, quasi-correspondents act as intermediary facilitators, giving smaller local banks access to cross-border payment networks through their own correspondent arrangements. Origin of Term: The phrase "Quasi-Correspondent Bank" was coined by Nicola Andrea Anderson of Kingston, Jamaica, on September 11, 2025, to frame the unique role of regional players (such as FCIB in the Caribbean banking ecosystem) that bridge domestic institutions to global correspondent networks. Contextual Note: This definition is intended to clarify the distinction between true correspondent banks, which maintain direct global clearing relationships, and quasi-correspondents, which serve as secondary intermediaries. It provides a framework for regulators, financial institutions, and policymakers to recognize the tiered nature of correspondent banking relationships in regions where access to direct correspondent lines is limited. Timestamp: This document serves as a public record of authorship and definition, suitable for citation in academic, regulatory, or professional contexts. It may be uploaded to platforms such as SSRN or Zenodo to provide a permanent DOI-linked attribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"准代理银行"的概念，指在特定地理区域内提供有限代理银行服务但依赖全球代理银行进行国际清算的金融机构。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和区分准代理银行与传统代理银行在跨境支付网络中的角色？
AI.motivation: 需要澄清区域金融机构在代理银行关系中的独特中介角色，为监管机构和政策制定者提供分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于代理银行理论和跨境支付网络分层结构，构建准代理银行的概念框架。
AI.method: 概念定义和术语创造，通过案例分析（如加勒比地区的FCIB）来阐述概念。
AI.findings: 准代理银行作为二级中介，为当地小型银行提供跨境支付网络接入，但其本身依赖全球代理银行进行国际清算。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"准代理银行"概念，丰富了代理银行理论，提供了分析分层代理银行关系的新框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构、金融机构和政策制定者识别代理银行关系的层级性质提供了实用工具，特别适用于直接代理银行关系有限的地区。

title: “No Woman belongs to Politics”: Gender-Based Hate Speech against Female Politicians in Czech Anti-Establishment Groups on Facebook

detail.title: “No Woman belongs to Politics”: Gender-Based Hate Speech against Female Politicians in Czech Anti-Establishment Groups on Facebook
detail.abstract: This research note presents a mixed-method analysis of gendered hate speech targeting Czech female politicians within 17 Facebook disinformation groups. Findings confirm earlier research that women face disproportionately more gender-based, sexualized, and violent online attacks than men, often initiated by a small number of highly active users, predominantly male. Analysis of hatespeech waves shows that these were frequently fueled by false quotes and media amplification. Twelve recurring categories of gendered attacks were identified. While male politicians are also targeted, attacks against women are more identity focused.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法分析了17个Facebook虚假信息群组中针对捷克女性政治家的性别仇恨言论。研究发现女性比男性面临更多基于性别、性化和暴力的网络攻击，主要由少数高度活跃的男性用户发起。仇恨言论浪潮常由虚假引用和媒体放大推动，识别出12种反复出现的性别攻击类别。
AI.research_question: 捷克女性政治家在Facebook虚假信息群组中面临何种类型的性别仇恨言论？这些攻击如何被发起和放大？
AI.motivation: 女性政治家面临不成比例的在线性别仇恨言论攻击，需要深入了解这些攻击的模式、来源和传播机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 性别政治理论、仇恨言论传播理论、社交媒体影响力理论
AI.method: 混合方法分析，包括定量和定性分析17个Facebook虚假信息群组的内容
AI.findings: 1) 女性面临更多性别化、性化和暴力攻击；2) 攻击主要由少数高度活跃的男性用户发起；3) 仇恨言论浪潮常由虚假引用和媒体放大推动；4) 识别出12种反复出现的性别攻击类别；5) 对女性的攻击更关注身份特征
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了对性别仇恨言论传播机制的理解，揭示了虚假信息和媒体放大在仇恨言论浪潮中的作用
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性干预措施的依据，帮助社交媒体平台改进仇恨言论检测和应对机制

title: Does Import Substitutability Constrain Foreign Policy? Evidence from UNGA Voting During Russia-Ukraine Conflicts
affiliations: Seoul National University, Princeton University and Department of Political Science and International Relations

detail.title: Does Import Substitutability Constrain Foreign Policy? Evidence from UNGA Voting During Russia-Ukraine Conflicts
detail.abstract: This study examines how economic dependencies constrain foreign policy autonomy by analyzing UN General Assembly voting patterns following Russia's 2014 annexation of Crimea and 2022 invasion of Ukraine. Using a novel measure of product-level import substitutability, we decouple genuine economic constraints from underlying factors correlated with UN voting preferences. Our analysis reveals that countries with higher constraint-weighted (i.e., harder-to-replace) import dependence on Russia were significantly more likely to support or abstain on Russia-related votes, with effects intensifying after 2022. Sectoral analysis shows that dependencies on hard-to-substitute products like 'Arms' and 'Cereals' created the strongest diplomatic constraints, while more substitutable 'Mineral Fuels' showed moderate effects despite their economic prominence. The 2022 invasion produced dramatic constraint intensification. These findings demonstrate that product-level substitutability-particularly switching costs and supply concentration-determines when economic ties translate into foreign policy constraints, with arms and specialized agricultural products proving more constraining than energy despite conventional wisdom emphasizing energy leverage.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过分析2014年克里米亚吞并和2022年乌克兰入侵后联合国大会投票模式，发现经济依赖会限制外交政策自主权。使用产品级进口可替代性新指标，研究发现对俄罗斯难以替代的进口依赖（特别是军火和谷物）显著增加了对俄支持或弃权投票的可能性，而传统上认为的能源依赖约束相对较弱。
AI.research_question: 经济依赖如何限制国家的外交政策自主权？具体而言，产品级进口可替代性在多大程度上决定了经济联系转化为外交政策约束的程度？
AI.motivation: 理解经济相互依赖如何影响国家在国际危机中的外交政策选择，特别是要区分真实的经济约束与投票偏好的相关性因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经济相互依赖理论、外交政策自主权理论、进口替代成本理论、供应链集中度理论
AI.method: 使用产品级进口可替代性新指标，分析联合国大会投票模式，比较2014年克里米亚吞并和2022年乌克兰入侵两个时期的数据
AI.findings: 1. 对俄罗斯难以替代的进口依赖显著增加了支持或弃权投票的可能性；2. 军火和谷物等难以替代产品的依赖产生最强外交约束；3. 矿物燃料等可替代性较强的产品约束相对较弱；4. 2022年入侵后约束效应显著增强
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 提出产品级可替代性作为经济依赖转化为外交约束的关键机制；2. 挑战传统智慧，证明军火和专业化农产品比能源更具约束力；3. 识别转换成本和供应集中度作为核心决定因素
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为政策制定者提供评估经济依赖外交风险的工具；2. 帮助识别关键战略产品的依赖风险；3. 为国际贸易和外交政策协调提供实证依据

title: From Market Waste to Green Wealth: Rethinking Kangemi’s Fresh Food Wastage

detail.title: From Market Waste to Green Wealth: Rethinking Kangemi’s Fresh Food Wastage
detail.abstract: Markets across Africa are both food baskets and waste centres. Kangemi, like many urban markets in Kenya, faces the waste management issues of plenty: fresh food comes in, but tons of it end up as waste. This paper reflects on four years of daily observations and proposes circular economy pathways—Black Soldier Fly (BSF) farming, composting into manure, coir (coco-pit) products, and waste-based innovations like mats, baskets, and threads. Using examples from Kenya, Uganda, and Nigeria, as well as global lessons, the paper demonstrates how waste transformation can create green jobs and enhance food security.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了非洲市场的食物浪费问题，提出了通过黑水虻养殖、堆肥、椰壳纤维产品和废弃物创新等循环经济途径，将食物废弃物转化为绿色就业机会和提升粮食安全。
AI.research_question: 如何通过循环经济途径有效管理非洲市场的食物废弃物，并创造绿色就业机会？
AI.motivation: 非洲市场既是食物供应中心也是废弃物中心，面临严重的废弃物管理问题，大量新鲜食物最终成为废弃物。
AI.theoretical_framework: 循环经济理论，强调废弃物资源化和价值链重构。
AI.method: 基于四年的日常观察，结合肯尼亚、乌干达和尼日利亚的案例研究以及全球经验。
AI.findings: 黑水虻养殖、堆肥成肥料、椰壳纤维产品以及废弃物创新（如垫子、篮子和线）等循环经济途径可以有效转化废弃物。
AI.theory_contributions: 为循环经济在发展中国家废弃物管理中的应用提供了实证支持，拓展了循环经济理论在非洲情境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了废弃物转化可以创造绿色就业机会，提升粮食安全，为非洲市场废弃物管理提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Development of the Life Insurance Market in Kosovo
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Development of the Life Insurance Market in Kosovo
detail.abstract: The Kosovo Insurance Market has experienced a relatively positive development over the last decade and has been characterized by ongoing reforms, especially with the new companies by off ering new services. Currently, there are twelve insurance companies operating on the market off ering a variety of products. The supervisory and regulatory institution, the Central Bank of Kosovo, approves the licensing and supervision of insurance companies in the country, based on two laws: 04/L-018 Law on Compulsory Motor Liability Insurances and 05/L-045 Law on Insurances. From the research conducted by the Insurance Association of Kosovo, it has come to the conclusion that both forms of insurance are developed: life insurance and non-life insurance, with the latt er dominating the market. The insurance market in Kosovo today is quite consolidated and has suffi cient fi nancial and professional capacities to provide various insurance coverage to protect citizens and their businesses from diff erent events whether they are natural disasters or insurance on health, life, property, responsibilities, various accidents etc. However, it should be noted that there are still challenges ahead to overcome and achieve even more qualitative services, further enhancement of security off ers and contemporary products, methods and ways forward of management to achieve European standards. Through this study we have come out with exploration to see which factors are aff ecting Kosovo's demand for life insurance and how insurance companies can design policies that address the demands of costumers for life insurance policies? Therefore, we have considered a brief history of the development of the insurance market, the progress of this market during the last decade, especially in voluntary insurance products such as life insurance. Our analysis is gathered on statistical and qualitative data through the study of the theories on life insurance development in other countries. Further, for the empirical analysis, we have used secondary data from Center Bank of Kosovo, Insurance Companies and Association Insurance of Kosovo. Also, we have conducted an interview with a manager of sell and marketing department from insurance company Illyria Life, to try and get a bett er understanding of the issue at hand. The identifi cation of these factors would enable insurance companies to design policies that tackle the demands of consumers for life insurance policies.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了影响科索沃人寿保险需求的因素，以及保险公司如何设计满足客户需求的人寿保险产品。研究发现科索沃保险市场在过去十年发展良好，但仍面临挑战需要克服以达到欧洲标准。
AI.research_question: 哪些因素影响科索沃对人寿保险的需求？保险公司如何设计能够满足客户需求的人寿保险产品？
AI.motivation: 科索沃保险市场在过去十年经历了相对积极的发展，但人寿保险作为自愿保险产品仍有发展空间。识别影响需求的因素有助于保险公司设计更好的产品。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于其他国家人寿保险发展的理论，结合科索沃保险市场的具体特点。
AI.method: 使用科索沃中央银行、保险公司和保险协会的二手数据，并对Illyria Life保险公司的销售和营销部门经理进行访谈。
AI.findings: 科索沃保险市场相对整合，具备足够的财务和专业能力提供各种保险覆盖。非人寿保险在市场中占主导地位。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家保险市场研究提供了实证案例，特别是对影响人寿保险需求因素的识别。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助科索沃保险公司设计更符合客户需求的人寿保险产品，促进市场发展和达到欧洲标准。

title: The L-CAPE Revolution: Redefining Equity Valuation in the Age of Global Monetary Expansion
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: The L-CAPE Revolution: Redefining Equity Valuation in the Age of Global Monetary Expansion

declarations.declarationOfInterest: I have no personal or financial relationships to disclose.
declarations.ethicsApproval: No species on Earth were harmed in the study and publication of this paper.
declarations.funderStatement: I have received no funding of any kind.

detail.abstract:
Traditional equity valuation metrics have become fundamentally flawed in the modern monetary environment. The widely-cited Shiller Cyclically Adjusted Price-to-Earnings (CAPE) ratio, which currently suggests extreme overvaluation in U.S. equities at approximately 38x earnings, fails to account for two critical structural changes: (1) a 4.7x expansion in U.S. M2 money supply since 2000, and (2) a 50% reduction in the number of publicly traded companies over the same period.

This paper introduces the Liquidity-Adjusted CAPE (L-CAPE), a revolutionary valuation framework that adjusts traditional metrics for monetary expansion and equity supply contraction. Under L-CAPE analysis, current U.S. equity markets are not overvalued at 38x earnings, but rather undervalued at an effective 4-8x earnings multiple when properly adjusted for liquidity conditions.

Furthermore, this analysis reveals that synchronized global monetary expansion—with major currencies expanding 3.5-4x over 25 years—creates unprecedented capital flows into U.S. equities, amplifying the liquidity adjustment beyond even the domestic U.S. monetary expansion. The framework provides new insights for investors, policymakers, and academics navigating equity markets in an era of unprecedented monetary expansion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了流动性调整CAPE（L-CAPE）估值框架，通过考虑货币扩张和股票供应收缩来修正传统估值指标。研究发现，在考虑流动性条件后，当前美国股市并非被高估38倍市盈率，而是被低估至有效4-8倍市盈率。
AI.research_question: 传统估值指标（如Shiller CAPE）在现代货币环境下是否仍然有效？如何构建考虑货币扩张和股票供应收缩的新估值框架？
AI.motivation: 传统股票估值指标在现代货币环境中存在根本性缺陷，未能考虑两个关键结构性变化：美国M2货币供应量自2000年以来扩张4.7倍，同时上市公司数量减少50%。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于传统CAPE估值理论，引入货币供应扩张和股票供应收缩的调整因素，构建流动性调整CAPE（L-CAPE）理论框架。
AI.method: 通过量化分析美国M2货币供应扩张（4.7倍）和上市公司数量减少（50%）对估值的影响，构建L-CAPE模型并进行实证分析。
AI.findings: 传统CAPE显示美国股市被高估38倍市盈率，但L-CAPE分析显示在流动性调整后，实际被低估至有效4-8倍市盈率。全球同步货币扩张进一步放大了流动性调整效应。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了第一个系统考虑货币扩张和股票供应收缩的估值框架，修正了传统估值理论在现代货币环境下的适用性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者、政策制定者和学者在货币扩张时代提供新的股票市场分析工具和投资决策依据。

title: The Effects & Impact of Environmental Justice: A Multifaceted Outlook on Environmental Sustainability Affecting Low-Income Residents of the Niger-Delta Region (Nigeria’s Oil-Producing Areas)
affiliations: University of Massachusetts Boston

detail.title: The Effects & Impact of Environmental Justice: A Multifaceted Outlook on Environmental Sustainability Affecting Low-Income Residents of the Niger-Delta Region (Nigeria’s Oil-Producing Areas)
detail.abstract: This paper examines the environmental justice challenges facing low-income residents of Nigeria’s Niger Delta, one of the world’s most resource-rich yet environmentally fragile regions. It explores the consequences of decades of oil exploration and gas flaring, including air and water pollution, biodiversity loss, and declining health outcomes. The analysis situates these impacts within broader debates on environmental justice, governance, and sustainable development. Drawing on case studies and comparative global examples, the paper highlights how weak regulatory enforcement, corporate practices, and systemic exclusion deepen the vulnerability of marginalized communities. It emphasizes the importance of community-driven participation, stronger environmental governance, and diversification of the local economy as pathways to sustainability. Recommendations include reforming outdated laws, separating regulatory functions from corporate interests, and ensuring meaningful community involvement in decision-making. Ultimately, the study underscores the need for a holistic approach that balances economic growth with environmental protection and social equity to advance justice and sustainability in the Niger Delta.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲地区低收入居民面临的环境正义挑战，探讨了数十年石油勘探和天然气燃烧造成的环境破坏、健康影响，并提出了通过社区参与、加强环境治理和经济多元化实现可持续发展的路径。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚尼日尔三角洲地区低收入居民面临的环境正义挑战是什么？如何通过治理改革和社区参与实现可持续发展？
AI.motivation: 尼日尔三角洲作为全球资源最丰富但环境最脆弱的地区之一，长期面临石油勘探和天然气燃烧造成的严重环境破坏，需要研究其环境正义问题并提出解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境正义理论、可持续发展理论、治理理论
AI.method: 案例研究和全球比较分析
AI.findings: 监管执法不力、企业实践和系统性排斥加剧了边缘化社区的脆弱性；环境破坏导致空气和水污染、生物多样性丧失和健康恶化
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了环境正义理论在资源丰富但环境脆弱地区的应用，扩展了可持续发展与治理理论的整合

title: Durability, Essentiality, and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Household Consumption
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Durability, Essentiality, and the Transmission of Monetary Policy to Household Consumption

publicationDetails.journalName: ECB: Working Paper Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: In this paper, we examine how different household consumption items respond to monetary policy shocks in the euro area. Specifically, we classify household consumption along two key dimensions: durability and essentiality. Our findings reveal pronounced heterogeneity in responses across these dimensions. First, durable items are highly sensitive to monetary policy shocks, whereas non-durable items exhibit weaker responses. Second, non-essential items react more strongly than essential items. Finally, we demonstrate that durability and essentiality each independently shape the sensitivity of household consumption to monetary policy shocks, with durable non-essential items being most strongly affected.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了欧元区不同家庭消费项目对货币政策冲击的响应差异，发现耐用消费品和非必需品的响应更强，且耐用性和必需性各自独立影响消费敏感性。
AI.research_question: 欧元区不同家庭消费项目如何对货币政策冲击做出响应？耐用性和必需性如何影响消费敏感性？

AI.method: 实证分析欧元区家庭消费数据，考察不同消费类别对货币政策冲击的响应差异。
AI.findings: 耐用消费品对货币政策冲击高度敏感，非耐用消费品响应较弱；非必需品比必需品响应更强；耐用性和必需性各自独立影响消费敏感性，耐用非必需品受影响最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了消费异质性在货币政策传导中的重要作用，扩展了消费理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为货币政策制定者提供更精准的政策工具设计依据，有助于优化政策传导效果。

title: Do Employers Comply with Pay Transparency Requirements in Job Postings?
affiliations: Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York and Federal Reserve Banks - Federal Reserve Bank of New York

detail.title: Do Employers Comply with Pay Transparency Requirements in Job Postings?

publicationDetails.journalName: Federal Reserve Bank of New York Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Over the past few months, New Jersey and Vermont have joined a growing number of U.S. states in requiring employers to include an estimated salary range in their online job listings. Has this push for greater pay transparency been effective? In this post, we use granular data on U.S. job postings from Lightcast to assess employers’ compliance with these new regulations. Focusing on the jurisdictions that adopted pay transparency laws early on, we find that many employers ignore pay transparency requirements; roughly a quarter of job listings covered by these laws fail to include salary information.

AI.tldr: 本文使用Lightcast的美国职位发布数据评估雇主对薪酬透明度法规的遵守情况，发现在早期采用薪酬透明度法律的司法管辖区，约四分之一的职位列表未能包含薪酬信息。
AI.research_question: 美国各州推动的薪酬透明度法规是否有效？雇主对这些新法规的遵守程度如何？
AI.motivation: 新泽西州和佛蒙特州等越来越多的美国州要求雇主在在线职位列表中包含估计的薪酬范围，需要评估这些薪酬透明度法规的实际效果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 薪酬透明度法规执行理论、雇主合规行为理论
AI.method: 使用Lightcast提供的美国职位发布细粒度数据进行分析
