title: Does Climate Change Concern Lead to Greenium?
affiliations: Goethe University Frankfurt

detail.title: Does Climate Change Concern Lead to Greenium?

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper was written as a part of my doctoral thesis

detail.abstract: To date the (non-)presence of green bond premium (i.e., greenium) has been debated. It is still unclear, however, how broadly and genuinely the notion of climate change is perceived by investors and urges them to mitigate its risk and uncertainty through green investments-a likely effective channel of greenium. To this end, I draw on the data from the US municipal bond market, which is largely populated by retail investors and segmented by states due to heterogeneous tax exemptions. I take a model-free matching approach and construct a matched bond data set to conduct a series of descriptive analyses. I find substantially higher demands for green munis in some states, which may point to the serious concern about human-induced climate change as well as to a call for environmental sustainability. Exploiting a quasi-experimental design based on natural disasters, the future agenda is to examine the degree to which an exogenous disaster-induced change in individual preferences for climate risk-as opposed to the level, which has been the focal point in extant research-leads to more demand for green bonds (relative to brown bonds).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了绿色债券溢价（greenium）的存在性，通过美国市政债券市场数据，采用模型无关的匹配方法分析投资者对气候变化的认知如何影响绿色债券需求。研究发现某些州对绿色市政债券需求显著更高，表明投资者对人为气候变化的关注。未来研究计划利用自然灾害作为准实验，考察外生冲击下个体偏好变化对绿色债券需求的影响。
AI.research_question: 投资者对气候变化的认知程度如何影响绿色债券溢价（greenium）的存在？
AI.motivation: 目前关于绿色债券溢价的存在性仍存争议，尚不清楚投资者对气候变化的认知广度与真实性如何促使他们通过绿色投资来缓解气候风险和不确定性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于投资者行为理论和气候风险认知理论，探讨个体投资者对气候变化的感知如何影响投资决策。
AI.method: 采用模型无关的匹配方法，构建匹配债券数据集，利用美国市政债券市场数据进行描述性分析。
AI.findings: 发现某些州对绿色市政债券的需求显著更高，这可能反映了投资者对人为气候变化的严重关切以及对环境可持续性的呼吁。
AI.theory_contributions: 从投资者偏好变化角度深化了对绿色债券溢价形成机制的理解，强调了气候变化认知在投资决策中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了关于绿色债券需求驱动因素的实证证据，有助于设计更有效的绿色金融政策。

title: Evolution and Theoretical Implications of the Utility Concept
affiliations: University of Milano - Bicocca - Department of Business and Law, Università degli Studi di Milano-Bicocca - Department of Business Administration, Finance, Management and Law and University of Milano - Bicocca - Department of Business and Law

detail.title: Evolution and Theoretical Implications of the Utility Concept

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding

detail.abstract: We review the evolution of the concept of utility in economics, addressing the conceptual and terminological fragmentation that characterises the interdisciplinary debate. This study adopts the scoping review framework to systematically analyse the main theoretical approaches, ranging from utility as preference to utility as subjective satisfaction and wellbeing. Particular attention is paid to procedural utility, i.e., the utility derived from the way decisions are made and interactions develop, divided into three areas: individual, linked to autonomy and self-determination; interpersonal, related to the quality of social relations; and institutional, referring to participation and recognition. The analysis is based on three aspects: (i) how different theoretical traditions have interpreted utility and well-being; (ii) what convergences and divergences emerge in the contemporary literature; (iii) and what implications these factors have for research and public policy. We highlight the complementarity between approaches and suggest extending economic reflection to dimensions that are central to the well-being of individuals and societies. The insights of this study have public policy implications, indicating that, through well-defined institutions, distributive justice, and welfare systems, taxpayers' hedonic utility can be transformed into the chrematistic utility of beneficiaries.

AI.tldr: 本文回顾了经济学中效用概念的演变，分析了从偏好到主观满意度和幸福感的多种理论路径，特别关注程序性效用（个体、人际和制度层面），并探讨了其对研究和公共政策的启示。
AI.research_question: 经济学中效用概念如何演变？不同理论传统如何解释效用和幸福感？当代文献中存在哪些趋同和分歧？这些因素对研究和公共政策有何启示？
AI.motivation: 解决跨学科辩论中存在的概念和术语碎片化问题，系统分析效用概念的理论发展路径。
AI.theoretical_framework: 效用理论、程序性效用理论（个体层面：自主性和自决；人际层面：社会关系质量；制度层面：参与和认可）、主观幸福感理论
AI.method: 范围综述框架，系统分析主要理论方法
AI.findings: 揭示了不同理论方法之间的互补性，程序性效用包含三个关键维度，效用概念从纯粹经济维度扩展到更广泛的社会心理维度
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了效用概念的综合框架，强调了程序性效用的重要性，扩展了经济学对个体和社会幸福感的理解
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共政策提供启示，表明通过制度设计、分配正义和福利系统，可以将纳税人的享乐效用转化为受益人的货币效用

reference: The Regulation of Data Sharing in Europe: A Critical Assessment of Regulatory Frameworks, Routledge (2025), https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003248255
title: The Interplay of Data Protection, Competition Law, IP Law and Data Sharing
affiliations: University of Brescia and University of Warsaw, Faculty of Management

detail.title: The Interplay of Data Protection, Competition Law, IP Law and Data Sharing

publicationDetails.detailsText: The Regulation of Data Sharing in Europe: A Critical Assessment of Regulatory Frameworks, Routledge (2025), https://doi.org/10.4324/9781003248255

detail.abstract: The conclusive chapter of book 'Data Sharing Regulation in Europe' (Routledge 2025, eds L. Zoboli, M. Bernatt) delves into the complex relationships between data protection, competition law and IP rights, analyzing how these legal frameworks can be harmonized with pro-data sharing regulation to promote the advancement of the EU data economy. In doing so, the chapter explores the challenges and opportunities presented by these regulatory areas and proposes strategies for balancing innovation, competition and privacy while facilitating data sharing. In particular, the chapter assesses limitations imposed by IP, competition and data protection laws and names on this basis specific limitations principles which govern data-sharing. At the same time, the chapter explains how IP, competition and data protection laws may reinforce data sharing. In this respect, it names the fostering principles which govern data-sharing. On top of this, the chapter discusses the coherence of the EU data law which aims to promote data sharing, including the Data Act, the DMA, the DGA, the GDPR, the Open Data Directive and the Regulation on the Free Flow of Non-Personal Data. The chapter identifies critical gaps in the regulatory framework and proposes strategies for creating a more balanced and coherent approach to data sharing. The chapter highlights the importance of aligning regulatory frameworks to support data-driven innovation while safeguarding privacy, promoting competition and respecting IP protections. The development of Common European Data Spaces represents a promising approach to harmonizing these frameworks and addressing the challenges faced by businesses in the digital age.

AI.tldr: 本章探讨欧盟数据保护、竞争法和知识产权法之间的复杂关系，分析如何协调这些法律框架与支持数据共享的法规，以促进欧盟数据经济发展。提出了平衡创新、竞争和隐私的策略，识别了监管框架中的关键差距，并建议创建更平衡和一致的数据共享方法。
AI.research_question: 如何协调数据保护、竞争法和知识产权法，以促进欧盟数据经济发展？
AI.motivation: 欧盟数据经济发展面临数据保护、竞争法和知识产权法之间的冲突与协调挑战，需要建立平衡创新、竞争和隐私的监管框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据保护法、竞争法、知识产权法、数据共享监管框架、欧盟数据法律体系（包括《数据法》、《数字市场法》、《数据治理法》、《通用数据保护条例》、《开放数据指令》和《非个人数据自由流动条例》）。
AI.method: 法律框架分析、监管协调性评估、原则识别和策略建议。
AI.findings: 识别了数据共享的限制原则和促进原则，发现了欧盟数据法律体系中的关键监管差距，提出了协调不同法律框架的策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了数据共享的限制原则和促进原则的理论框架，为协调数据保护、竞争法和知识产权法提供了理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了创建平衡和一致数据共享方法的策略建议，支持欧洲共同数据空间的发展，帮助企业应对数字时代的挑战。

title: Optimal Path for Orbital Debris
affiliations: University of Malaga and University of Malaga

detail.title: Optimal Path for Orbital Debris
detail.abstract: This paper introduces the DISE-2024 (Dynamic Integrated Space Economy) model, an integrated assessment model (IAM) designed to analyze the economics of efficient mitigation policies for orbital debris in the long-run at a global scale. The DISE-2024 model integrates an optimal neoclassical economic growth framework with a physical model of the Earth's orbital environment, capturing the dynamics of orbital debris and the likelihood of collisions. The economic component of the model determines the optimal consumption path and investments across two capital assets: Earth capital and space capital (i.e., satellites). The physical component models the endogenous generation of orbital debris, accounting for factors such as launch activity, in-orbit breakups, and collisions. The model is simulated over a 200-year horizon under various policy scenarios, including no intervention, de-orbiting policy, no breakups, reusable launch vehicles, debris-free launch systems, collision avoidance, and the European Space Agency's (ESA) zero debris policy. A key finding of the study is that mitigation policies targeting debris emissions alone have a limited impact on reducing the long-term accumulation of orbital debris. Only scenarios involving complete collision avoidance can prevent the catastrophic chain reaction predicted by Kessler syndrome.

AI.tldr: DISE-2024模型结合经济增长与轨道环境物理模型，分析轨道碎片减缓政策。研究发现仅针对碎片排放的政策效果有限，只有完全避免碰撞才能防止凯斯勒综合征的灾难性连锁反应。
AI.research_question: 如何通过有效的减缓政策来长期控制全球轨道碎片的积累？
AI.motivation: 轨道碎片日益增多威胁太空活动的可持续性，需要评估不同政策对长期碎片积累的影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优新古典经济增长框架与地球轨道环境物理模型的整合
AI.method: 开发DISE-2024综合评估模型，模拟200年内不同政策情景
AI.findings: 仅针对碎片排放的政策对减少长期碎片积累效果有限，只有完全碰撞避免才能防止凯斯勒综合征
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了首个整合经济增长与轨道物理学的综合评估模型框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了不同减缓政策效果的定量评估，强调碰撞避免的重要性

title: Salah Bey (1771–1792): From Cobbler to Governor of the Eastern Beylik

detail.title: Salah Bey (1771–1792): From Cobbler to Governor of the Eastern Beylik
detail.abstract: This article examines the life and rule of Salah Bey of Constantine (1771-1792), one of the most prominent Ottoman governors in Algeria. Relying on both Ottoman archival sources and oral traditions, the study explores his origins, reforms in urban policy, education, and trade regulation, and the opposition that culminated in his assassination. The analysis highlights the tension between reformist governance and entrenched socio-political structures, while also assessing Salah Bey's enduring cultural legacy in Eastern Algeria through architecture, oral poetry, and collective memory.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了阿尔及利亚康斯坦丁的萨拉赫贝伊（1771-1792）的生平与统治，探讨其改革政策、面临的反对以及文化影响。
AI.research_question: 萨拉赫贝伊作为奥斯曼帝国在阿尔及利亚的重要总督，其改革政策如何与当地社会政治结构产生张力，以及他的文化影响如何延续至今？
AI.motivation: 研究萨拉赫贝伊的统治，有助于理解奥斯曼帝国晚期在阿尔及利亚的治理模式、改革与地方传统之间的冲突，以及历史人物在集体记忆中的塑造过程。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合历史学、政治学和文化记忆理论，分析改革主义治理与地方社会结构之间的张力，以及历史人物在集体记忆中的建构。
AI.method: 利用奥斯曼档案资料和口头传统，进行历史文献分析和口述史研究。
AI.findings: 萨拉赫贝伊在城市建设、教育和贸易方面推行改革，但遭到地方势力的反对，最终被暗杀；他的文化影响通过建筑、口头诗歌和集体记忆在阿尔及利亚东部持续存在。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对奥斯曼帝国晚期地方治理中改革与保守力量冲突的理解，丰富了历史人物在集体记忆中的研究视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿尔及利亚地方史研究提供了重要案例，对理解当代阿尔及利亚社会文化传统的历史根源具有参考价值。

title: Financial Covenants, Firm Financing, and Investment
affiliations: University of St. Gallen - School of Finance

detail.title: Financial Covenants, Firm Financing, and Investment
detail.abstract: This paper studies how financial covenants influence firm investment. I develop a structural model incorporating covenants and find that they allow for 4.7% higher aggregate investment relative to a no-covenants baseline. While covenants are beneficial overall, the model also reveals costs for firms attempting to avoid covenant violations. In two model applications, I find that, first, the transmission of aggregate shocks to firm financing crucially depends on firms' efforts to avoid covenant violations. Second, the model shows that earnings covenants allow for higher investment in industries with low asset pledgeability but offer no advantage when assets can be easily pledged.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了财务契约如何影响企业投资。通过构建包含契约的结构模型，发现相对于无契约基准，契约能使总投资提高4.7%。虽然契约总体有益，但模型也揭示了企业为避免违约而付出的成本。在模型应用中，发现：1）总体冲击向企业融资的传导关键取决于企业避免违约的努力；2）在资产可抵押性低的行业中，收益契约能支持更高投资，但在资产易于抵押时无优势。
AI.research_question: 财务契约如何影响企业投资？
AI.motivation: 研究财务契约对企业投资的影响机制，分析契约在总体投资提升和企业避免违约成本之间的权衡。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于结构模型理论，将财务契约纳入企业投资决策框架，分析契约对投资效率和风险传导的影响。
AI.method: 构建包含财务契约的结构模型，通过模型模拟和比较分析，评估契约对投资的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 财务契约使总投资提高4.7%；2. 企业为避免违约付出额外成本；3. 总体冲击传导取决于企业避免违约努力；4. 收益契约在低资产可抵押性行业更有效。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 建立了包含财务契约的企业投资结构模型；2. 揭示了契约对投资效率的双重影响机制；3. 阐明了契约在风险传导中的作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为金融机构设计契约条款提供理论依据；2. 帮助企业理解契约对投资决策的影响；3. 为监管机构评估契约政策效果提供参考。

title: CBDC Design in General Equilibrium: Closed-Form Adoption Thresholds and Welfare Decomposition
affiliations: Bharatiya Vidya Bhavan - S.P. Jain Institute of Management & Research (SPJIMR) and S.P Jain Institute of Management and Research

detail.title: CBDC Design in General Equilibrium: Closed-Form Adoption Thresholds and Welfare Decomposition
detail.abstract: We develop the first analytically tractable heterogeneous-agent general equilibrium model of central bank digital currency (CBDC). Households choose between cash, deposits, and CBDC based on transaction costs, liquidity services, and heterogeneous digital payment preferences, while banks transform deposits into loans subject to reserve requirements and intermediation costs. The model admits closed-form CBDC adoption thresholds and an exact welfare decomposition into three components: payment-system efficiency, distributional effects at the adoption margin, and intermediation losses from deposit substitution. We prove existence and uniqueness of equilibrium, show that the welfare decomposition tracks steady-state welfare with deviations below numerical rounding error, and provide a microfoundation for the intermediation wedge. In calibrations to ECB, BIS, and FDIC data, efficiency gains dominate under baseline parameters, making a zero spread welfare-maximizing; when intermediation frictions are stronger, the ranking reverses and high spreads or binding caps become optimal. Using spreads and caps as policy instruments, we show they act as strategic substitutes. The closed-form structure enables policymakers to map adoption elasticities and banking responses directly into welfare without relying on simulation, providing a transparent analytical benchmark for CBDC design, yielding ordinal welfare rankings and explicit policy trade-offs.

AI.tldr: 该论文开发了首个可解析处理的异质代理人一般均衡模型来分析央行数字货币（CBDC）。模型显示CBDC福利效应包含三个组成部分：支付系统效率、采用边际的分配效应和存款替代带来的中介损失。在基准参数下效率收益占主导，但当中介摩擦较强时，高利差或约束上限成为最优选择。
AI.research_question: 央行数字货币（CBDC）如何影响经济福利？CBDC的最优设计（利差和上限）是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有CBDC研究缺乏可解析处理的一般均衡模型，无法提供透明的政策分析框架。需要开发一个能够明确量化CBDC福利效应和政策权衡的模型。
AI.theoretical_framework: 异质代理人一般均衡模型，包含家庭在现金、存款和CBDC之间的选择，以及银行在储备要求和中介成本约束下的存款转贷款行为。
AI.method: 构建可解析处理的理论模型，证明均衡存在性和唯一性，提供福利分解的微观基础，并使用ECB、BIS和FDIC数据进行校准分析。
AI.findings: CBDC福利由支付效率、分配效应和中介损失三部分组成；在基准参数下效率收益主导，零利差最优；当中介摩擦强时，高利差或约束上限最优；利差和上限是战略替代品。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了首个可解析处理的CBDC异质代理人一般均衡模型；证明了均衡存在性和唯一性；建立了福利分解的微观基础；阐明了中介楔子的微观基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了透明分析框架，可直接将采用弹性和银行反应映射到福利，无需依赖模拟；提供了明确的政策权衡和序数福利排序；指导CBDC最优设计。

title: Balancing Equity, Efficiency, and Stability Designing Permit Trading Schemes for Sustainable Climate Cooperation
affiliations: HSE University and KU Leuven

detail.title: Balancing Equity, Efficiency, and Stability Designing Permit Trading Schemes for Sustainable Climate Cooperation
detail.abstract: This paper demonstrates how emission permit trading systems, with strategically designed initial allocations, can simultaneously balance the competing goals of economic efficiency, distributional equity, and coalition stability. We develop a novel theoretical framework that embeds participation constraints into the welfare optimization problem, ensuring countries voluntarily join a coalition. Using numerical simulation results of a RICE type of integrated assessment model, including climate-induced capital depreciation and total factor productivity growth losses, we determine welfare maximizing initial allocations of permits that address participation constraints and equity concerns. Our findings demonstrate that carefully designed permit allocations can sustain stable international cooperation while preserving climate ambitions. The welfare maximizing permit allocations exhibit a distinct temporal pattern directing permits earlier in time to vulnerable, low-income regions (notably Africa) and later to wealthier regions.

AI.tldr: 本文展示了通过战略设计的初始排放权分配，排放权交易系统可以同时平衡经济效率、分配公平和联盟稳定这三个竞争目标。我们开发了一个将参与约束嵌入福利优化问题的新理论框架，确保各国自愿加入联盟。通过RICE类型综合评估模型的数值模拟，确定了能解决参与约束和公平关切的福利最大化初始排放权分配。研究发现精心设计的排放权分配可以在保持气候雄心的同时维持稳定的国际合作。
AI.research_question: 如何通过战略设计的初始排放权分配来同时实现经济效率、分配公平和联盟稳定？
AI.motivation: 平衡经济效率、分配公平和联盟稳定这三个竞争目标在国际气候合作中具有挑战性，需要开发新的理论框架来解决这一问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将参与约束嵌入福利优化问题的新理论框架，确保各国自愿加入联盟。
AI.method: 使用RICE类型综合评估模型的数值模拟，包括气候引起的资本折旧和全要素生产率增长损失。
AI.findings: 精心设计的排放权分配可以维持稳定的国际合作同时保持气候雄心；福利最大化的排放权分配呈现明显的时间模式：早期将排放权分配给脆弱低收入地区（特别是非洲），后期分配给富裕地区。
AI.theory_contributions: 开发了将参与约束嵌入福利优化问题的新理论框架，为国际气候合作提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的排放权分配策略，能够在保持气候雄心的同时促进国际合作和公平分配。

title: Environmental regulation, markup, and price: Evidence from China's paper industry
affiliations: Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU), Antai College of Economics and Management, Students, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and Shanghai Jiao Tong University (SJTU) - Antai College of Economics and Management

detail.title: Environmental regulation, markup, and price: Evidence from China's paper industry
detail.abstract: We examine the impacts of environmental regulation on market power and price, with a case study of China’s water pollutant regulation in the paper industry. We find that the regulation reduces market competition thus enables surviving firms to acquire more market demand. The rising market power and therefore markup, together with increased marginal cost caused by the regulation, result in higher prices charged by surviving firms. The findings of this paper therefore highlight the importance of studying the welfare impact of environmental regulations on the consumer side.

AI.tldr: 研究中国造纸业水污染物监管对环境法规的影响，发现监管降低了市场竞争，使存活企业获得更多市场份额，导致价格上涨。
AI.research_question: 环境监管如何影响市场力量和价格？
AI.motivation: 研究环境监管对消费者福利的影响，特别是在监管可能导致市场集中度增加和价格上涨的情况下。
AI.theoretical_framework: 环境经济学、产业组织理论、市场力量理论
AI.method: 案例研究法，以中国造纸业水污染物监管为研究对象
AI.findings: 环境监管减少市场竞争，使存活企业获得更多市场需求；市场力量和加成率上升，加上监管导致的边际成本增加，共同导致价格上涨。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了环境监管通过市场力量渠道对价格的影响机制，丰富了环境监管经济效应的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒政策制定者关注环境监管对消费者福利的潜在负面影响，建议在制定环境政策时考虑市场竞争和价格效应。

title: A text time-series model for candidates' rhetoric during the 2020 US presidential elections: are VPs coming out of the shadows?
affiliations: Université Paris III - Sorbonne Nouvelle, France, Centre National de la Recherche Scientifique, University of California Santa Barbara and Université Paris III - Sorbonne Nouvelle, France

detail.title: A text time-series model for candidates' rhetoric during the 2020 US presidential elections: are VPs coming out of the shadows?
detail.abstract: The desire for a stable, "homogeneous people" is at the centre of the republican project of the United States (Claybourn, 2019). In a country that originally "lacked nearly all of the symbols of a real nation" (Claybourn, 2019), the sense of commonality at the base of "nationhood" is fluctuating (Claybourn, 2019). Therefore, the very definition of the notion of "people" and how it is conveyed through speeches of both the presidential candidate and the vice-presidential partner is one of the main stakes of a presidential campaign. We employ a stochastic time-series model for text data (Chalkiadakis et al., 2020) to analyse the discourse of the Republican and Democratic tickets running for the 2020 election. We aim to obtain an insight into the instrumentalisation of the notion of "people" by the two campaigns, aiming to better understand the evolution of the political landscape in the US in recent years. First, following the method of Albalat-Mascarell (2019) for rhetorical analysis, we describe the "sociocultural context" and the "generic context" of the emergence of discourse. The former is composed of the "prediscursive" components of the discursive instance (the ethos of the orator, its campaign strategy and the evolution of the race), while the latter comprises the modalities of the enunciation scene during an American political campaign. Second, we extract statistical traits from candidates' speeches to obtain a signature of the notion of "American people" per candidate. We obtain this statistical time-varying signature by focusing on the evolution, over the speeches delivered during the campaign, of discourse terms that characterise the three "modes of emergence of the people" developed by political philosopher Pierre Rosanvallon: the "social people", the "electoral people" and the "voters", and the "people principle".

AI.tldr: 本文使用随机时间序列模型分析2020年美国总统选举中共和党和民主党候选人的演讲，探讨"人民"概念在政治竞选中的工具化使用，以及美国政治格局的演变。
AI.research_question: 两党竞选团队如何通过演讲工具化"人民"概念？
AI.motivation: 美国作为一个缺乏传统民族象征的国家，"人民"的定义和表达方式在总统竞选中具有重要意义，反映了国家认同的流动性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Pierre Rosanvallon的人民出现模式理论（社会人民、选举人民和选民、人民原则），Albalat-Mascarell的修辞分析方法。
AI.method: 使用随机时间序列模型分析文本数据，结合修辞分析方法描述社会文化背景和通用背景，提取演讲中的统计特征。
AI.findings: 通过分析候选人演讲中"人民"概念的时间变化特征，揭示了不同竞选团队对人民概念的工具化使用策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了Rosanvallon人民理论在政治传播研究中的应用，提供了分析政治话语中人民概念演变的实证方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为理解美国政治竞选策略和人民概念的工具化使用提供了分析框架，有助于洞察当代美国政治格局的演变。

title: How Do Smallholder Farmers Adapt to Water Scarcity? Evidence from the Three Gorges Dam
affiliations: Hong Kong Baptist University, Peking University and Jinan University

detail.title: How Do Smallholder Farmers Adapt to Water Scarcity? Evidence from the Three Gorges Dam
detail.abstract: We use the initial impoundment of the world's largest hydroelectric dam as a natural experiment to assess how dam-induced seasonal water scarcity was met with heterogeneous responses from households of varying endowments. In response to a persistent 12% reduction in rice yields, the wealthier households (measured by the size of farmland or bank deposits prior to the dam) compensated by increasing the labor days devoted to non-agricultural activities through out-migration, whereas the poor households increased the acreage of rice cultivation. Our study confirms that one major obstacle for farmers to choose the more effective adaptation strategy is the wealth constraint.

AI.tldr: 本文利用世界最大水电站大坝首次蓄水的自然实验，研究不同禀赋家庭如何应对大坝引起的季节性水资源短缺。研究发现，面对水稻产量持续下降12%，富裕家庭通过外出务工增加非农劳动天数来补偿，而贫困家庭则扩大水稻种植面积。研究证实财富约束是农民选择更有效适应策略的主要障碍。
AI.research_question: 不同禀赋的家庭如何应对大坝引起的季节性水资源短缺？
AI.motivation: 利用世界最大水电站大坝首次蓄水作为自然实验，评估大坝引起的季节性水资源短缺对不同禀赋家庭的影响和适应策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于自然资源管理和适应策略理论，关注财富约束对适应策略选择的影响。
AI.method: 自然实验方法，利用大坝首次蓄水作为外生冲击，分析不同财富水平家庭的应对策略。
AI.findings: 面对水稻产量下降12%，富裕家庭增加非农劳动天数，贫困家庭扩大水稻种植面积。富裕家庭选择更有效的适应策略。
AI.theory_contributions: 证实财富约束是影响适应策略选择的关键因素，丰富了环境冲击下家庭决策的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供针对性建议，帮助贫困家庭克服财富约束，选择更有效的适应策略。

title: From Welfare to Desire: Social Democracy, Market Socialism, and Pathways Toward a Post-Spectacular Society

detail.title: From Welfare to Desire: Social Democracy, Market Socialism, and Pathways Toward a Post-Spectacular Society
detail.abstract:
This article explores the possibility that institutional traditions like social democracy
and market socialism can act as pathways toward certain emancipatory goals
articulated by the Situationist International (SI). While the SI explicitly rejected institutional
politics and promoted the radical transformation of everyday life in the face of
the ’society of the spectacle’ (Debord, 1967), their critique of alienated labor, commodified
urban space, and forms of mass consumption resonates with contemporary debates
on universal basic income, the reduction of the working day, participatory urbanism,
and the cooperative management of strategic resources (Weeks, 2011; Buch-Hansen
and Koch, 2018; Bauwens et al., 2019).
The article develops a conceptual framework that translates Situationist conceptssuch
as drive, dtournement, decommodification, autonomy, and spatial reappropriationinto
analytical categories that are evaluable for concrete reforms. Through empirical case
studies on the reduction of the working day in Iceland and cooperative development in
Mondragn, we examine both the conditions that enable material and cultural emancipation
and the risks of co-optation, bureaucratization, and reproduction of the spectacle
(Berg et al., 2021; Restakis, 2010).
The findings suggest that certain social democratic and market socialist reforms
can generate conditions of possibility for a post-spectacular society, fostering collective
capacity, creativity, and political participation, as long as they are articulated with
broader social movements and are designed as non-reformist reforms that challenge
the dominant logic rather than merely improving existing conditions. This approach
contributes to the literature on applied Situationist praxis and offers a methodological
framework for evaluating the transformative potential of institutional interventions in
advanced capitalist contexts.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社会民主和市场社会主义等制度传统能否作为实现情境主义国际解放目标的途径。研究发现，某些社会民主和市场社会主义改革能够为后景观社会创造可能性条件，前提是这些改革与社会运动结合，并设计成挑战主导逻辑的非改良主义改革。
AI.research_question: 社会民主和市场社会主义等制度传统能否作为实现情境主义国际解放目标的途径？
AI.motivation: 情境主义国际明确拒绝制度政治，但其对异化劳动、商品化城市空间和大众消费形式的批判与当代关于全民基本收入、缩短工作日、参与式城市主义和合作资源管理的辩论产生共鸣。
AI.theoretical_framework: 情境主义概念框架：驱力、转向、去商品化、自主性和空间重新占用，将其转化为可评估具体改革的分析范畴。
AI.method: 概念框架开发和实证案例研究，包括冰岛缩短工作日和蒙德拉贡合作发展的案例。
AI.findings: 某些社会民主和市场社会主义改革能够为后景观社会创造可能性条件，促进集体能力、创造力和政治参与，前提是这些改革与社会运动结合，并设计成挑战主导逻辑的非改良主义改革。
AI.theory_contributions: 为应用情境主义实践文献做出贡献，提供评估先进资本主义背景下制度干预变革潜力的方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供评估具体改革变革潜力的分析工具，识别可能实现物质和文化解放的条件，以及被收编、官僚化和景观再生产的风险。

title: Drawing the Line Between Unacceptable Audit Failure and Acceptable Audit Failure: For Building a Just Culture in a Financial Statement Audit
affiliations: Aichi University

detail.title: Drawing the Line Between Unacceptable Audit Failure and Acceptable Audit Failure: For Building a Just Culture in a Financial Statement Audit

keywords: Audit Failure in a Broad Sense
Just Culture in a Financial Statement Audit

detail.abstract:
The purpose of this paper is to examine unacceptable and acceptable audit failures and draw the line between them. This paper also suggests that drawing the line is essential to building a just culture in a financial statement audit. 

In a financial statement audit and the study of audit failure, it is critical to regard the concept of audit failure as 'audit failure in a broad sense'. This is because the auditor needs to face all audit failures, learn from them, gain valuable lessons, and prevent them in order to reduce audit failures and improve audit quality. 

However, when audit failures occur, it is unacceptable not only to punish all audit failures but also to condone them all equally. Neither accepting all failures nor unaccepting them all is just. We need to draw the line between unacceptable and acceptable audit failures to build a just culture in a financial statement audit. 

Hence, in the light of 'audit failure in a broad sense', this paper draws the line between unacceptable and acceptable audit failures. By drawing the line between them, it is possible to build a just culture in a financial statement audit. 

In conclusion, it is essential to draw the line between unacceptable and acceptable audit failures to build a just culture in a financial statement audit. This just culture is desirable not only for auditors but also for society, including stakeholders and client companies.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨如何区分不可接受和可接受的审计失败，并指出这种区分对于在财务报表审计中建立公正文化至关重要。
AI.research_question: 如何在财务报表审计中区分不可接受和可接受的审计失败？
AI.motivation: 审计师需要面对所有审计失败并从中学习，但既不能惩罚所有失败也不能同等容忍所有失败，需要建立公正的审计文化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 广义审计失败概念，公正文化理论
AI.method: 概念分析框架
AI.findings: 通过区分不可接受和可接受的审计失败，可以在财务报表审计中建立公正文化。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了在审计失败研究中采用广义审计失败概念的重要性，并建立了区分不同类型审计失败的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为审计实务提供了建立公正文化的具体路径，有助于审计师、利益相关者和客户公司共同构建健康的审计环境。

title: Solar Expansion Following Coal Phase-Outs
affiliations: Columbia University and World Bank

detail.title: Solar Expansion Following Coal Phase-Outs

declarations.declarationOfInterest: We have no conflict of interest to declare.

detail.abstract: This paper examines how coal phase-out policies can indirectly spur renewable energy growth by reshaping market demand expectation and reallocating capital. We study China's retirement of 123 gigawatts of coal capacity between 2001 and 2020 under policy thresholds. Using a fuzzy regression discontinuity design, we find that each coal unit retirement leads to 2.1 new solar plants and 51.3 MW of capacity in the same prefecture-year, with effects quadrupling at the province level. Firm-to-firm investment data shows that coal closures increase investment in solar firms, particularly from private investors, consistent with a forward-looking reallocation of capital. Firm-level evidence further indicates that coal closures raise solar exports and improve total factor productivity, suggesting broader industrial upgrading. These results highlight how coal phase-outs can function as an indirect green industrial policy, generating sustained market demand for renewables, stimulating private investment, and enhancing the global competitiveness of the solar industry.

AI.tldr: 本文研究发现，中国淘汰煤电政策通过重塑市场预期和资本重新配置，间接推动了可再生能源发展。每淘汰1个煤电单位，在同一地级市年度内会新建2.1个太阳能电站和51.3兆瓦容量，省级层面效应扩大四倍。
AI.research_question: 煤电淘汰政策如何通过重塑市场预期和资本重新配置间接推动可再生能源发展？
AI.motivation: 理解煤电淘汰政策在推动能源转型中的间接作用机制，特别是如何通过市场信号和资本流动促进可再生能源发展。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于市场预期理论和资本重新配置理论，研究政策如何通过信号效应影响投资者行为。
AI.method: 使用模糊断点回归设计，分析中国2001-2020年间淘汰123吉瓦煤电产能的政策效果。
AI.findings: 煤电淘汰显著促进太阳能投资，特别是私人投资增加；企业层面证据显示太阳能出口和全要素生产率提升，表明产业升级。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了煤电淘汰作为间接绿色产业政策的概念框架，揭示了政策通过市场机制推动能源转型的路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了通过煤电淘汰间接促进可再生能源发展的实证依据，有助于设计更有效的能源转型政策。

title: Cover Crops a Potential Water Saver
affiliations: Statiunea de Cercetarte Dezvoltare pentru Viticultura si Vinificatie Bujoru, Statiunea de Cercetarte Dezvoltare pentru Viticultura si Vinificatie Bujoru, Statiunea de Cercetarte Dezvoltare pentru Viticultura si Vinificatie Bujoru, Statiunea de Cercetarte Dezvoltare pentru Viticultura si Vinificatie Bujoru and "Dunarea de Jos" University

detail.title: Cover Crops a Potential Water Saver
detail.abstract: This study investigates and evaluates the benefits brought by the use of cover crops in grapevine plantations and their impact on vegetative state as a result of increasing the amount of water present in the soil. Intensifying global warming phenomena has affected all ecosystems around the world, changing their specificity to new climate conditions. Due to extreme drought phenomena, the Balkan region is facing unprecedented water supply sortage, affecting both agricultural practices, including viticultural practices, and by default quality of life. The use of cover crops can become a viable choice for water resource conservation, assuring agricultural sustainability. Climate data, for 2024, analysis highlighted non-specific values for general and vine specific climate parameters. Due to extreme drought, cover crop experimental variants recorded limited vegetative growth and consequently had minimal effects on the soil water retention and vine plantation development. We aim at reestablishing experimental variants in the context of 2025 climate conditions, to obtain a positive impact regarding soil water reserves.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查和评估了葡萄园中使用覆盖作物带来的益处及其对植物生长状态的影响。由于全球变暖加剧导致极端干旱，巴尔干地区面临水资源短缺。2024年的实验显示，由于极端干旱，覆盖作物生长受限，对土壤保水和葡萄园发展的影响有限。计划在2025年重新建立实验以验证覆盖作物对土壤水储备的积极影响。
AI.research_question: 覆盖作物在葡萄园中的使用如何影响土壤水分含量和植物生长状态？
AI.motivation: 全球变暖加剧导致极端干旱现象，巴尔干地区面临前所未有的水资源短缺，影响农业实践和生活质量。覆盖作物可能成为水资源保护和农业可持续发展的可行选择。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于气候变化对农业生态系统影响的理论，以及覆盖作物在土壤水分保持和农业可持续发展中的作用机制。
AI.method: 通过分析2024年的气候数据，建立覆盖作物实验变体，评估其对土壤水分保持和葡萄园发展的影响。
AI.findings: 由于极端干旱，覆盖作物实验变体记录到有限的营养生长，因此对土壤水分保持和葡萄园发展的影响最小。
AI.theory_contributions: 为理解极端干旱条件下覆盖作物对土壤水分保持的有效性提供了实证证据，丰富了气候变化背景下农业适应性管理理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为葡萄种植者提供了在干旱条件下使用覆盖作物的实际效果评估，指导未来农业水资源管理实践，并为2025年的实验改进提供了基础。

title: Restitution Beyond the Object: Digital and Intellectual Property Restitution with the Royal Albert Memorial Museum & Art Gallery
affiliations: , affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Restitution Beyond the Object: Digital and Intellectual Property Restitution with the Royal Albert Memorial Museum & Art Gallery
detail.abstract: Around the world, countries are reforming national laws to enable the restitution of cultural property taken during colonial and imperial conquests. However, such restitution initiatives focus primarily on the return of physical artefacts, with less consideration for archival and catalogue records, analogue and digital reproductions, and the property or intellectual property rights associated with them. Rather than viewing these materials as separable from the physical artefact, this chapter argues they should also be included in claims to support digital and intellectual property restitution. It explores the significant potential for museums to initiate transfers using pathways already available in private law using areas of property, intellectual property, and contract law. It argues that possessors must re-examine the systems of law and practice typically applying to these materials to disentangle them to the greatest extent possible. The chapter contributes to this shift in thinking through research praxis with the Royal Albert Memorial Museum & Art Gallery in Exeter to develop pathways for digital and intellectual property restitution and, ultimately, a more expansive restitution methodology that extends beyond the physical object.

AI.tldr: 本章主张文化财产归还应超越物理文物，包含档案记录、数字复制品及相关知识产权，并探讨博物馆利用私法途径实现数字和知识产权归还的可能性。
AI.research_question: 如何将档案记录、数字复制品和知识产权纳入文化财产归还主张中？
AI.motivation: 当前文化财产归还主要关注物理文物，忽视了相关的档案记录、数字复制品和知识产权，需要更全面的归还方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于财产法、知识产权法和合同法理论，探讨文化财产归还的法律框架。
AI.method: 通过与埃克塞特皇家阿尔伯特纪念博物馆的合作研究实践，开发数字和知识产权归还的途径。
AI.findings: 博物馆可以利用现有的私法途径实现数字和知识产权转移，需要重新审视适用于这些材料的法律和实践体系。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了超越物理对象的更广泛归还方法论，将数字和知识产权纳入归还范围。
AI.practical_contributions: 为博物馆提供了实施数字和知识产权归还的具体途径和方法论。

title: When Floods Swamp Banks
affiliations: Univ Rennes, CNRS, CREM - UMR6211, F-35000 Rennes France and ESC PAU

detail.title: When Floods Swamp Banks
detail.abstract: This article examines the impact of natural disasters, particularly floods, on systemic banking risk. The analysis is based on a quarterly panel of 61 banks located in Bangladesh, India, and Pakistan over the period 2008-2021. The results reveal a significant increase in systemic risk following floods. These results highlight the need to integrate climate risks into macroprudential frameworks, particularly in financial systems that are structurally exposed to extreme climate shocks.

AI.tldr: 本文研究洪水等自然灾害对系统性银行风险的影响，基于2008-2021年孟加拉国、印度和巴基斯坦61家银行的季度面板数据，发现洪水后系统性风险显著增加，强调需将气候风险纳入宏观审慎框架。
AI.research_question: 自然灾害（特别是洪水）对系统性银行风险有何影响？
AI.motivation: 在气候变化加剧自然灾害频发的背景下，了解极端气候事件对金融系统稳定性的影响具有重要意义，特别是在易受气候冲击的金融体系中。
AI.theoretical_framework: 系统性风险理论、气候金融风险理论、宏观审慎监管框架
AI.method: 基于2008-2021年孟加拉国、印度和巴基斯坦61家银行的季度面板数据进行实证分析

title:
Green Silence: Double Machine Learning

Carbon Emissions Under Sample Selection Bias
affiliations: University of Glasgow, Adam Smith Business School, EDHEC Business School and Swiss Finance Institute - University of Geneva

detail.title:
Green Silence: Double Machine Learning

Carbon Emissions Under Sample Selection Bias
detail.abstract: Voluntary carbon disclosure collapses into a paradox of green silence: firms choose to disclose emissions based on strategic incentives (e.g., correcting vendor overestimates), while high emitters may exploit vendor estimation bias. Mirroring Heckman sample selection bias, this self-censorship skews disclosed emissions into non-random samples, distorting climate risk pricing and policy. We bridge economic problem and machine learning, proposing a Heckman-inspired three-step framework in high-dimensional settings to correct for strategic non-disclosure and ensure variable selection consistency in the presence of sample selection bias. By integrating kernel group lasso (KG-lasso) and double machine learning (DML) from neighbouring firms, i.e., using information from carbon next door, we unveil systematic underestimation: empirical analysis of 3444 unique US firms (2010-2023) rejects the null of no selection bias. Our findings indicate that voluntary disclosure induces adverse selection, where green silence rewards polluters and undermines decarbonization. Underestimation translates to a $2.6 billion shortfall in tax revenues and up to $525 billion hidden social cost of carbon. Our high-dimensional imputations also imply a substantially larger carbon premium.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示了自愿碳披露中的"绿色沉默悖论"：企业基于战略动机选择性披露排放数据，而高排放企业可能利用供应商估计偏差。这种自我审查导致披露样本存在选择偏差，扭曲了气候风险定价和政策。作者提出一个Heckman启发的三步框架，结合机器学习方法纠正战略不披露问题，发现存在系统性低估，导致税收收入短缺26亿美元和高达5250亿美元的隐藏社会成本。

AI.motivation: 自愿碳披露制度下，企业基于战略动机选择性披露排放数据，导致样本选择偏差，这可能扭曲气候风险定价和政策有效性。
AI.theoretical_framework: Heckman样本选择偏差理论、战略披露理论、信息不对称理论
AI.method: 提出Heckman启发的三步框架，结合核群组lasso（KG-lasso）和双重机器学习（DML），利用邻近企业信息（"隔壁碳"）进行高维环境下的变量选择一致性分析，对3444家美国独特企业（2010-2023）进行实证分析
AI.findings: 拒绝无选择偏差的原假设，发现系统性低估；自愿披露导致逆向选择，绿色沉默奖励污染者并削弱脱碳；低估导致26亿美元税收收入短缺和高达5250亿美元隐藏社会成本；高维插补显示更大的碳溢价
AI.theory_contributions: 将经济问题与机器学习结合，提出纠正战略不披露的Heckman启发框架；揭示自愿碳披露中的绿色沉默悖论和逆向选择问题
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供纠正碳披露偏差的方法论；量化披露偏差对税收和社会成本的影响；帮助企业更准确地评估碳风险

detail.title: Carbon Trading and Financial Sustainability: Intersections, Implications, and Strategies
detail.abstract: In recent years the world has been focusing more on combating climate change and carbon trading has become a vital tool with an aim to lower the carbon emissions. The studies have shown that the financial market is essential for the success of carbon trading as they provide carbon related assets with liquidity, price discovery, and risk management. This chapter examines how carbon trading mechanisms affect the financial health of businesses and economies. It explores how emissions trading systems affect financial performance and its implications on company's profitability, liquidity and competitiveness. This study reflects how environmental regulations influence business operations, considering opportunities and challenges for achieving financial sustainability. By integrating theoretical frameworks with implication and strategies from different studies and reports, this chapter aims to inform policy makers, businesses, and investors on the role of carbon trading in promoting sustainable finance and building long-term economic resilience in the face of climate change challenges.

title: Tax the (very) Rich ! Revised 1

detail.title: Tax the (very) Rich ! Revised 1

keywords: Simulation of the Dynamic of Cumulative Wealth Distribution

detail.abstract:
This paper is a response to and offers supporting analysis for Tony Atkinson's and Thomas Piketti’s claim that only rigorous Government intervention can slow the pace of the otherwise ineluctable growth in wealth inequality,which if left unchecked, is likely to have catastrophic consequences for society. The paper shows analytically, through simulation that an unequal distribution of wealth (typically the norm in industrial or post industrial society) according to the Pareto curve will, over time, lead to further massive inequalities of wealth.
However a small redistribution of wealth together with associated policies, see below, will have the effect of slowing inequality growth.
If the process of cumulative inequality is left unchecked the consequences will be disasterous
The simulation analysis is supported by an analysis of wealth inequality growth in the USA and UK between 1950 and 2020. The paper concludes with briefly reviewing the work of Atkinson and Piketti which tells a similar story by different means

declarations.ethicsApproval: No patients or participants. No approval needed.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of College and University Law, Volume 50, No. 1. Pp. 219-248.

detail.abstract: A spate of recent postings on social media have gotten the posting professors into hot water. These expressions are not rooted in their academic disciplines, but address public and institutional controversies: condemning Israel as a "social cancer"; condemning a faculty advisor as "racist" for the campus organization he advised. May they be sanctioned? In public institutions shelter might be sought in the first amendment. In all institutions shelter might be sought in institutional academic freedom policies rooted in national professional norms. On closer examination, however, the first amendment appears a rather weak reed to lean on; and protective policy appears enervated, the national norms in decay. This article explains how the robust, uninhibited, unfettered campus debate on public and institutional issues is now beclouded, and explores what this trend portends.

title: The Survival of U.S. Patent Damages on Appeal: An Empirical Study of Award Size and Affirmance Rates
affiliations: University of California, Berkeley

detail.title: The Survival of U.S. Patent Damages on Appeal: An Empirical Study of Award Size and Affirmance Rates
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the survival of large patent damages awards on appeal to the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Federal Circuit (CAFC). Drawing on a novel database of district court jury verdicts between 2010 and 2025, the research assesses how often damages survive appellate review and whether award size affects affirmance rates. Key Findings: (1) Low overall survival: Only about one-third of damages awards survive intact on appeal once pending and settled cases are excluded. (2) Award size is decisive: Larger verdicts are disproportionately overturned, reduced, or vacated. Upheld awards average $103M, while non-upheld awards average $ 267 million. Median damages are similar (~$35–40M), showing that mega-verdicts skew the averages. (3) Cliff effect at high values: Awards above $100M are rarely upheld. Awards above $500M are never upheld. (4) Biotech vs. non-biotech: Non-biotech cases show a stronger negative correlation between award size and survival, with statistical significance. 

Implications for policymakers: The data suggest that very large damages awards, while headline-grabbing, are illusory. They rarely survive appellate scrutiny and may distort perceptions of patent enforcement. For litigants: The fragility of large verdicts may play a key role in informing the litigation and settlement strategies of patent litigants of different sizes. For the courts: The findings highlight the appellate system’s active role in overturning the majority of lower court decisions, which adds to the duration and expense of patent litigation. 

Conclusion: Patent damages awards are most vulnerable at the upper end of the spectrum. Billion-dollar verdicts consistently collapse on appeal, and damages exceeding $500M have no survival record in the modern era. The relationship between award size and appellate survival is robust, providing a better understanding of the real outcomes of patent litigation as empirical input for policy debates on patent enforcement.

affiliations: and BML Munjal University

detail.title: A Comprehensive Analysis of Environmental Accounting Practices in Indian Companies: A Key Approach to Ensuring Environmental Sustainability
detail.abstract: As environmental sustainability becomes a global priority, businesses are increasingly integrating ecological considerations into their financial frameworks through environmental accounting, or green accounting. This study examines the reliability of measurement scales used to assess green accounting practices and provides a comprehensive review of relevant literature, policies, and standards, particularly in the Indian corporate context. Using Principal Component Analysis (PCA), the research investigates the relationships between various environmental accounting practices, highlighting the roles of financial analysis, transparent reporting, and sustainable production in promoting effective environmental management. The findings emphasize the need for corporations to improve environmental financial disclosures and invest in green production methods to meet sustainability objectives. Moreover, the study identifies gaps in current practices, suggesting areas for further research to refine these techniques and enhance corporate accountability. This analysis offers practical insights for organizations looking to integrate sustainability into their core strategies, contributing to more responsible environmental stewardship. The study also holds significance for policymakers and scholars by presenting a framework that connects financial performance with sustainability, paving the way for more informed decision-making and stronger corporate governance aligned with environmental goal

title: The Echoes of Competition in Operations: Understanding Its Impact on Consumer Review Behavior
affiliations: University of Florida - Warrington College of Business, Santa Clara University - Leavey School of Business, University of Oklahoma, University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration and Temple University - Department of Statistics, Operations, and Data Science

detail.title: The Echoes of Competition in Operations: Understanding Its Impact on Consumer Review Behavior
detail.abstract: As more businesses recognize the value of digital platforms to enhance their presence, the resulting influx of participants has led to intensified competition in the marketplace. Meanwhile, online reviews continue to be a key factor in competition, with significant implications for firms’ operational outcomes. However, the way consumers respond to competition, particularly through their reviews, remains underexplored. To illuminate this uncharted area, we investigate how the competitive environment of a business affects consumers’ tendency to write influential online reviews. We find that intensified competition, while necessitating greater decision-making effort that encourages more helpful comments, also simultaneously reduces the visibility of potential reviews and deters informative ones, leading to an inverted U-shaped relationship between competition and the likelihood of consumers posting informative reviews. Moreover, more options, due to increased competition, boost the possibility for consumers to find a match but also elevate their expectations, resulting in a similar nonmonotonic pattern between competition and the likelihood of consumers posting negative reviews. We also show that business popularity moderates the observed inverted U-shaped relationships. We further adopt an instrumental variable approach, an exogenous shock from property leasing or buying, to alleviate the endogeneity concern and conduct a survey to corroborate the underlying mechanisms. Our findings highlight the prominent role of the competitive environment in shaping consumer reviews and offer insights into platforms’ operational strategies for sustaining high-quality contributions and for businesses seeking to manage their online reputation effectively.

detail.abstract:
ניתוח אשכולות אלו טכניקות שעוסקות בארגון הנתונים בקבוצות בעלות היגיון מובחן. היגיון מסדר זה הוא אחד מאופני ההבנה והלמידה הבסיסיים במגוון רחב של תחומים כגון סיווג סימפטומים רפואיים או פילוח שוק הצרכנים. כיום, עם ההתפתחות הזמינות והידידותיות של כלים לניתוח נתונים, משתמש עם אוריינות טכנית בסיסית יכול בקלות להפעיל כלים של סיווג וניתוח אשכולות. באופן זה המשתמש לא זקוק עוד לידע אודות תהליך ומנגנוני העיבוד, אלא רק להבנה הפרשנית לגבי האופן בו יש לקרוא ולפרש את התוצאות שהתקבלו. הדבר מאוד יעיל ואמין כאשר אנחנו מפעילים טכניקות "יציבות". מנגד, הדבר מסוכן כאשר מדובר בטכניקות "לא יציבות" כדוגמת ניתוח אשכולות, שמפיקות תוצאות שונות עם כל שינוי בערכים של משתני ההפעלה. לכן, ראוי להסב את תשומת ליבו של המשתמש לרכיבים המשפיעים על החלוקה לקבוצות ועל קביעת ההיגיון המסדר. המאמר הנוכחי עומד על ליבת המשתנים המשפיעים על התהליך ומצביע על הנקודות בהן המשתמש חייב להיות בעל ידע והבנה מעמיקים, כדי שיוכל לבקר ולאמת את התוצר המתקבל.

Cluster analysis is a set of techniques that organize data into sensible groupings. The ordering logic behind such grouping represents one of the most fundamental modes of understanding and learning across various fields, such as medical symptom classification or consumer market segmentation. Today, with increased availability of AI and data analysis tools, a user with basic technical literacy can easily operate these tools with only an interpretive understanding of how to read and interpret the results obtained and no knowledge about the underlying processing. This approach is very effective and reliable when we use stable techniques that yield identical results independent of operating conditions, but is risky when we use unstable techniques, such as cluster analysis, which produce different results with each change in the values of the operating variables. Therefore, it is appropriate to draw the user's attention to the components that affect the division of data into groups and the determination of the grouping logic. This article focuses on the core factors that affect the cluster analysis process, and highlights the components of the process that require in-depth knowledge and understanding, so that users can operate these tools in a way that ensures the reliability of the results obtained.

detail.abstract: Drawing on Institutional Theory and Transaction Cost Economics, this study investigates how procedural inefficiencies and bureaucratic barriers within state management institutions affect the competitiveness of businesses in Vietnam's import-export sector. Through a mixed-methods approach combining qualitative interviews and quantitative surveys, the research examines the relationships between institutional inefficiencies, transaction costs, and business performance. The findings reveal significant negative impacts: procedural inefficiencies reduce business competitiveness (β = -0.45, p < 0.01), while bureaucratic barriers increase operational costs (β = 0.39, p < 0.05), particularly affecting SMEs. These challenges manifest through lengthy customs clearance processes (averaging 20 hours delay), excessive documentation requirements (12 documents versus the regional standard of 7), and frequent regulatory changes. Digital solutions demonstrate significant moderating effects (β = 0.28, p < 0.05), potentially reducing negative impacts by up to 20%. Based on these findings, the study recommends expanding the National Single Window system, implementing standardized documentation templates, enhancing digital infrastructure, and establishing clear performance metrics. These evidence-based reforms are essential for improving Vietnam's trade competitiveness and creating a more efficient, transparent business environment in the import-export sector.

title: Steering Fast and Slow: How Newcomers in DAOs Drive and Stall Governance Innovation
affiliations: Pennsylvania State University - Department of Supply Chain & Information Systems and Pennsylvania State University - Department of Supply Chain & Information Systems

detail.title: Steering Fast and Slow: How Newcomers in DAOs Drive and Stall Governance Innovation
detail.abstract: Blockchain technology has enabled novel organizational forms such as Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs). To remain competitive, DAOs pursue governance innovations—new governance practices that deviate from existing ones—through proposal creation and voting. Unlike traditional corporations, DAOs operate under an open and decentralized structure, making newcomers play an important role in both proposal creation and voting. Yet their impact remains unclear. Using data from Snapshot, a leading DAO governance platform, we show that newcomers act as a double-edged sword in governance innovation: they increase proposal novelty as creators but suppress it as voters. Specifically, new creators introduce more novel proposals, though these are less likely to be approved. New voters, by contrast, herd by following incumbents’ negative sentiment toward novel ideas and often lack domain expertise to assess such initiatives, though prior experience in other DAOs mitigates this skepticism. This study contributes to the literature on organizational theory, DAO governance, and crowdsourcing.

title: Strategies Analysis of Luxury Fashion Rental Platform in Sharing Economy
affiliations: Tongji University, China Europe International Business School (CEIBS), Tongji University - School of Economics and Management and Xi’an Jiaotong University

detail.title: Strategies Analysis of Luxury Fashion Rental Platform in Sharing Economy
detail.abstract: As the sharing economy has grown rapidly in recent years, luxury fashion rental has become a prominent business trend. An increasing number of designer brands are finding ways to cooperate with rental platforms rather than compete with them. We develop a stylized model to study the impact of business-to-consumer product sharing on luxury fashion brands. Specifically, we consider a setting where a designer brand firm provides a luxury fashion product to a rental platform, which can either purchase the product from the firm then rent to consumers, or allow the designer brand firm to use its platform to reach the consumers directly with a commission fee. Our analysis reveals that the presence of a rental platform leads to two simultaneous effects: a market expansion effect and a cannibalization effect. In the base model, we show that the market expansion effect dominates the cannibalization effect. Therefore, the designer brand firm can benefit from the appearance of a rental platform. Further, our analysis reveals that the optimal choice between the wholesale and agency contract of the firm and the platform depends critically on two parameters: the revenue-sharing proportion and salvage value. We illustrate that when the revenue-sharing proportion is relatively large and salvage value is relatively small, both the firm and the platform benefit more under the agency contract. Moreover, we illustrate the robustness of our main insights to consider the presence of different consumer segments, consumers' conspicuous behavior, competition between rental platforms, and two-period rental setting.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了奢侈品时尚租赁平台对设计师品牌的影响，发现租赁平台同时产生市场扩张效应和蚕食效应，但市场扩张效应占主导地位，因此设计师品牌可以从租赁平台中受益。最优合同选择（批发或代理）取决于收入分成比例和残值两个关键参数。

title: Risk & Quality Management -Case Study for a company planning to Migrate their File Storage and Solution Sharing from a Local Server environment to a Cloud-Based Provider
affiliations: Robert Gordon University

detail.title: Risk & Quality Management -Case Study for a company planning to Migrate their File Storage and Solution Sharing from a Local Server environment to a Cloud-Based Provider
detail.abstract:
The goal of a risk assessment in project management is to identify potential risks and uncertainties that could jeopardize the project's success. The purpose is to foresee issues and establish solutions to mitigate or manage these risks so that their negative impact on project objectives is minimized. 

The results of a risk assessment are utilized for a variety of objectives, including: 

It assists in detecting and cataloging any hazards that may develop during the project's lifecycle. This includes brainstorming discussions, historical data analysis, and consulting specialists to ensure a thorough understanding of potential dangers. 

Risk Analysis: The assessment enables a qualitative or quantitative examination of recognized risks. The probability and impact of hazards are assessed in qualitative analysis, whereas quantitative analysis assigns numerical values to risks based on probabilities and impacts. 

Prioritization: The data acquired aids in the prioritization of risks based on their possible impact on the project's success criterion. This guarantees that the most critical risks receive the greatest attention and resources. 

Response Planning: The creation of risk response strategies is informed by risk assessment. Proactive strategies are developed for high-priority hazards to mitigate, transfer, accept, or avoid the risk. 

Contingency Planning: It facilitates the development of contingency plans that specify measures to be taken if recognized risks manifest. The presence of contingency plans improves the project's durability and adaptability.

title: Bitcoin Must Become More Sustainable, For its own Good (as Well as the Planet's)
affiliations: ESCP Europe - ESCP Europe - Turin Campus and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Bitcoin Must Become More Sustainable, For its own Good (as Well as the Planet's)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The original digital cryptocurrency, bitcoin, continues to receive media attention as it repeatedly breaks valuation records. It is also increasingly coming under the spotlight for its environmental impact. Indeed, as of 2021, the Bitcoin network consumes yearly as much energy as the entire country of The Netherlands and each transaction has a CO2 footprint equal to 1,218,903 VISA transactions (Bitcoin Energy Consumption Index 2021). This raises "serious concerns for its potential impact on health and climate" (De Vries 2020). Left unrestricted and unregulated, bitcoin mining could critically compromise global decarbonization efforts. Beside these critical issues, we argue in this impact paper that Bitcoin must transition to more sustainable practices for its own viability as an investment as well as for its long-term survival.

AI.tldr: 比特币作为首个数字货币，其高能耗和环境影响引发严重担忧。比特币网络年耗电量相当于荷兰全国，每笔交易的碳排放量相当于121万笔VISA交易。若不加以限制和监管，比特币挖矿将严重威胁全球脱碳努力。本文认为比特币必须转向更可持续的做法，这不仅关乎其投资价值，也关乎其长期生存。
AI.research_question: 比特币如何能够转向更可持续的做法以确保其长期生存和投资价值？
AI.motivation: 比特币的高能耗和环境影响引发严重担忧，其年耗电量相当于荷兰全国，碳排放量巨大，可能严重威胁全球脱碳努力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于环境可持续性理论和加密货币生存理论，探讨比特币的可持续转型需求。
AI.method: 基于现有数据和文献分析，采用影响评估方法。

AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和比特币社区提供了向可持续实践转型的紧迫性和必要性的实证依据。

title: The Agency Model for Digital Goods: Strategic Analysis of Dual Channels in Electronic Publishing Industry
affiliations: China Europe International Business School (CEIBS) and University of Florida - Warrington College of Business Administration

detail.title: The Agency Model for Digital Goods: Strategic Analysis of Dual Channels in Electronic Publishing Industry
detail.abstract: The advent of digital goods has made a significant impact on the current traditional (physical) goods markets for items such as movies, music, video games, and books. Firms that manage both a traditional and a digital goods distribution channels are facing many emerging operational challenges. One of the most pivotal challenges is the supply chain contract model for the distribution of digital goods alongside their traditional counterparts. Recently, the agency model utilized by the e-book publishing industry has been highlighted in the press as a result of the U.S. Department of Justice's lawsuit against Apple, Inc. The regulators claim that the agency model is hurting this industry as well as the consumer's welfare because e-book prices have increased after the introduction of agency model. We investigate the strategic impact of the agency model by formulating a dual channel model in comparison with the prevalent wholesale model. Contrary to current press presaging the negative impact of the agency model, we find that the equilibrium price of digital goods is lower in the agency model than in the wholesale model. Furthermore, the agency model can mitigate the double marginalization effect of the supply chain and improve the consumers' surplus.

title: Hidden Levers in Constitutional Design: How Broad Clauses Enable Executive Discretion

detail.title: Hidden Levers in Constitutional Design: How Broad Clauses Enable Executive Discretion
detail.abstract: Constitutions often appear to guarantee fundamental freedoms, including speech, assembly, and information access. However, some constitutions include broadly worded clauses that allow authorities to restrict these rights under vague conditions, such as protecting "constitutional order," public safety, or morality. This paper analyzes how such provisions function as hidden levers of executive discretion, enabling governments to maintain control while presenting a democratic façade. The analysis draws on generalized patterns observed in post-authoritarian and transitional contexts, illustrating how legal ambiguity can influence the practical implementation of rights and shape political power dynamics.

title: Task Assignments in Distributed Supply Chains When Downtime Hurts: A Data-Driven Approach
affiliations: Indian Institute of Technology (IIT), Bombay, New York University (NYU) - Leonard N. Stern School of Business and USC Marshall School of Business

detail.title: Task Assignments in Distributed Supply Chains When Downtime Hurts: A Data-Driven Approach

publicationDetails.detailsText: NYU Stern School of Business Research Paper
publicationDetails.journalName: New York University Stern School of Business Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Artisanal supply chains sustain millions globally but face persistent productivity challenges. Using loomlevel data and surveys from one of the largest employers of rural artisanal women involved in carpet making, we show that task breaks-idle periods between assignments-depress weaving productivity significantly. In particular, task breaks are associated with a statistically significant 7.8% increase in production time, even after accounting for observable heterogeneity. Further, our heterogeneous treatment effects analysis suggests that these effects are significantly amplified when (i) weavers are assigned either low-complexity rugs, or rugs that fall outside their stated preferences; (ii) weavers who face task-breaks are less affluent. To generate prescriptive insights, we model loom readiness and task assignment as a restless bandit problem and derive Whittle indices to guide real-time task allocation. Analytically, we derive a closed-form performance gap that quantifies when-and by how much-a "wait-for-a-higher-value-job" heuristic (rejecting low-value jobs) is dominated by a readiness-aware rule that sometimes takes a low-value job to ensure task continuity. Our index outperforms naive heuristics and is implementable with limited data. This study highlights the cost of idle time and shows how behavioral frictions can be embedded in tractable policies for distributed supply chains.

AI.tldr: 手工艺供应链中的任务中断（闲置期）显著降低编织生产率7.8%，特别是在低复杂度地毯或不符合织工偏好的任务中影响更大。研究提出基于Whittle指数的实时任务分配策略，优于简单的"等待高价值工作"启发式方法。
AI.research_question: 任务中断如何影响手工艺供应链的生产率？如何设计有效的任务分配策略来减少闲置时间的影响？
AI.motivation: 手工艺供应链支撑着全球数百万人的生计，但面临持续的生产率挑战，特别是任务中断导致的闲置时间问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 使用不安定老虎机问题（restless bandit problem）建模织机准备状态和任务分配，应用Whittle指数指导实时任务分配。
AI.method: 使用织机级数据和调查数据，来自一个最大的农村手工艺女性地毯制造商，进行异质性处理效应分析。
AI.findings: 任务中断导致生产时间显著增加7.8%；在低复杂度地毯或不符合织工偏好的任务中影响更大；对较不富裕织工影响更显著。
AI.theory_contributions: 推导出封闭形式的性能差距，量化"等待高价值工作"启发式与准备状态感知规则之间的差异；将行为摩擦嵌入可处理的分布式供应链策略中。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出的Whittle指数策略优于简单启发式方法，且仅需有限数据即可实施；为手工艺供应链管理者提供减少闲置时间成本的实际指导。

title: Work intensity and unsustainable work: Evidence from the European Working Conditions Survey
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Work intensity and unsustainable work: Evidence from the European Working Conditions Survey

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In this paper, I focus on work intensity as an important element of unsustainable work. I briefly discuss some key determinants and outcomes of work intensity. In addition, using the 2010 and 2015 waves of the European Working Conditions Survey (EWCS), I present results on selected predictors of work intensity. These results indicate categories of employees who are experiencing higher levels of work intensity and, therefore, whose ability to stay longer in the workforce might be at greater risk. Results also show that task uncertainty and certain human resource practices seem to be strong positive predictors of work intensity. In contrast, some types of discretion seem to be associated with lower levels of work intensity. Because the analysis is based on cross-sectional data, these findings should be interpreted with caution.

AI.tldr: 本文使用欧洲工作条件调查数据，分析工作强度的预测因素，发现任务不确定性和某些人力资源实践会显著增加工作强度，而某些自主权则与较低的工作强度相关。

detail.abstract: Among the nomadic Maasai of East Africa for whom cattle symbolize wealth, tradition permits Maasai women to own the milk but not the cows, which are largely received as a dowry. In our contribution, we seek to outline how women can manage and grow their businesses despite challenges, by adopting three key successful practices: Combining resources in multi-firm networks, focusing on value-adding activities, and Exploiting digital technology.

title: An Evaluation of Determinants Influencing the Adoption of Circular Economy Principles in Nigerian Construction SMEs
affiliations: , The British University in Dubai and Independent

detail.title: An Evaluation of Determinants Influencing the Adoption of Circular Economy Principles in Nigerian Construction SMEs
detail.abstract: Recent global-wide events including the COVID-19 pandemic have triggered further concerns for construction organizations and policy makers to rethink their resource utilization particularly as most nations gradually return to normalcy. Thus, the primary aim of this study was to appraise the current barriers and drivers of circular economy (CE) concept implementation among construction small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in developing countries. Focus groups were used to answer the overarching question on the determinants influencing CE implementation within construction SMEs. The focus groups revealed a wealth of CE practice detailed information and insights into emerging CE research themes. The study found that the CE concept makes strong arguments for achieving value in economies by reusing, repairing and recycling of constrained resources during operational activities especially within the built environment. Moreover, the findings of this study provide a basis for the research community and practitioners to recognize how various determinants can be coalesced to influence CE adoption and to potentially yield sustainably organizationally valued outputs.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了发展中国家建筑中小企业实施循环经济概念的障碍和驱动因素，发现循环经济通过资源再利用、修复和回收在建筑环境中创造价值，为研究界和实践者提供了影响循环经济采用的各种决定因素的整合框架。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家建筑中小企业实施循环经济概念的主要障碍和驱动因素是什么？

AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供了影响循环经济采用的决定因素整合框架，有助于产生可持续的组织价值产出

detail.abstract: Can innovation be more inclusive and sustainable? The coronavirus crisis has brought to light various shortcomings of modern capitalism, primarily in terms of the hidden aspects of inequality and distribution of wealth in the way we innovate. A crisis of this magnitude offers an opportunity to rethink innovation. This paper aims to analyze some of the challenges the crisis has imposed on innovation, but also, how we can learn and move forward from this point in time.

title: Trust Tech: The Emergence of a New Technological Sector for Tackling Online Disinformation and Cognitive Manipulation
affiliations: Haim Striks Faculty of Law - College of Management, , College of Management (Israel),  and

detail.title: Trust Tech: The Emergence of a New Technological Sector for Tackling Online Disinformation and Cognitive Manipulation

declarations.funderStatement: This research was entirely funded by the Louis Brandeis Institue for Society, Economy and Democracy at the College of Management Academic Studies

detail.abstract:
The rapid erosion of trust in institutions, governments, and shared information sources - driven by disinformation, misinformation, and manipulation - is among the defining challenges of our time. While this challenge requires policy and educational responses, it also calls for technological solutions.

This report documents and analyzes the emergence of “Trust Tech”, a technology sector dedicated to countering online disinformation, misinformation, and manipulation.

Drawing on a dataset of 256 Trust Tech startups worldwide, we define the sector and assess its geographic distribution, growth dynamics, and product focus.

We find that the sector is concentrated in Western democracies and leading innovation hubs: 46.2% of firms are incorporated in the United States, followed by the United Kingdom (10.8%) and Israel (4.5%). Sector development tracks salient political and global events associated with disinformation concerns, including the U.S. elections of 2016 and 2020, the COVID‑19 pandemic, and the rise of generative AI, with growth accelerating rapidly after 2021.

Most firms in our sample exhibit the characteristics of a nascent, early‑stage industry.

In terms of solutions, firms span multiple domains, reflecting limited specialization in an emerging field. Trust Tech companies primarily target detection (69.8%) and protection (83.1%), with fewer focusing on literacy (29.8%) and active mitigation/response (19.2%).  

We argue that recognizing Trust Tech as a distinct sector is essential to accelerate its development and to guide policy, investment, and research.

AI.tldr: 本文定义了"信任科技"这一新兴技术领域，分析了全球256家相关初创企业的地理分布、增长动态和产品焦点，发现该领域主要集中在西方民主国家，主要关注虚假信息检测和保护，并呼吁将其视为独立领域以促进发展。
AI.research_question: 信任科技作为应对在线虚假信息和操纵的技术领域，其发展现状、地理分布和产品焦点如何？
AI.motivation: 机构、政府和共享信息源信任的快速侵蚀是当今时代的重大挑战，需要技术解决方案来应对虚假信息、错误信息和操纵问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信任科技作为新兴技术领域的定义和分类框架，包括检测、保护、素养和主动缓解/响应等解决方案维度。
AI.method: 基于全球256家信任科技初创企业的数据集分析，评估地理分布、增长动态和产品焦点。
AI.findings: 1) 信任科技企业集中在西方民主国家和创新中心（美国46.2%，英国10.8%，以色列4.5%）；2) 发展轨迹与重大政治和全球事件相关；3) 主要关注检测（69.8%）和保护（83.1%），较少关注素养（29.8%）和主动缓解（19.2%）。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将信任科技定义为一个独立的技术领域，建立了该领域的分类框架和分析方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、投资者和研究人员提供了信任科技领域的全景视图，有助于指导政策、投资和研究方向。

title: Detecting Illegal Logging Using Deep Learning and Statistical Modeling on Sentinel-1 SAR Imagery
affiliations: Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT)

detail.title: Detecting Illegal Logging Using Deep Learning and Statistical Modeling on Sentinel-1 SAR Imagery

publicationDetails.journalName: MIT Sloan School of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Illegal logging in tropical peat swamp forests represents a significant threat to global climate stability, by contributing to around 15-20% of worldwide greenhouse emissions and degrading vital carbon storage ecosystems. This study addresses the necessity of automated detection of illegal logging activities in the Mawas Conservation Area of Central Kalimantan, Indonesia, by developing a deep learning model trained on Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) imagery from Sentinel-1. The model structure involves a combination of UNet and DeepLabV3 architecture with EfficientNet-B4 as the encoder backbone, enhanced by Spatial and Channel Squeeze & Excitation (SCSE) attention mechanisms for improved feature extraction. The model was trained on 690 SAR images, captured from March 2018 to December 2019. The deep learning model shows promising results with an F1-Score of 0.66 and an IoU of 0.82. The overall accuracy is high at 92.55% and a precision is 87.41%. These results demonstrate the viability of deep learning and statistical modeling for monitoring illegal logging in data-sparse tropical forest regions.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个基于深度学习的模型，使用Sentinel-1 SAR影像自动检测印度尼西亚热带泥炭沼泽森林中的非法采伐活动。模型结合UNet和DeepLabV3架构，采用EfficientNet-B4编码器和SCSE注意力机制，在690张SAR图像上训练，取得了92.55%的准确率和0.82的IoU值。
AI.research_question: 如何利用深度学习和合成孔径雷达影像自动检测热带泥炭沼泽森林中的非法采伐活动？
AI.motivation: 非法采伐对全球气候稳定构成重大威胁，贡献了约15-20%的全球温室气体排放，并破坏了重要的碳储存生态系统。在数据稀疏的热带森林地区需要有效的监测方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于深度学习的计算机视觉方法，结合UNet和DeepLabV3架构，采用EfficientNet-B4作为编码器骨干网络，并集成空间和通道压缩激励注意力机制。
AI.method: 使用Sentinel-1 SAR影像，在2018年3月至2019年12月期间采集的690张图像上训练深度学习模型。模型架构结合了UNet和DeepLabV3，采用EfficientNet-B4编码器和SCSE注意力机制。
AI.findings: 深度学习模型表现出色，F1分数为0.66，IoU为0.82，整体准确率达到92.55%，精确度为87.41%。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了深度学习和统计建模在数据稀疏的热带森林地区监测非法采伐的可行性，为类似环境下的自动监测提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了一个实用的非法采伐自动检测系统，可用于保护热带泥炭沼泽森林，减少温室气体排放，支持森林保护政策的实施。

title: The Stability Frontier in Network Coordination Games

detail.title: The Stability Frontier in Network Coordination Games
detail.abstract: “The Stability Frontier in Network Coordination Games”. We prove that network coordination games exhibit a sharp phase transition at λ₁(Ā)·φ = χ + δ. Below this spectral threshold the system possesses a unique, globally stable Nash equilibrium; above it multiple equilibria appear and the “critical configuration” is uniquely stochastically stable under best-response, fictitious-play, regret-minimising and reinforcement learning. We derive finite-size corrections, tight Price-of-Anarchy bounds (Θ(n) for complete graphs, O(log n) for scale-free networks) and supply an O(m log n) algorithm that computes the critical threshold. The results are directly usable for cascade-risk diagnostics in public health, such as pandemic control, fintech, such as bank runs, and cyber-security, such as network attacks.

AI.tldr: 该论文证明了网络协调博弈存在一个尖锐的相变阈值λ₁(Ā)·φ = χ + δ。低于该阈值时系统具有唯一全局稳定的纳什均衡；高于该阈值时出现多重均衡，且"临界配置"在最佳响应、虚拟博弈、遗憾最小化和强化学习下具有唯一的随机稳定性。
AI.research_question: 网络协调博弈中是否存在相变阈值？该阈值如何影响系统的均衡稳定性和动态行为？
AI.motivation: 理解网络协调博弈中的相变现象对于公共卫生（如疫情控制）、金融科技（如银行挤兑）和网络安全（如网络攻击）等领域的级联风险诊断具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 网络协调博弈理论、谱图理论、纳什均衡理论、随机稳定性理论
AI.method: 理论证明和数学分析，包括谱分析方法、相变理论、有限尺寸修正和算法设计
AI.findings: 发现了一个尖锐的相变阈值λ₁(Ā)·φ = χ + δ，该阈值决定了系统的均衡唯一性和稳定性；提出了计算临界阈值的O(m log n)算法；推导了紧致的无政府代价界限（完全图为Θ(n)，无标度网络为O(log n)）
AI.theory_contributions: 建立了网络协调博弈的相变理论框架，揭示了系统从单一均衡向多重均衡转变的临界条件，发展了随机稳定性理论在网络博弈中的应用
AI.practical_contributions: 为公共卫生、金融科技和网络安全领域的级联风险诊断提供了可直接使用的分析工具和算法，有助于预测和控制系统性风险

title: Et si la crise permettait à la GRH de devenir durable ? (What if the crisis allowed HRM to become sustainable?)
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Et si la crise permettait à la GRH de devenir durable ? (What if the crisis allowed HRM to become sustainable?)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: (GRH) s'est étendu à un plus grand nombre de parties prenantes internes et externes. Contrainte à des adaptations de court terme, elle s'est inscrite dans l'anticipation dans le plus long terme pour préparer l'avenir. Les résultats de ses actions sont aussi plus intégrés à ceux financiers et écologiques. Elle pourrait ainsi devenir durable ou responsable grâce à la crise. Ce papier analyse cette « nouvelle » orientation de la GRH, ses déclinaisons en termes de pratiques, et envisage les variantes et les défis de la GRH durable.

English Abstract: With the crisis, the scope of action of Human Resource Management (HRM) has expanded to include a larger number of internal and external stakeholders. Forced into short-term adaptations, it has also engaged in longer-term anticipation in order to prepare for the future. The results of its actions are now more closely integrated with financial and ecological outcomes. Thus, HRM could become sustainable or responsible thanks to the crisis. This paper analyzes this “new” orientation of HRM, its implications in terms of practices, and considers the variations and challenges of sustainable HRM.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了危机如何推动人力资源管理(HRM)向可持续方向发展，使其涵盖更多利益相关者、整合长期与短期视角，并将人力资源成果与财务和生态结果更紧密地结合。
AI.research_question: 危机如何推动人力资源管理向可持续方向转型？这种转型在实践中的具体表现是什么？可持续人力资源管理面临哪些变体和挑战？
AI.motivation: 危机促使人力资源管理扩大其行动范围，纳入更多内外部利益相关者，并需要在短期适应与长期规划之间找到平衡，同时将人力资源成果与财务和生态结果更紧密地整合。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续人力资源管理理论、利益相关者理论、组织适应理论
AI.method: 理论分析
AI.findings: 危机推动了人力资源管理的转型，使其：1）扩大行动范围至更多利益相关者；2）在短期适应基础上增加了长期规划；3）更紧密地整合人力资源成果与财务和生态结果；4）向可持续或负责任的方向发展。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对可持续人力资源管理的理解，阐明了危机如何作为催化剂推动人力资源管理向更可持续的方向转型，并提出了可持续人力资源管理的实践框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了在危机背景下实施可持续人力资源管理的指导，帮助管理者平衡短期适应与长期规划，并更好地整合人力资源成果与其他关键绩效指标。

title: Complex Adaptive Leadership: The Case of a Mining Conglomerate under Reorganization Process and the Role of Leader
affiliations: AAB College - Faculty of Economics

detail.title: Complex Adaptive Leadership: The Case of a Mining Conglomerate under Reorganization Process and the Role of Leader
detail.abstract: The purpose of this paper is to analyze leader's role in unpredictable organizational world through critically analysing the leadership approaches and the roles of leaders in a mining conglomerate. Through a brief adaptive leadership literature review the paper presents main aspects of complexity theory, adaptive leadership, leader's role in this framework and potential utilization of literature findings in real case of a mining conglomerate in Kosovo which is under reorganization process. Assenting to the literature the leader role has changed in direction of adapting the behaviour or leading approach based on the complexity of the environment that organizations are facing today. As anticipated the paper in fact, finds positive correlation of literature theory and practical use of several complex adaptive leadership aspects that the leadership of the mining conglomerate can consider during the reorganization process, with the purpose of adjusting their role accordingly to the complexity of the environment of the organization.

title: Fighting for Democracy: Companies' Sustainable Investments in the Political Arena
affiliations: ESCP Europe Business School Berlin and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Fighting for Democracy: Companies' Sustainable Investments in the Political Arena

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Companies depend on a viable political system, which in Western democracies has come under pressure due to populist movements. In this paper, we present corporate political responsibility based on strong sustainability. To illustrate this concept, we describe how some companies operate as political actors and actively position themselves against antidemocratic forces. By investing in political activities, companies can contribute to a sustainable strengthening of Western democracies. This new political role of corporations, which goes beyond lobbying and donations, deepens our understanding of corporations as political actors.
