title: Au-delà de la valeur financière : un appel à recourir aux indicateurs de l'économie circulaire pour soutenir les entreprises à mission (Beyond Financial Value: A Call to Use Circular Economy Indicators to Support Purpose-Driven Companies)
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Au-delà de la valeur financière : un appel à recourir aux indicateurs de l'économie circulaire pour soutenir les entreprises à mission (Beyond Financial Value: A Call to Use Circular Economy Indicators to Support Purpose-Driven Companies)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: Cet article est un appel à la transition des plus grandes entreprises vers le business for good. Nous mettons en évidence la nécessité de basculer d'un mode de création de valeur linéaire vers un modèle circulaire et insistons pour que les instruments actuels d'évaluation des entreprises soient adaptés afin de remplacer la primauté de l'actionnaire par une vision intégrale de la valeur, prenant en compte les performances sociales et environnementales. Nous illustrons d'abord ce propos par une initiative méconnue mise en place au début des années 2010 entre deux multinationales qui ont entrepris d'intégrer les principes de l'économie circulaire à leurs chaînes d'approvisionnement. H.J Heinz et Ford Motors aspiraient à poursuivre des objectifs sociaux et environnementaux dans le cadre de leurs activités, mais ont finalement dû abandonner cette démarche en raison de la vision exclusivement axée profit des principaux actionnaires des groupes. Par la suite, nous appelons à une approche globale de l'évaluation de la performance et soulignons l'utilité des indicateurs de circularité, pour aider les entreprises à maintenir des objectifs à dimensions multiples.

English Abstract: This article is a call for the transition of large corporations toward business for good. We highlight the need to shift from a linear value creation model to a circular one, and we stress the importance of adapting current business evaluation tools so that shareholder primacy is replaced by a holistic view of value that incorporates social and environmental performance. We first illustrate this point with a little-known initiative launched in the early 2010s between two multinationals that sought to integrate circular economy principles into their supply chains. H.J. Heinz and Ford Motors aimed to pursue social and environmental objectives within their activities but ultimately had to abandon the initiative due to the profit-focused outlook of their major shareholders. We then call for a comprehensive approach to performance evaluation and underline the usefulness of circularity indicators to help companies maintain multi-dimensional objectives.

title: Des chaînes de valeur globales aux relocalisations : une « transition durable » ? (From Global Value Chains to Reshoring: A “Sustainable Transition”?)
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Des chaînes de valeur globales aux relocalisations : une « transition durable » ? (From Global Value Chains to Reshoring: A “Sustainable Transition”?)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: Malgré la visibilité médiatique des relocalisations et les pressions politiques croissantes pour les encourager, des incertitudes persistent quant à la viabilité d'une remise en question profonde des chaînes de valeur globales complexes et établies depuis plusieurs décennies. Par ailleurs, les décisions de relocalisation reposent rarement sur des considérations d'une économie effectivement plus vertueuse et l'effet bénéfique des relocalisations sur l'empreinte sociale et environnementale est moins clair qu'il n'y paraît. En nous appuyant sur des travaux existants et notre connaissance du sujet, nous montrons que les relocalisations massives n'auront pas lieu et que l'amélioration de l'impact social et environnemental des chaînes de valeur proviendra de trois effets : relocaliser mieux, améliorer l'empreinte des délocalisations et transformer les chaînes de valeur et organisations industrielles.

English Abstract: Despite the media visibility of reshoring and the growing political pressures to encourage it, uncertainties remain regarding the feasibility of a deep reconsideration of complex global value chains that have been established over several decades. Moreover, reshoring decisions rarely rely on considerations of a truly more virtuous economy, and the beneficial effect of reshoring on social and environmental footprints is less clear than it might appear. Based on existing research and our knowledge of the subject, we show that massive reshoring will not occur, and that improvements in the social and environmental impact of value chains will result from three effects: reshoring more effectively, improving the footprint of offshoring, and transforming value chains and industrial organizations.

AI.tldr: 本文认为大规模产业回流不会发生，价值链的社会和环境改善将来自三个方面：更有效的回流、改善离岸外包的足迹、以及价值链和产业组织的转型。
AI.research_question: 产业回流是否可行？其对价值链社会和环境足迹的改善效果如何？
AI.motivation: 尽管产业回流在媒体上备受关注且政治压力日益增大，但对其可行性和实际环境社会效益存在不确定性。

title: Le départ du DG de Danone : couple risque-rentabilité ou trépied risque-rentabilité-soutenabilité ? L'intégration de la soutenabilité dans l'équation financière (The Departure of Danone’s CEO: Risk-Return Couple or Risk-Return-Sustainability Tripod? Integrating Sustainability into the Financial Equation)
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Le départ du DG de Danone : couple risque-rentabilité ou trépied risque-rentabilité-soutenabilité ? L'intégration de la soutenabilité dans l'équation financière (The Departure of Danone’s CEO: Risk-Return Couple or Risk-Return-Sustainability Tripod? Integrating Sustainability into the Financial Equation)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: En mars 2021, le directeur général de Danone, bien connu pour son engagement en faveur de la durabilité, a été licencié en raison de mauvaises performances financières. Face à cette apparente opposition entre indicateurs financiers et extra-financiers, nous introduisons un trépied risque-rentabilité-soutenabilité pour analyser cette décision du point de vue des actionnaires. Nous montrons que même pour un actionnaire "responsable", les indicateurs financiers sont toujours importants, et qu'un équilibre est nécessaire entre les trois paramètres du trépied. En appliquant ce trépied à deux secteurs différents, nous montrons que différents segments d'actionnaires peuvent coexister dans le capital d'une entreprise.

English Abstract: In March 2021, the CEO of Danone, well-known for his commitment to sustainability, was dismissed due to poor financial performance. Faced with this apparent conflict between financial and extra-financial indicators, we introduce a risk-return-sustainability tripod to analyze this decision from the shareholders’ perspective. We show that even for a “responsible” shareholder, financial indicators remain important, and a balance among the three parameters of the tripod is necessary. By applying this tripod to two different sectors, we demonstrate that different segments of shareholders can coexist within a company’s capital.

AI.tldr: 该论文引入风险-回报-可持续性三支柱框架，分析达能CEO因财务表现不佳被解雇的事件，证明即使对负责任股东而言，财务指标仍然重要，需要在三支柱间保持平衡。
AI.research_question: 股东视角下，财务指标与非财务指标（如可持续性）之间是否存在冲突？如何在风险、回报和可持续性之间取得平衡？
AI.motivation: 达能CEO因财务表现不佳被解雇，尽管其以可持续性承诺著称，这引发了财务与非财务指标之间明显冲突的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 风险-回报-可持续性三支柱框架，用于分析股东决策视角下的企业绩效评估。
AI.method: 案例分析法（达能CEO解雇事件），并将三支柱框架应用于两个不同行业进行验证。
AI.findings: 即使对负责任股东而言，财务指标仍然重要；需要在风险、回报和可持续性三支柱间保持平衡；不同股东群体可以在公司资本中共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出风险-回报-可持续性三支柱理论框架，扩展了传统股东价值理论，将可持续性纳入核心考量维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理层和股东提供平衡财务与非财务目标的决策框架，帮助理解不同类型股东的利益诉求和共存机制。

detail.abstract: Effective project communications management is critical to project success. It guarantees that the project team, stakeholders, and any other parties engaged are all on the same page. This mutual awareness of project goals, roles, and expectations reduces misunderstandings and conflicts. Throughout the project's lifecycle, effective communication keeps stakeholders involved, maintains their support, and assists in managing their expectations. Furthermore, it aids in the early identification and resolution of issues, which is critical for preventing problems from escalating. Proper communication also allows for informed decision-making, risk management, quality control, and useful project documentation for future reference.

title: Epistemic Responsibility: A Missing Dimension of Corporate Social Responsibility
affiliations: ESCP Europe and ESCP Europe

detail.title: Epistemic Responsibility: A Missing Dimension of Corporate Social Responsibility

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Corporate social responsibility covers a wide range of social, environmental and ethical concerns, but the epistemic dimension of this social responsibility, which concerns the reliability of the information disseminated, is generally ignored. Yet, if material pollution is a threat to the environment, epistemic pollution-fake-news, "business bullshit", misinformation, and so on-is a threat to society and the economy, and reflections on sustainability should also address this topic. By drawing on the current debates concerning Section 230 of the Communications Decency Act ("230 CDA") in the United States, which allows Internet service providers not to be liable for the possible falsity of the information they diffuse, we will show why this epistemic dimension should be taken into account, and how it could be.

AI.tldr: 该论文认为企业社会责任应包含认知维度（信息可靠性），指出认知污染（假新闻、商业废话等）对社会和经济的威胁，并通过分析美国《通信规范法案》第230条来论证如何将认知维度纳入企业社会责任框架。
AI.research_question: 企业社会责任为何以及如何应该包含认知维度（信息可靠性）？
AI.motivation: 当前企业社会责任主要关注社会、环境和伦理问题，但忽视了认知维度（信息可靠性）。认知污染（假新闻、商业废话、错误信息等）对社会和经济构成威胁，可持续发展思考也应涉及这一主题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业社会责任理论、认知责任理论、信息可靠性理论
AI.method: 通过分析美国《通信规范法案》第230条的当前辩论，探讨互联网服务提供商对传播信息真实性的责任豁免问题
AI.findings: 认知污染对社会和经济构成严重威胁，企业社会责任框架应该包含认知维度，互联网服务提供商等企业应对其传播信息的可靠性承担责任
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业社会责任的理论边界，提出了认知维度的概念，丰富了企业社会责任的理论框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业实践提供了将认知责任纳入企业社会责任的路径，对政策制定者重新审视互联网平台责任具有参考价值

title: The Impact of Leadership Styles on Service Quality and Customer Satisfaction: A Comparative Analysis Between Foreign and Domestic Capital Banks in Kosovo
affiliations: , AAB College and

detail.title: The Impact of Leadership Styles on Service Quality and Customer Satisfaction: A Comparative Analysis Between Foreign and Domestic Capital Banks in Kosovo
detail.abstract: This study measured the impact of leadership styles on service quality and the impact of service quality on customer satisfaction. In addition, it analyzed whether there is a difference in service quality and customer satisfaction between banks by categorizing them by capital types. The quantitative method was used to achieve the objectives. The sample comprised 360 employees of Kosovo banks, where 99 employees were from banks with domestic capital, and 261 were from foreign capital banks. According to the OLS model, the authoritarian style has a more significant impact on the service quality in banks with foreign capital. In contrast, in banks with domestic capital, a transactional style significantly impacts service quality. According to the t-test, there is a statistically significant relationship between consumer satisfaction and banks with foreign and domestic capital, with the greatest consumer satisfaction in banks with foreign capital. However, considering the service quality, the t-test showed a non-significant result, which means that there is no difference in the service quality between the two categories of banks. This paper found that the leadership style has a higher effect on the service quality of the two categories of banks, recommending that banks fill the gap between the style used and the one that affects the service quality best. Banks also received feedback on customer satisfaction to strengthen SERVQUAL model components, improving service quality and increasing customer satisfaction.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了领导风格对服务质量的影响，以及服务质量对客户满意度的影响，并分析了不同资本类型银行在服务质量和客户满意度方面的差异。研究发现，在外国资本银行中，专制领导风格对服务质量影响更大；在国内资本银行中，交易型领导风格对服务质量影响显著。外国资本银行的客户满意度更高，但两类银行的服务质量无显著差异。
AI.research_question: 领导风格如何影响银行服务质量？服务质量如何影响客户满意度？不同资本类型的银行在服务质量和客户满意度方面是否存在差异？
AI.motivation: 了解领导风格对银行服务质量的影响机制，以及不同资本结构银行在服务质量和客户满意度方面的表现差异，为银行管理提供实践指导。
AI.theoretical_framework: 领导风格理论（专制风格、交易型风格）、服务质量理论、客户满意度理论、资本类型分类理论
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用OLS模型和t检验，样本包括科索沃360名银行员工（99名来自国内资本银行，261名来自外国资本银行）
AI.findings: 1. 在外国资本银行中，专制领导风格对服务质量影响更大；2. 在国内资本银行中，交易型领导风格对服务质量影响显著；3. 外国资本银行的客户满意度显著高于国内资本银行；4. 两类银行的服务质量无显著差异
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了领导风格与服务质量关系的研究，揭示了不同资本结构下领导风格影响的差异性，拓展了服务质量理论的应用边界
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理者提供领导风格选择的指导建议，帮助银行优化领导风格以提升服务质量，通过加强SERVQUAL模型组件来提高客户满意度

title: Business Education Meets Planetary Boundaries: How to Teach Energy and Climate in Business Schools?
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Business Education Meets Planetary Boundaries: How to Teach Energy and Climate in Business Schools?

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Beyond reframing each management discipline, sustainability education involves a deep disciplinary renewal within management education. Such renewal is necessary to build a deep, transversal and systemic understanding of sustainability grand-challenges, and to realize how business activities are affected by planetary boundaries. After exposing the centrality of energy and climate issues in sustainability, this article builds on a new 30h course-Energy: Business, Climate & Geopolitics-started in 2021 at ESCP Business School-to reflect on the major pedagogical choices and outcomes. After considering the need for large-scale and systemic changes required to address the energy and climate challenges, we reflect on five general-and disquieting-observations about business and the climate transition.

AI.tldr: 该论文探讨了可持续发展教育中管理学科的深层更新，重点分析了能源与气候问题在可持续发展中的核心地位，并基于ESCP商学院2021年开设的"能源：商业、气候与地缘政治"课程，反思了主要教学选择和成果。
AI.research_question: 如何在管理教育中实现可持续发展所需的深层学科更新，以建立对可持续发展重大挑战的深刻、横向和系统性理解？

AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展教育理论、系统思维、地球边界理论、能源转型理论
AI.method: 基于ESCP商学院2021年开设的30小时"能源：商业、气候与地缘政治"课程的教学实践反思

AI.theory_contributions: 为管理教育中的可持续发展学科更新提供了理论框架和实践路径，强调了能源和气候问题的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了具体的课程设计和教学实践案例，为商学院可持续发展教育提供了可借鉴的模式。

title: Good Deeds Across the Board: How Organisations Can Foster Prosocial Behaviour Across Domains
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Good Deeds Across the Board: How Organisations Can Foster Prosocial Behaviour Across Domains

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: There have been increasing discussions about the role that businesses play in mobilising their employees' and customers' prosocial behaviours to deliver social impact. However, previous studies tend to focus on one social issue and in one context. Our paper looks at businesses as employers, enablers of technology, and producers of goods and services, and showcases the triggers of and the boundary conditions for how organisations can affect prosocial behaviours across different domains.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨企业如何通过作为雇主、技术赋能者和产品服务提供者三种角色，在不同领域触发和影响员工及顾客的亲社会行为，并分析其边界条件。
AI.research_question: 组织如何在不同领域影响亲社会行为？触发因素和边界条件是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究多集中于单一社会问题和单一情境，缺乏对企业多重角色下亲社会行为影响机制的全面理解。
AI.theoretical_framework: 亲社会行为理论、企业社会责任理论、组织行为学理论
AI.method: 未在摘要中明确说明
AI.findings: 企业作为雇主、技术赋能者和产品服务提供者三种角色都能触发亲社会行为，但存在特定的触发因素和边界条件。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了企业影响亲社会行为的理论框架，从单一情境扩展到多领域分析。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业设计有效的亲社会行为干预策略提供实践指导，帮助企业在不同角色下最大化社会影响力。

title: Ikonomy and the Dictature of Images
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Ikonomy and the Dictature of Images

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper attempts to better define the concept of ikonomy which amalgamates economy with the Greek etymology of image, "ikon". As images have become channeled, data streams that coagulate here and there in changing formats, ikonomy is based on the fact that visibility has become the condition for the existence of human beings, things, opinions. Through their apparent immateriality, images apparently symbolize the false freedom that characterizes our societies, while facial recognition programs are constantly being developed without our knowledge, from the misappropriation of our photographs and millions of selfies. As if we were the main source of control of ourselves. As we will demonstrate, this complete instrumentalization of the image, constitutes the historical novelty of this smart dictatorship.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"图像经济"（ikonomy）概念，将经济与图像相结合，探讨在数字时代中可见性如何成为人类、事物和观点存在的条件。作者认为图像表面上象征自由，实则通过面部识别等技术成为控制工具，构成了一种新型的智能独裁。
AI.research_question: 如何定义和解释"图像经济"（ikonomy）这一概念，以及它如何反映当代社会中图像与控制的复杂关系？
AI.motivation: 随着图像变成数据流并以不同格式聚合，可见性已成为人类、事物和观点存在的条件。图像表面的非物质性掩盖了其作为控制工具的本质，面部识别程序在未经我们同意的情况下不断发展，构成了新型的智能独裁。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结合经济学与图像学理论，提出"图像经济"概念，探讨可见性政治、数字控制论和当代社会中的权力关系。
AI.method: 概念分析和理论建构，通过批判性分析图像在数字时代的角色和功能来发展理论框架。
AI.findings: 图像经济揭示了当代社会中图像的双重性：表面上象征自由，实际上成为控制工具；可见性成为存在的前提条件；我们自身成为控制的主要来源。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"图像经济"这一创新概念，为理解数字时代中图像、经济和控制之间的关系提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 揭示了面部识别等技术如何在不为人知的情况下发展，提醒公众关注数字隐私和控制问题，为政策制定和技术伦理提供参考。

title: From brand Management to Brand Governmentality
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: From brand Management to Brand Governmentality

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Brands are usually analyzed either from an agency perspective or from a media perspective through which they are considered to be cultural catalysts and forms of relationships to be built between stakeholders. The rising importance of the idea of brand purpose confronts us with a new paradigm which goes largely beyond a managerial paradigm. What we propose in this paper is to look at brands from the perspective of governmentality as it was defined by Michel Foucault, that is an activity meant to shape, guide or affect the conducts of people's lives. It appears to be an interesting paradigm to understand how brands can promote virtuous behaviours enabling a change in the lives of individuals and societies.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从福柯的治理术视角分析品牌，将品牌视为塑造和引导人们行为的治理活动，探讨品牌如何促进美德行为并改变个体和社会生活。
AI.research_question: 如何从治理术的视角理解品牌作为塑造和引导人们行为的治理活动？
AI.motivation: 品牌目的理念的重要性日益凸显，这超越了传统管理范式，需要新的分析框架来理解品牌如何影响个体和社会行为。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于米歇尔·福柯的治理术理论，将品牌视为一种治理活动，旨在塑造、引导或影响人们的生活行为。
AI.method: 理论分析框架，通过福柯的治理术概念重新解读品牌现象。
AI.findings: 治理术视角为理解品牌如何促进美德行为并实现个体和社会生活的改变提供了有价值的分析框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 将福柯的治理术理论引入品牌研究，为品牌分析提供了新的理论视角，超越了传统的代理和媒介视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为品牌管理者提供了理解品牌社会影响力的新框架，帮助品牌更好地设计和实施促进积极社会变革的策略。

title: Transformative and Emancipatory Pedagogies in Education for Sustainable Development: The Integrative Experience of Individual Reflective Notes
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Transformative and Emancipatory Pedagogies in Education for Sustainable Development: The Integrative Experience of Individual Reflective Notes

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The topic of this paper relates to pedagogical innovations mobilizing the personal level of student experience in education for sustainable development (ESD). Seeking to stimulate self-awareness and critical thinking, transformative and emancipatory pedagogies complement the repertoire of transmissive and instrumental pedagogies typically deployed in the ESD curricula of higher education institutions. A device comprising an individual reflective note (IRN) on personal consumption was deployed in an international marketing course on four groups of students at Master's level. The pedagogical feedback from this first wave of IRN writing suggests that such devices can be easily constructed and proposed in training curricula to create an integrative experience capable of articulating the contributions of the four main pedagogies of ESD (transmissive, instrumental, transformative and emancipatory).

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了在可持续发展教育中运用学生个人经验的教学创新，通过个人反思笔记这一工具，将传递式、工具式、变革式和解放式四种主要教学法整合起来。
AI.research_question: 如何在可持续发展教育中通过个人反思笔记等教学工具，整合四种主要教学法（传递式、工具式、变革式和解放式）？
AI.motivation: 现有的可持续发展教育课程主要采用传递式和工具式教学法，缺乏激发学生自我意识和批判性思维的变革式和解放式教学法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展教育的四种主要教学法：传递式、工具式、变革式和解放式教学法。
AI.method: 在国际营销课程中，对四个硕士生小组部署了关于个人消费的个人反思笔记写作设备。
AI.findings: 个人反思笔记可以轻松构建并纳入培训课程，创造能够整合四种主要可持续发展教育教学法的综合体验。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了将四种可持续发展教育教学法整合的理论框架，丰富了可持续发展教育的教学理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了可操作的教学工具（个人反思笔记），帮助教育工作者在实际教学中实现教学法的整合应用。

title: An Analysis of the Institute of Dissolution of the Assembly: A Case of the Emerging Democracies
affiliations: AAB College and AAB College

detail.title: An Analysis of the Institute of Dissolution of the Assembly: A Case of the Emerging Democracies
detail.abstract: This topic is about the process of parliamentary democracy.  The institute of dissolution of the assembly in the Republic of  Kosovo is complicated by a complex procedure. Dissolution of parliament is one of the most serious tools that may be used by the executive power against the parliament, where such power can dissolve the legislative council before the end of the term provided under the Constitution (Al Momani, 2018). This study aims to analyze the institute of dissolution of the assembly in developing countries and emerging democracies. The research model was based on the comparative study and normative method. Furthermore, this study focuses on 1) making a review analysis of the institute of dissolution of the Assembly of the Republic of  Kosovo, like a developing country; 2) identifying the differences and similarities between the institute of dissolution of the Assembly of the Republic of Kosovo with that of Albania; 3) the most frequent reasons that leading to the dissolution of the parliament in Kosovo. The main findings of the study show that the most frequent reasons for the dissolution of parliament are weak parliamentary majorities in countries with developing democracies such as Kosovo and economic and political crises in the country as a result of economic and social problems.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了科索沃议会解散制度，通过比较研究探讨发展中国家和新兴民主国家中议会解散的程序、原因和影响，重点关注科索沃与阿尔巴尼亚的异同。
AI.research_question: 发展中国家和新兴民主国家中议会解散制度的运作机制、原因和影响是什么？
AI.motivation: 科索沃议会解散程序复杂，这是行政权力对抗议会的最严重工具之一，在发展中国家民主进程中具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 议会民主理论、行政-立法关系理论、发展中国家民主制度比较研究
AI.method: 比较研究法和规范分析法
AI.findings: 科索沃议会解散的最常见原因是议会多数席位薄弱，以及经济和政治危机导致的经济社会问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对发展中国家议会解散制度的理解，丰富了新兴民主国家行政-立法关系理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃等发展中国家完善议会解散程序提供实践参考，促进民主制度的稳定发展。

title: From Awareness to Engagement: How can Impact Pedagogy Educate Future Sustainable Leaders?
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: From Awareness to Engagement: How can Impact Pedagogy Educate Future Sustainable Leaders?

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This paper aims at characterizing what can be called an "impact pedagogy". Building on the literature on sustainability education in business (Béchard, 2017, Schiro, 2013, Hermes and Rimaczy, 2018, Kassel et al. 2016), we examine the impact of an innovative induction seminar called "Designing Tomorrow: Business & Sustainability" created at ESCP Business School in spring 2019. We explore more specifically the following questions: How can students' learning processes contribute to making an effective impact on a more sustainable approach in business? What are the main characteristics of the pedagogical design that enable the empowerment of students? The empirical data come from the description and assessment of the pedagogical design encompassing a 3-day seminar, followed by a 3-month field investigation on a controversy related to business transformation issues due to climate change. A specific focus is given to two classes in which a partnership was developed with an insightful change-maker, Eric Duverger-ESCP alumnus and former top executive of Michelin. He offered the students the opportunity to work on a field investigation in order to help him prepare a transformative project for corporations, called "Convention des Entreprises pour le Climat". Our study reveals that a virtuous loop was created between the students and the partner thanks to the specific learning dynamics of the seminar, which we call "impact pedagogy". The empowering effect of impact pedagogy can explain the transition from awarenessraising to effective engagement of both students and partner, leading to the creation of the "Convention des Entreprises pour le Climat" which aims to enroll 150 CEOs in July 2021.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"影响力教学法"概念，通过ESCP商学院2019年春季的创新研讨课"设计明天：商业与可持续性"，研究如何通过学生学习过程促进企业可持续转型，并分析赋能学生的教学设计特征。研究发现学生与合作伙伴之间形成了良性循环，从意识提升到有效参与，最终创建了旨在招募150位CEO的"企业气候公约"。
AI.research_question: 学生的学习过程如何促进企业更可持续的方法产生有效影响？赋能学生的主要教学设计特征是什么？
AI.motivation: 基于可持续商业教育文献，探索创新教学法如何推动商业可持续转型，特别关注学生赋能和实际影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续商业教育理论（Béchard, 2017; Schiro, 2013; Hermes and Rimaczy, 2018; Kassel et al. 2016）
AI.method: 实证研究：描述和评估包含3天研讨课和3个月实地调查的教学设计，特别关注与变革推动者Eric Duverger合作的两个班级。
AI.findings: 创建了学生与合作伙伴之间的良性循环，通过"影响力教学法"的学习动态，实现了从意识到有效参与的转变，促成了"企业气候公约"的创建。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"影响力教学法"概念，丰富了可持续商业教育理论，揭示了学习过程与实际行动之间的转化机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了有效的教学模型，促成了实际的企业气候行动项目（"企业气候公约"），为商学院可持续教育提供了可复制的实践方案。

title: Shaping Future Success: Evidence from an Early Childhood Human Capital Formation Intervention
affiliations: University of Connecticut - Department of Economics, World Bank, Allegheny County Department of Human Services, , Northeastern University (USA) and University of Connecticut

detail.title: Shaping Future Success: Evidence from an Early Childhood Human Capital Formation Intervention

publicationDetails.journalName: CESifo Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Nearly 200 million children under five in low- and middle-income countries face developmental deficits, even as access to early childhood services expands. We present evidence from a largescale randomized controlled trial (N=3,131 children in 201 schools) in Nepal’s government system testing three models of combining classroom quality with parental engagement. All teachers completed a 15-day training on pedagogy, national standards, and caregiver engagement, after which schools were randomly assigned to models varying whether caregiver sessions were led by teachers alone, by teachers supported with in-class helpers, or by external facilitators. The intervention increased children’s developmental outcomes by 0.10–0.20 standard deviations and improved caregiver engagement by similar magnitudes. Effects were most consistent when teachers received support that sustained classroom quality while engaging families, underscoring the critical role of workload management. Impacts were concentrated among disadvantaged households—those with lower baseline engagement, higher stress, and less education—with ASQ gains largest among children with the lowest baseline scores and improvements in parental engagement (PESL) strongest among those with higher initial levels. Mechanism analysis shows the program shifted home and school inputs from substitutes to complements, creating mutually reinforcing pathways for child development. These findings demonstrate that modest, system-embedded reforms can generate scalable improvements in early childhood human capital formation while reducing inequalities.

AI.tldr: 在尼泊尔进行的随机对照试验表明，结合课堂质量与家长参与的干预措施能显著改善儿童发展结果，特别是对弱势家庭效果更明显，且能将家庭和学校投入从替代关系转变为互补关系。
AI.research_question: 在低收入和中等收入国家，如何通过结合课堂质量提升与家长参与的不同模式来改善儿童早期发展结果？
AI.motivation: 尽管早期儿童服务的覆盖面在扩大，但低收入和中等收入国家仍有近2亿五岁以下儿童面临发展缺陷，需要找到可扩展的解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于儿童发展的人力资本形成理论，关注家庭与学校投入的互补关系。
AI.method: 大规模随机对照试验（3,131名儿童，201所学校），测试三种结合课堂质量与家长参与的模式：教师单独主导、教师支持课堂助手、外部协调员支持。
AI.findings: 干预使儿童发展结果提高0.10-0.20个标准差，家长参与度也类似提升。当教师获得支持以维持课堂质量同时与家庭互动时效果最一致。效果集中在弱势家庭，机制分析显示项目将家庭和学校投入从替代关系转变为互补关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了家庭与学校投入从替代到互补关系的转变机制，为儿童发展的人力资本理论提供了新证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 展示了适度、系统嵌入的改革可以在早期儿童人力资本形成中产生可扩展的改进，同时减少不平等，为政策制定提供了可行的干预模式。

title: Performance Evaluation of DSR and GRP under Black Hole Attack
affiliations: Punjabi University Regional Centre for Information Technology and Management Mohali

detail.title: Performance Evaluation of DSR and GRP under Black Hole Attack
detail.abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Network is a dynamic network which formed by collection of wireless nodes without any centralized support. Due its features mobile ad hoc network is more prone to security attacks.Black Hole Attack is one of them.Back hole attack is type of security attack in which all data packets routed towards node which not actually exist it drop all data packets.This research paper evaluate the performance of two mobile ad hoc network routing protocols DSR and GRP under black hole attack on certain parameters like end-to-end delay, network load and throughput.OPNET Modeler 14.5 is used as simulation tool. On the basis of observation it found GRP performs better as compared to DSR under black hole attack.

AI.tldr: 本文评估了移动自组织网络中DSR和GRP路由协议在黑洞攻击下的性能表现，发现GRP协议在黑洞攻击下表现优于DSR协议。
AI.research_question: 移动自组织网络中DSR和GRP路由协议在黑洞攻击下的性能表现如何？
AI.motivation: 移动自组织网络由于其动态性和无中心化特性，更容易受到安全攻击，黑洞攻击是其中一种常见攻击方式，会丢弃所有数据包。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动自组织网络路由协议理论，包括DSR（动态源路由）和GRP（地理路由协议）的工作原理和特性。
AI.method: 使用OPNET Modeler 14.5作为仿真工具，通过模拟黑洞攻击场景，评估两种协议在端到端延迟、网络负载和吞吐量等参数上的表现。
AI.findings: GRP协议在黑洞攻击下的性能表现优于DSR协议。
AI.theory_contributions: 为移动自组织网络路由协议在安全攻击下的性能评估提供了实证研究，验证了不同协议对黑洞攻击的抵抗能力差异。
AI.practical_contributions: 为移动自组织网络的实际部署提供了路由协议选择建议，在存在安全威胁的环境中推荐使用GRP协议以获得更好的性能表现。

title: Organizing in a fluid social media sphere: the empowering and disempowering effects of ownership, openness, and stakeholder engagement through an affordance perspective
affiliations: Ca Foscari University of Venice - Department of Management, Neoma Business School and Ca Foscari University of Venice - Department of Management

detail.title: Organizing in a fluid social media sphere: the empowering and disempowering effects of ownership, openness, and stakeholder engagement through an affordance perspective

declarations.funderStatement: This research was developed within the Project “SoMe4Dem.Social media for democracy– understanding the causal mechanisms of digital citizenship”, financed by the European Union’s Horizon Europe Programme under Grant Agreement No. 101094752.

publicationDetails.detailsText: Venice School of Management - Department of Management Working Paper No. 7
publicationDetails.journalName: Venice School of Management - Department of Management Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: Examining social media architecture and affordances, this paper explores three key dimensions central to the functioning of social media in democratic societies: ownership, openness, and stakeholder engagement. The aim is to propose a new research agenda that bridges critical management and organizational studies with social media studies, examining how the architectural ownership choices of certain social media platforms shape the intertwined dimensions of openness and stakeholder engagement. First, it briefly defines what social media platforms afford in the public sphere. Afterwards, it examines openness and stakeholder engagement as fluid organizing principles adopted by users on social media platforms. Then it explores how social media ownership can lead to either empowering or disempowering effects on the community of users. Lastly, it offers a list of research questions for potential paths forward in empirical research.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨社交媒体架构与可供性的三个关键维度：所有权、开放性和利益相关者参与，旨在提出连接批判管理与组织研究同社交媒体研究的新研究议程，分析社交媒体平台的所有权选择如何影响开放性和利益相关者参与的相互作用。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体平台的所有权选择如何塑造开放性和利益相关者参与这两个相互交织的维度？
AI.motivation: 连接批判管理与组织研究同社交媒体研究，探讨社交媒体架构在民主社会中的功能，特别是所有权结构如何影响平台的开放性和利益相关者参与。
AI.theoretical_framework: 社交媒体架构与可供性理论、批判管理研究、组织研究、公共领域理论
AI.method: 概念性分析框架，通过理论整合和维度分析来构建研究议程
AI.findings: 提出了社交媒体研究的三个核心维度（所有权、开放性、利益相关者参与）及其相互关系，展示了所有权选择可能对用户社区产生赋权或去权效应

title: Comparative Analysis of DSR, GRP and TORA under IPv6 Environment
affiliations: Punjabi University Regional Centre for Information Technology and Management Mohali

detail.title: Comparative Analysis of DSR, GRP and TORA under IPv6 Environment
detail.abstract: Mobile Ad Hoc Network is a dynamic network which formed by collection of wireless nodes without any centralized support. Nodes are mobile in mobile ad hoc network and free to move anywhere in network. Due to the mobility of nodes it is difficult to route data between nodes Thus it is challenging to select an appropriate routing protocol, which route data more efficiently. Each routing protocol has its own architecture and working. It is obligatory to analyze the behavior different routing protocols under different environments. IPv6 is a version of internet protocol and got importance because it has some additional features and more secure than IPv4.In this paper three routing protocols of mobile ad hoc network namely DSR, GRP and TORA are tested under IPv6 environment. Performance of these routing protocols is evaluated by using OPNET Modeler 14.5 as simulation tool on the basis of different performance metrics-End-To-End Delay, Network Load and Throughput. On the basis of simulation results it concluded that GRP performs better which stated that it is suitable for efficient routing.

AI.tldr: 本文在IPv6环境下测试了移动自组织网络中的三种路由协议（DSR、GRP和TORA），使用OPNET Modeler 14.5进行仿真，基于端到端延迟、网络负载和吞吐量等性能指标评估协议性能，发现GRP表现最佳，适合高效路由。
AI.research_question: 在IPv6环境下，移动自组织网络中哪种路由协议（DSR、GRP、TORA）表现最佳？
AI.motivation: 移动自组织网络节点具有移动性，数据路由困难，需要选择合适的路由协议；IPv6相比IPv4具有更多特性和更高安全性，需要分析不同路由协议在IPv6环境下的性能表现。
AI.theoretical_framework: 移动自组织网络理论、IPv6协议特性、路由协议架构（DSR、GRP、TORA）
AI.method: 使用OPNET Modeler 14.5仿真工具，在IPv6环境下测试三种路由协议，基于端到端延迟、网络负载和吞吐量等性能指标进行评估
AI.findings: GRP路由协议在IPv6环境下表现最佳，适合高效路由
AI.theory_contributions: 为移动自组织网络在IPv6环境下的路由协议选择提供了理论依据，验证了GRP协议在IPv6环境下的优越性能
AI.practical_contributions: 为移动自组织网络的实际部署提供了路由协议选择指导，帮助网络设计者选择最适合IPv6环境的高效路由协议

title: From Narrative to Action: Are Business Schools Finally Walking the Talk of Responsible Management Education?
affiliations: ESCP Business School and ESCP Business School

detail.title: From Narrative to Action: Are Business Schools Finally Walking the Talk of Responsible Management Education?

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Business schools are higher education institutions specialized in educating the current and future generation of business leaders and as such have an enormous educational power and duty. Whilst in recent global crises, e.g. the 2008 financial crisis, business schools were considered to be part of the problem, not having educated their students in acting responsibly, the Covid-19 pandemic can be seen as the opportunity for business schools to regain legitimacy. This impact paper presents the rapid and novel responses to Covid-19 that were undertaken by business schools and its implications toward a more responsible management education (RME).

title: Servant Leadership and Organizational Performance - Evidence from Bali and Manado
affiliations: De La Salle University, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University, Sam Ratulangi University and University of Debrecen

detail.title: Servant Leadership and Organizational Performance - Evidence from Bali and Manado
detail.abstract:
This study investigates the influence of servant leadership on organizational
performance by examining the mediating roles of competence, value co-creation, and leader–
member exchange (LMX). Drawing upon human capital theory, service-dominant logic, and
social exchange theory, the research positions servant leadership as both a direct driver of
performance and an enabler of mediating mechanisms. Using a quantitative, explanatory
research design, data were collected through structured surveys distributed to 650 participants.
However, only 300 responses from employees and managers in service and knowledge-
intensive organizations met the validity, reliability, and bias criteria. Partial Least Squares–
Structural Equation Modeling (PLS-SEM) was employed to test the proposed hypotheses. The
findings reveal that servant leadership significantly enhances organizational performance both
directly and indirectly. Competence, value co-creation, and LMX were confirmed as important
mediators, with LMX emerging as the strongest pathway linking servant leadership to
performance outcomes. The study highlights that servant leadership fosters employee
competence through empowerment and coaching, facilitates collaborative processes that
enable value co-creation, and strengthens trust-based leader–member relationships that drive
innovation, adaptability, and sustainability. By integrating these three mediating mechanisms
into a unified framework, this research contributes to leadership and organizational behavior
literature, providing both theoretical and practical insights. The results suggest that
organizations can achieve long-term competitiveness and resilience by adopting servant
leadership principles and aligning leadership development with competence-building, co-
creation practices, and relational trust.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了仆人式领导通过能力、价值共创和领导-成员交换(LMX)的中介作用对组织绩效的影响。研究发现仆人式领导既能直接提升绩效，也能通过这三种中介机制间接提升绩效，其中LMX是最强的中介路径。
AI.research_question: 仆人式领导如何通过能力、价值共创和领导-成员交换(LMX)的中介机制影响组织绩效？
AI.motivation: 理解仆人式领导对组织绩效的作用机制，为组织提供有效的领导力发展策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人力资本理论、服务主导逻辑、社会交换理论
AI.method: 定量解释性研究设计，采用结构化问卷调查，收集300份有效数据，使用偏最小二乘结构方程模型(PLS-SEM)进行假设检验
AI.findings: 仆人式领导显著直接和间接提升组织绩效；能力、价值共创和LMX是重要的中介变量，其中LMX是最强的中介路径；仆人式领导通过赋权和辅导培养员工能力，促进价值共创的协作过程，加强基于信任的领导-成员关系
AI.theory_contributions: 将三种中介机制整合到统一框架中，丰富了领导力和组织行为文献
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织实现长期竞争力和韧性提供指导，建议采用仆人式领导原则，并将领导力发展与能力建设、共创实践和关系信任相结合

title: Le changement climatique est un défi technologique (Climate Change Is a Technological Challenge)
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Le changement climatique est un défi technologique (Climate Change Is a Technological Challenge)

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract:
French Abstract: À rebours de la vision catastrophiste et anti-technologique de l'écologisme, cet article présente la lutte contre le changement climatique comme un défi technologique, en montrant que le décroissantisme peut devenir la première cause de la catastrophe qu'il prétend éviter. Une série de technologies prometteuses est proposée.

English Abstract: Contrary to the catastrophic and anti-technological vision of environmentalism, this article presents the fight against climate change as a technological challenge, showing that degrowth ideology could become the primary cause of the very catastrophe it claims to prevent. A series of promising technologies is proposed.

AI.tldr: 本文反对环保主义的反技术立场，认为应对气候变化是技术挑战，指出去增长主义可能成为其声称要避免的灾难的主要原因，并提出了一系列有前景的技术解决方案。
AI.research_question: 去增长主义是否真的能够有效应对气候变化，还是会成为气候灾难的主要原因？
AI.motivation: 反驳环保主义中的反技术和灾难性观点，强调技术创新的重要性，揭示去增长主义可能带来的负面后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于技术乐观主义和创新理论，批判去增长主义理论框架。
AI.method: 理论分析和论证，通过逻辑推理展示去增长主义的潜在危害。
AI.findings: 去增长主义可能适得其反，成为气候灾难的推动因素，而技术创新才是应对气候变化的有效途径。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了主流环保主义中的反技术叙事，为技术解决方案提供了理论支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了一系列具体的技术方案，为政策制定者和实践者提供了替代去增长主义的可行路径。

title: Quantifying Consumer-Product Fit: A Representation Learning Approach
affiliations: Bocconi University, Bocconi University, WU Vienna and Bocconi University

detail.title: Quantifying Consumer-Product Fit: A Representation Learning Approach
detail.abstract: This paper introduces a novel approach using neural embeddings to extract marketing insights from user-product interactions. Our method adapts the distributional hypothesis to consumer behavior, representing users and products as vectors in a shared latent space. This framework allows for the direct measurement of individual preferences from revealed-preference data. Using the Goodreads Book Graph Dataset, we demonstrate that this method can uncover hidden patterns in consumer tastes and provide new micro-level evidence for canonical marketing theories. This research offers valuable tools for academics studying market dynamics and practitioners developing marketing strategies for experiential goods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种使用神经嵌入从用户-产品交互中提取营销洞察的新方法，通过将用户和产品表示为共享潜在空间中的向量，能够直接从显示偏好数据中测量个体偏好。
AI.research_question: 如何利用神经嵌入方法从用户-产品交互数据中提取营销洞察？
AI.motivation: 传统方法难以从用户行为数据中直接测量个体偏好，需要一种能够有效捕捉消费者行为模式的新方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于分布假说在消费者行为中的应用，构建用户和产品在共享潜在空间中的向量表示框架。
AI.method: 使用神经嵌入技术，在Goodreads图书图谱数据集上验证方法有效性。
AI.findings: 该方法能够揭示消费者口味中的隐藏模式，并为经典营销理论提供微观层面的新证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分布假说扩展到消费者行为领域，为市场动态研究提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学者研究市场动态和从业者制定体验型商品的营销策略提供了有价值的工具。

title: Good Faith Competition as a Natural Mechanism for Sustainable Economic Growth
affiliations: ESCP Europe and ESCP Business School

detail.title: Good Faith Competition as a Natural Mechanism for Sustainable Economic Growth

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Under good faith competition, companies pursue sustainable competitive advantages, which can be defined as value-creating strategies that competitors cannot replicate. To develop and maintain those advantages over time, firms have to invest in tangible and intangible resources to stimulate innovation which is the key pillar for economic growth, employment, and welfare enhancement. We argue that a good faith competition market is a natural mechanism to incentivize firms to make sustainability more than just a buzzword, but rather to move sustainability from awareness to effective actions, thereby promoting sustainable economic growth.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了诚信竞争如何激励企业将可持续性从概念转化为实际行动，通过投资有形和无形资源来推动创新，从而获得可持续竞争优势并促进可持续经济增长。
AI.research_question: 诚信竞争市场如何激励企业将可持续性从意识转化为有效行动，并促进可持续经济增长？
AI.motivation: 企业需要在诚信竞争中追求可持续竞争优势，这要求它们投资于资源以刺激创新，而创新是经济增长、就业和福利提升的关键支柱。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续竞争优势理论、资源基础观、创新理论
AI.method: 理论分析和论证
AI.findings: 诚信竞争市场是激励企业将可持续性从口号转化为实际行动的自然机制，能够促进可持续经济增长。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了可持续竞争优势理论，提出了诚信竞争作为推动可持续性从意识到行动转化的机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了在诚信竞争环境中实现可持续竞争优势的实践指导，强调了投资创新资源的重要性。

title: Why should Business Embrace Sustainability? Lessons from the World's most Sustainable Energy Companies
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Why should Business Embrace Sustainability? Lessons from the World's most Sustainable Energy Companies

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Sustainability is on the cusp of an evolutionary leap. Companies all over the world are beginning to explore more sustainable ways of doing business, primarily due to the global climate emergency. They consider their long-term impact on the local environment, society, and the economy and ask whether their business makes a positive contribution. Becoming more sustainable may not be easy at first, but business sustainability is more an opportunity than a threat. The challenge is well worth the reward since there is no long-term trade-off between sustainability and financial value creation. Sustainable companies will be more resilient and create an enduring impact. This impact paper looks at the value of sustainability to business. First, it discusses the benefits as well as key strategies and challenges to increasing sustainability in business. Second, the link between energy efficiency and sustainability is examined. The business plan of the world's most sustainable energy companies is analysed, focusing on the lessons energy businesses can learn to become more sustainable.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了可持续发展对企业的价值，分析了可持续发展的益处、关键策略和挑战，以及能源效率与可持续发展的联系，并研究了全球最可持续能源公司的商业计划，为能源企业提供可持续发展经验。
AI.research_question: 可持续发展如何为企业创造价值？能源企业如何通过可持续发展策略提升竞争力？
AI.motivation: 全球气候紧急状况促使企业探索更可持续的经营方式，考虑对环境、社会和经济的长期影响，并评估其业务是否做出积极贡献。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可持续发展理论、企业社会责任理论、能源效率与可持续发展关联理论
AI.method: 文献综述、案例分析（分析全球最可持续能源公司的商业计划）
AI.findings: 可持续发展不仅是机遇而非威胁，而且与财务价值创造不存在长期权衡取舍；可持续企业更具韧性并能创造持久影响；能源效率是实现可持续发展的重要途径
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了可持续发展与企业价值创造关系的理论认识，建立了能源效率与可持续发展的理论联系框架
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业提供了可持续发展的具体策略和路径，特别是为能源企业提供了可借鉴的可持续发展实践经验和商业计划模式

title: Crafting new Imaginaries for Sustainability -What can Design Fiction Bring to Sustainability Education?
affiliations: ESCP Business School, ESCP Business School and Independent

detail.title: Crafting new Imaginaries for Sustainability -What can Design Fiction Bring to Sustainability Education?

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: In tackling sustainability grand challenges, the ability to create and share new narratives and imaginaries about the future is key. Imaginaries raise awareness, generate emotional involvement and foster action and innovation. Design fiction (DF) is a powerful innovative methodology that individuals may use to develop future fictional scenarios based on scientific data and science fiction reasoning in order to create awareness and start debates about possible futures. After outlining the origin, main principles and fields of application of DF, this article builds on the experience and feedback from a new 30-hour course called Design Fiction for sustainability, started in 2021 at ESCP Business School, to foster discussion on the potential of DF. How can DF contribute to renewing sustainability teaching in a business school? What type of imaginaries does DF help shape? To what extent does DF act as a catalyst for students to take action in their future role of managers?

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了设计虚构（Design Fiction）作为一种创新方法在商学院可持续发展教育中的应用潜力，通过分析ESCP商学院2021年开设的30小时课程经验，研究DF如何重塑可持续发展教学、塑造未来想象，并激励学生作为未来管理者采取行动。
AI.research_question: 设计虚构如何革新商学院可持续发展教学？DF帮助塑造何种类型的未来想象？DF在多大程度上能激励学生作为未来管理者采取行动？
AI.motivation: 应对可持续发展重大挑战需要创造和分享关于未来的新叙事和想象，这些想象能够提高意识、激发情感参与并促进行动和创新。设计虚构作为一种基于科学数据和科幻推理的方法，具有创造意识和引发未来讨论的潜力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计虚构理论框架，包括其起源、主要原则和应用领域；可持续发展教育理论；未来想象和叙事理论。
AI.method: 基于ESCP商学院2021年开设的30小时"可持续发展设计虚构"课程的经验和反馈进行定性分析。
AI.findings: 设计虚构能够有效革新商学院可持续发展教学，帮助学生通过虚构场景探索可能的未来，激发情感参与和行动意愿。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了设计虚构在教育领域的应用理论，特别是在可持续发展教育中的理论框架；深化了未来想象和叙事在商业教育中的作用理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为商学院可持续发展教学提供了创新的教学方法；为培养具有未来视野和行动力的管理者提供了实践路径；展示了设计虚构在激发学生行动意愿方面的实际效果。

affiliations: ESCP Business School

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: Traditional finance may be the single biggest stumbling block to reimagining capitalism». This sentence appears in Rebecca Henderson's best selling book titled: «Reimagining Capitalism: How Business Can Save the World », as one of the key pieces to reform the economic and political system in the right direction. These words generate clear ethical dilemmas for somebody such as myself who teaches finance in a business school like ESCP. Am I, as a finance teacher, one of the main blocks to Save the World? This paper aims to reflect upon the compatibility of finance and the goal of this ESCP's Impact Papers Edition to promote Better Business and Create Sustainable Value.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨传统金融是否是阻碍资本主义改革的主要障碍，反思金融教育与促进可持续商业价值之间的兼容性。
AI.research_question: 金融教育是否阻碍资本主义改革和可持续价值创造？
AI.motivation: 作者作为商学院金融教师，对传统金融可能成为资本主义改革障碍的说法产生伦理困境，希望反思金融与可持续价值创造的兼容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于Rebecca Henderson关于重新构想资本主义的理论，探讨传统金融在资本主义改革中的角色。
AI.method: 反思性论文，基于作者个人经验和理论分析。
AI.findings: 传统金融确实可能成为资本主义改革的障碍，但金融教育可以与可持续价值创造目标兼容。
AI.theory_contributions: 为金融伦理和可持续金融教育提供理论反思框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 帮助商学院金融教师重新思考教学内容和目标，促进金融教育向可持续方向发展。

detail.abstract: We describe how Sustainable Finance is understood in the European context, its current state, and its outlook. We argue that while the framework currently being developed to standardize our understanding of sustainable investments is absolutely necessary, it is also crucial for concrete laws and regulations to be created to incentivize actors in the financial markets to redirect funds from non-sustainable investments to sustainable alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧洲背景下可持续金融的理解、现状和前景，强调需要建立标准化框架和具体法规来激励金融市场将资金从非可持续投资转向可持续替代方案。

title: Capital has no Responsibility Toward Humans. Capital has no Responsibility Toward the Planet. … and Customers do not Fall from Heaven
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: Capital has no Responsibility Toward Humans. Capital has no Responsibility Toward the Planet. … and Customers do not Fall from Heaven

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: The task of management is value creation. However, this does not imply that value creation is the purpose of the corporation. This contribution discusses Milton Friedman's piece in the New York Times on "The Social Responsibility of Business to Increase Its Profits" and puts forward reflections pointing to the civic responsibility of the owner (principals) and of the agents (businessmen/managers). It is the responsibility of a business to fulfill its purpose as requested by its principal(s). Managers in their role as agents cannot only pursue increases in profits and shareholder return maximization, even if the owners as principals request them to do so. Owners as principals cannot ask their managers as agents to pursue only increases in profits or shareholder return maximization. Civic responsibilities prevail. In fact, value creation is not and cannot be per se the purpose of the corporation. It is the responsibility of a business to engage in open and free competition without deception and fraud. It is not the responsibility of a business to use it resources and to engage in activities designed to exploit humankind and nature.

AI.tldr: 本文批判了弗里德曼的企业社会责任观，认为企业不能仅追求利润最大化，所有者和管理者都负有公民责任，企业应在自由竞争中避免欺诈和剥削。
AI.research_question: 企业的真正责任是什么？价值创造是否应该成为企业的唯一目的？
AI.motivation: 回应弗里德曼在《纽约时报》发表的"企业的社会责任是增加利润"观点，探讨企业所有者和经理人的公民责任。
AI.theoretical_framework: 代理理论、企业社会责任理论、公民责任理论
AI.method: 理论分析和批判性反思
AI.findings: 企业不能仅追求利润最大化，所有者和管理者都负有公民责任；价值创造不应成为企业唯一目的；企业应在自由竞争中避免欺诈和剥削。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了弗里德曼的股东价值最大化理论，提出了企业公民责任的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业所有者和经理人提供了责任边界指导，强调企业应平衡经济利益与社会责任。

title: Guiding Passenger Search: Sequential Choice and Platform Design in Ride-Hailing
affiliations: The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen and The Chinese University of Hong Kong, Shenzhen

detail.title: Guiding Passenger Search: Sequential Choice and Platform Design in Ride-Hailing
detail.abstract: The expansion of service tiers on ride-hailing platforms such as Uber and Didi prompts an investigation into how mechanisms like search modes and search costs can manage a diverse user base. This study examines passenger adoption of platform-guided versus self-directed search and analyzes the strategic revenue implications of a positive search cost. We model the search process as a passenger choice between a self-directed Single-Request (SR) mode and a platform-assisted Dual-Request (DR) mode. In the SR mode, passengers iteratively search a single tier and incur a cost for each rejection. The DR mode, in contrast, involves the platform screening both tiers to present only the single match with the shortest expected wait time. This framework allows us to analyze how the design of these search modes shapes distinct passenger behaviors and impacts platform revenue. We find that platformguided search is valuable yet fragile, as rational passengers abandon it once one tier becomes dominant. Also, positive search cost is not necessarily a friction to be minimized. Instead, it could serve as a strategic tool that improves revenue from price-sensitive riders by tempering costly search behavior. The analysis further quantifies the harm of a static policy, revealing that a rule tailored only to sophisticated users causes less-experienced passengers to exit the market. To address these trade-offs, an adaptive uniform policy (AUP) is proposed. This policy maintains fixed prices and search costs but sets a smart default search mode in real time based on market conditions. This approach preserves uniform terms for all users while partially recovering the revenue loss due to user heterogeneity.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了网约车平台如何通过搜索模式和搜索成本管理多样化用户群体。研究发现平台引导搜索有价值但脆弱，理性用户会在某一层级主导时放弃使用。积极搜索成本可作为战略工具改善价格敏感用户的收入，而非需要最小化的摩擦。提出了自适应统一政策来解决用户异质性带来的收入损失。
AI.research_question: 网约车平台如何通过搜索模式和搜索成本机制来管理多样化用户群体并优化平台收入？
AI.motivation: 网约车平台服务层级的扩展促使研究如何通过搜索模式和搜索成本管理多样化用户群体，以优化平台战略收入。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将搜索过程建模为乘客在自主搜索（SR模式）和平台辅助搜索（DR模式）之间的选择，分析搜索成本对用户行为和平台收入的影响。
AI.method: 建立理论模型分析乘客在SR模式（单层级迭代搜索）和DR模式（平台筛选两个层级）之间的选择行为，以及搜索成本对平台收入的战略影响。
AI.findings: 平台引导搜索有价值但脆弱；积极搜索成本可作为战略工具改善收入；静态政策对经验不足用户有害；自适应统一政策能部分恢复用户异质性带来的收入损失。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了搜索成本作为战略工具的理论框架，揭示了平台引导搜索的脆弱性，并量化了用户异质性对平台政策设计的影响。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了自适应统一政策（AUP），在保持统一价格和搜索成本的同时，根据市场条件智能设置默认搜索模式，为平台管理者提供实用的政策设计指导。

title: "Made in Prison": Promoting Employment in Jails through Social Entrepreneurship
affiliations: ESCP Business School

detail.title: "Made in Prison": Promoting Employment in Jails through Social Entrepreneurship

publicationDetails.journalName: ESCP Business School Research Paper Series

detail.abstract: This article, while acknowledging the usual lack of transparency in the corporate use of prison labor and its different forms of abuse, aims to broaden the debate and to highlight the positive rise of innovative social entrepreneurship projects for the prison workforce. It focuses mainly on the case study of Pietà, a social and eco-responsible fashion initiative that manufactures and distributes its clothes from the prisons of Lima, Peru. Having built its brand image around the prison culture and by fully embracing the recruitment of inmates, Pietà offers insights into ways to balance ethics and business in the prison environment, with a view to promoting peaceful and inclusive societies.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析秘鲁利马监狱的Pietà社会企业案例，探讨如何在监狱环境中平衡伦理与商业，推动创新社会创业项目的发展。

title: The Impact of Total Quality Management on Operational Performance
affiliations: , AAB College and AAB College

detail.title: The Impact of Total Quality Management on Operational Performance

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Governance and Regulation, volume 12, issue 1, 2023[10.22495/jgrv12i1art16]

detail.abstract: Recent studies have highlighted the positive correlation between total quality management (TQM) and the performance of manufacturing companies (Sahoo & Yadav, 2018), which has been proven, specifically that the achievement of better operational performance is enabled by the application of TQM. This research aims to measure the impact of TQM through the components: organizational leadership, customer relationship, human resource management, strategic planning development, and supplier management in the operational performance of manufacturing enterprises in Kosovo. The research was carried out using the quantitative method, where 308 managers were part of the sample. Referring to the ordinary least squares (OLS) model, it turned out that organizational leadership and supplier management had the greatest impact on operational performance, while strategic planning development had the least impact. Also, based on the Mann-Whitney U test, it was found that there is a difference in the operational performance of manufacturing enterprises by categorizing them according to the implementation of ISO standards, where the enterprises that implement ISO standards had better operational performance.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过定量方法分析了全面质量管理(TQM)五个组成部分对科索沃制造企业运营绩效的影响，发现组织领导和供应商管理影响最大，战略规划发展影响最小。实施ISO标准的企业运营绩效更好。
AI.research_question: TQM的五个组成部分（组织领导、客户关系、人力资源管理、战略规划发展、供应商管理）如何影响科索沃制造企业的运营绩效？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明TQM与制造企业绩效呈正相关，但需要具体测量TQM各组成部分对运营绩效的影响，特别是在科索沃这样的发展中经济体。
AI.theoretical_framework: 全面质量管理(TQM)理论，包括组织领导、客户关系、人力资源管理、战略规划发展、供应商管理等核心组件。
AI.method: 定量研究方法，采用普通最小二乘法(OLS)模型分析308名管理者的问卷数据，并使用Mann-Whitney U检验比较实施ISO标准企业的绩效差异。
AI.findings: 1. 组织领导和供应商管理对运营绩效影响最大；2. 战略规划发展影响最小；3. 实施ISO标准的企业运营绩效显著更好。
AI.theory_contributions: 验证了TQM理论在发展中国家的适用性，明确了各组成部分对运营绩效的相对重要性，为TQM理论提供了实证支持。
AI.practical_contributions: 为科索沃制造企业提供了TQM实施的重点方向建议，强调了组织领导和供应商管理的重要性，以及ISO标准认证的价值。

title: Financial Structure and Mergers
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System,  and Government of the United States of America - Federal Trade Commission

detail.title: Financial Structure and Mergers

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: We study how corporate debt influences the competitive outcomes of horizontal and conglomerate mergers. In contrast to standard models where debt does not affect pricing, our framework shows that mergers can spread fixed debt obligations across a broader product portfolio, creating an "insurance effect" against adverse demand shocks. This effect interacts with the traditional recapture effect from reduced competition. Using numerical simulations and a case study of a major casino merger, we find that debt can either dampen or amplify post-merger price increases, depending on the merger's structure and the market environment.

AI.tldr: 本文研究企业债务如何影响横向和混合并购的竞争结果。与传统模型不同，债务通过将固定债务义务分散到更广泛的产品组合中，产生对抗需求冲击的"保险效应"，该效应与竞争减少的传统再捕获效应相互作用。研究发现债务可能抑制或放大并购后价格上涨，取决于并购结构和市场环境。
AI.research_question: 企业债务如何影响横向和混合并购的竞争结果？
AI.motivation: 传统并购模型通常假设债务不影响定价，但现实中企业债务水平对并购后的竞争结果可能有重要影响，需要建立新的理论框架来理解这一机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了一个包含债务因素的并购理论框架，强调债务分散产生的"保险效应"与竞争减少的"再捕获效应"之间的相互作用。
AI.method: 使用数值模拟方法和一个主要赌场并购的案例研究。
AI.findings: 债务可能抑制或放大并购后价格上涨，具体效果取决于并购结构（横向vs混合）和市场环境。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了传统并购模型中债务不影响定价的假设，提出了债务分散的保险效应理论，丰富了并购竞争效应的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和监管机构提供了评估并购竞争影响的新视角，特别是在高债务环境下，有助于更准确地预测并购后的价格变化和市场影响。
